item.g:title: Xiaomi Oscillation Electric Toothbrush Pro - Purple
item.g:description: Upgrade your daily oral care routine with the Xiaomi Oscillation Electric Toothbrush Pro, engineered with intelligent oscillation technology and precision-driven performance. Designed around the clinically recognised Bass brushing technique, this advanced electric toothbrush intelligently identifies individual tooth surfaces and automatically adjusts the brushing angle and vibration intensity for a deeper, more targeted clean. A built-in 6-axis motion sensor detects brushing orientation in real time, ensuring optimal coverage across all areas of the mouth. Whether you’re focusing on hard-to-reach gaps or polishing visible surfaces, the toothbrush dynamically adapts to your brushing behaviour for a smarter, more effective clean every time. The integrated smart colour digital display provides instant feedback on brushing coverage, recent brushing behaviour analysis, and operational mode selection. The screen automatically activates when the toothbrush is lifted, keeping you informed and in control of your oral hygiene. Designed for South African households seeking long-term reliability, the Xiaomi Oscillation Electric Toothbrush Pro delivers an impressive ultra-long battery life of up to 180 days in Gentle Mode and 100 days in Standard Mode, supported by convenient Type-C charging. With intelligent pressure detection that automatically reduces vibration when excessive force is applied, your gums remain protected while maintaining optimal plaque removal. item.g:title: Xiaomi 45W Nano Turbo Power Adapter (2 port)
item.g:description: The Xiaomi 45W Nano Turbo Power Adapter (2-Port) delivers powerful, efficient charging in an ultra-compact design built for modern lifestyles. Engineered with advanced GaN (Gallium Nitride) fast-charging technology, this adapter offers higher efficiency and improved thermal performance compared to traditional silicon chargers. With a maximum 45W output, it provides rapid charging for a wide range of devices, including smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, and other USB Type-C powered gadgets. Designed for convenience, the adapter features two USB Type-C ports, allowing you to charge multiple devices simultaneously without compromising speed. Its compact form factor makes it perfect for travel, office use, or everyday charging at home. Built with durable PC material and supporting universal 100–240V input, the Xiaomi 45W Nano Turbo Power Adapter is ideal for users who need reliable performance both locally and internationally. The charger supports multiple fast-charging protocols, including QC2.0, QC3.0, PD (Power Delivery), and PPS, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of mainstream devices from leading brands. Despite its powerful output, the adapter remains lightweight at only 72.5g, making it easy to carry in a bag or pocket. Its space-saving design ensures it fits neatly into crowded power strips or wall sockets, while the clean white finish complements modern tech setups. For South African users seeking a versatile, travel-ready charging solution, this adapter combines speed, safety, and portability in one sleek device. item.g:title: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W - Black
item.g:description: The Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W is engineered for modern smartphone users who demand portable power without compromising on style or performance. Designed with an incredibly slim 6mm profile and weighing just 98g, this ultra-light power bank easily slips into a pocket, handbag, or laptop sleeve—making it ideal for commuters, travellers, and everyday users across South Africa. Its premium aluminium alloy casing combined with a glass fibre charging panel delivers a refined finish while maintaining durability and efficient wireless power transfer. Built around a high-density Silicon-Carbon Anode lithium-ion battery, the device offers improved energy efficiency and compact battery storage, ensuring reliable performance in a remarkably slim form factor. Equipped with magnetic induction wireless charging, the power bank securely attaches to compatible smartphones, including Xiaomi devices and the iPhone 17 series, for seamless cable-free charging up to 15W. When faster charging is required, the USB Type-C wired output delivers up to 22.5W, enabling quick power top-ups for phones, earbuds, and other USB Type-C powered devices. The intelligent design also supports simultaneous wired and wireless charging, allowing two devices to be powered at once. Xiaomi integrates multiple advanced safety protections, including ESD protection and input over-voltage protection, ensuring stable charging performance while safeguarding both the power bank and connected devices. FEATURES: Only 6mm thick with a 98g ultra-light build, finished with a durable aluminium alloy casing and glass fibre charging surface. Advanced lithium-ion battery architecture provides efficient energy storage in a compact form factor. Secure 15W magnetic induction wireless charging compatible with supported Xiaomi smartphones and the iPhone 17 series. Rapid 22.5W charging via USB Type-C output, ideal for smartphones, earbuds, and portable devices. Charge one device wirelessly while powering another through USB Type-C at the same time. Integrated ESD protection and input over-voltage protection help maintain safe and stable charging performance. item.g:title: Cudy WR300S 300Mbps 5-Port Wi-Fi 4 Router – White
item.g:description: Cudy WR300S 300Mbps 5-Port Wi-Fi 4 Router – White 300Mbps Wi-Fi | 5 Fast Ethernet Ports | 5-in-1 Modes | VPN Client | Ideal for Small Homes Quick Specs • 300Mbps Wi-Fi 4 performance on 2.4GHz • 5 Fast Ethernet ports (1× WAN + 4× LAN) • 5-in-1 Modes: Router / Access Point / Extender / WISP / Client • Built-in VPN Client (WireGuard, PPTP, L2TP) • Covers up to 90m² with 4 external antennas Compact & Versatile for Everyday Connectivity The WR300S is designed for apartments, small homes and offices needing stable, affordable internet coverage. With 300Mbps wireless speeds and four high-gain external antennas, it delivers reliable signal strength for browsing, HD streaming and smart home connectivity. Its five Fast Ethernet ports allow you to connect gaming consoles, smart TVs, desktop PCs and network devices without relying entirely on Wi-Fi, helping to reduce congestion and maintain stable performance. Whether you're upgrading an older router or setting up a secondary network, the WR300S provides flexible deployment options without complexity. Flexible 5-in-1 Multi-Mode Operation The WR300S is designed to adapt easily to different network environments with five versatile operating modes. In Router Mode, it functions as a standard home router, sharing your internet connection across multiple wired and wireless devices. Access Point Mode allows you to add Wi-Fi to an existing wired network, making it ideal for expanding coverage in offices or larger homes. When set to Range Extender Mode, it boosts and extends an existing wireless signal to improve coverage in areas with weak reception. WISP Mode enables connection to a wireless internet service provider, making it suitable for fixed wireless setups. In Client Mode, the router can provide wired network access to devices by connecting them to an existing Wi-Fi network. This flexibility makes the WR300S a practical solution for fibre connections, fixed wireless services, or repurposing older networking equipment. Secure & Private Networking With built-in VPN client support for WireGuard, PPTP and L2TP, the WR300S lets you secure your entire home network through a private, encrypted connection without needing to install VPN software on every device. item.g:title: Keychron V3 Max QMK/VIA 80% Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard (Banana Switch) – Carbon Black
item.g:description: The Keychron V3 Max QMK/VIA Wireless Mechanical Keyboard is built for enthusiasts who demand both performance and customization in a compact form. Featuring an 80% TKL layout, it strikes the perfect balance between functionality and desk space, offering a full set of keys without the bulk of a numpad. Its gasket mount design and ABS plastic body with a PC plate deliver a stable yet cushioned typing feel, while the hot-swappable design supports most 3-pin and 5-pin MX-style mechanical switches, giving you endless customization options. Connectivity is seamless with triple-mode support: 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.1, and USB Type-C wired. With a 1000Hz polling rate in wired and 2.4GHz modes, and 90Hz in Bluetooth, the V3 Max ensures ultra-low latency and high responsiveness across gaming, productivity, or creative tasks. You can connect and switch between up to three devices effortlessly, making it ideal for those who work or play across multiple platforms. Typing comfort and visual appeal are at the forefront with OSA double-shot PBT keycaps, designed for durability and a premium texture. Paired with south-facing RGB backlighting, users enjoy vibrant lighting effects without interference when using custom keycap sets. The Gateron Jupiter BANANA switches included in the fully assembled version offer smooth actuation with a tactile bump, while screw-in PCB stabilizers ensure a quieter and more stable typing experience. The 4000mAh rechargeable Li-polymer battery delivers up to 190 hours of use with backlighting off, or up to 100 hours with RGB on its lowest brightness, ensuring long-lasting performance. With QMK/VIA support, users have full control to program macros, remap keys, and customize lighting to suit their workflow. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, the Keychron V3 Max is a versatile powerhouse that combines modern wireless technology, premium build quality, and limitless customization. item.g:title: PCBuilder CUBE-N100 8GB DDR4 512GB Windows 11 Home Mini PC
item.g:description: QUICK SPEC: PCBuilder CUBE Mini PC Intel® N100 4-Core 2.5GHz (Up to 3.4GHz) 8GB DDR4 3200MHz SO-DIMM Memory (1x 8GB) Intel® UHD Integrated Graphics 512GB Gen3 M.2 NVMe Solid State Drive (SSD) Built-in Power Supply 2.5Gb LAN and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity Microsoft Windows 11 Home The PCBuilder CUBE-N100 Intel Mini PC delivers powerful desktop performance in a compact PC form, making it an ideal choice for offices, digital signage, and point-of-sale (POS) systems. Whether you need a reliable workstation or a space-saving business solution, this compact PC ensures smooth multitasking with its Intel® N100 processor, featuring 4 cores and 4 threads reaching speeds of up to 3.40GHz. It also features 8GB of high speed DDR4 SODIMM memory and a 512GB Gen3 M.2 NVMe SSD to ensure that every task gets done on time. Designed for professional environments, the CUBE-N100 Intel Mini PC supports stunning 4K visuals with Intel® UHD Integrated Graphics. Dual HDMI 2.1 ports allow you to extend or mirror your display, creating an efficient multi-monitor setup for increased productivity. Whether you’re running presentations, managing business applications, or driving digital signage, this compact PC delivers crisp, vibrant visuals at 4K@60Hz. With Intel® Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax), Bluetooth 5.2, and Gigabit Ethernet, this Intel N100 Mini PC ensures seamless connectivity. It also features rapid USB 3.2 and Type-C ports, supporting data transfers up to 10Gbps – perfect for quick file access and connecting external devices. Storage flexibility is another advantage of this compact PC. It supports an M.2 PCIe 4.0 NVME SSD for high-speed performance, a 2.5” SATA HDD for additional capacity, and a microSD card reader for easy expansion. Whether you need fast boot speeds or ample storage, the PCBuilder CUBE-N100 Intel Mini PC adapts to your needs. Designed to save space, this compact PC is VESA-mountable, allowing for a clutter-free setup by attaching it behind a monitor. The included VESA mount makes installation simple, while its durable build ensures long-lasting reliability. Security is also a priority, with a Kensington lock slot providing protection in shared office environments. The PCBuilder CUBE comes pre-installed with Windows 11, which has easy-to-use tools that can help you optimise your screen space and maximise your productivity. It features great tools like Microsoft Edge, the new and improved Microsoft Store, Snap Layouts to arrange your open windows into grids, Desktops for better organisation, as well as Widgets. If you’re looking for an efficient and space-saving solution for your workspace, the PCBuilder CUBE-N100 Intel Mini PC offers a perfect balance of power and convenience. With its compact size, versatile connectivity, and high-speed performance, this compact PC is built to enhance productivity in any professional setting. Built in-house by our experienced technicians, each build is constructed with care and precision. They’re packaged with protective foam that secures the components while in transit, so every build arrives at its destination ready to use from day one. PCBuilder mini PCs come with a 2-year warranty. Windows 11 reimagines the way a PC should work for you and with you. item.g:title: Hiksemi Future 2TB Gen4 M.2 NVMe NAND SSD
item.g:description: Unlock ultra-fast performance with the Hiksemi Future 2TB Gen4 M.2 NVMe SSD, a next-generation storage solution built for speed, reliability, and intelligent design. Powered by the latest PCIe Gen4x4 interface, this high-performance SSD delivers sequential read speeds of up to 7450MB/s and write speeds up to 6750MB/s, making it ideal for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts who demand peak responsiveness and accelerated workflows. Whether you're booting your OS, launching applications, or transferring massive files, the Hiksemi Future SSD is engineered to eliminate delays and keep your system running at full throttle. At its core, the Hiksemi Future SSD leverages advanced 3D TLC NAND flash and a proprietary NAND Flash management system developed by Hiksemi. This ensures optimized performance, data integrity, and energy efficiency—delivering consistent high-speed operations even under demanding conditions. With 860K IOPS read and 690K IOPS write capabilities, it excels in multitasking and real-time application execution, making it the perfect choice for content creators, software developers, and professionals who need both speed and dependability. This SSD isn’t just about raw performance—it’s designed for rugged reliability. Thanks to its solid-state architecture, the Hiksemi Future 2TB SSD is inherently shock and vibration-resistant, eliminating the risk of mechanical failure. The absence of moving parts paired with low power consumption (max 3.66W) makes it an efficient choice for both desktops and ultrathin laptops. Additionally, its thermal management system keeps your system cool under pressure, further extending the drive's lifespan and maintaining optimal performance. Compatible with a wide range of devices including gaming desktops, laptops, and even PlayStation 5, the Hiksemi Future SSD offers versatile deployment in today’s most demanding digital environments. With an impressive 3600TBW endurance rating and 2 million hours MTBF, it's backed by Hiksemi’s renowned quality standards and a reliable after-sales support system. For users looking to future-proof their systems with blazing-fast storage, the Hiksemi Future 2TB Gen4 M.2 NVMe SSD is a high-performance, long-term investment built for modern computing. item.g:title: Hiksemi City Series E100 2TB 2.5" SATAIII SSD
item.g:description: Unlock reliable performance and faster data access with the Hiksemi City Series E100 2TB 2.5" SATAIII SSD, designed to breathe new life into your desktop or laptop. Backed by years of development in flash memory and storage optimisation, this SSD offers seamless startup times, improved system responsiveness, and ultra-stable operation for daily computing needs. Whether you're upgrading an older system or building a new one, the E100 ensures efficient data transfer and application loading, transforming your overall computing experience. At its core, the E100 SSD is powered by advanced 3D NAND flash technology, enabling greater storage density and long-term stability. With impressive sequential read and write speeds of up to 560MB/s and 520MB/s, respectively, along with IOPS up to 72K, this drive ensures rapid multitasking, quick boot-ups, and fast file transfers. It features SATA III 6Gb/s interface compatibility for wide-ranging support across desktops, laptops, and even gaming consoles like the PS4. With a total write endurance (TBW) of 960TB and a mean time between failures (MTBF) of 2 million hours, the E100 is built for longevity and reliability. Engineered for durability, the Hiksemi E100 boasts a vibration-resistant, chip-based structure with no moving parts, enhancing data security and reducing failure risk in portable or active environments. Despite its lightweight design at just ≤ 36.8g, the E100 doesn't compromise on protection, offering TRIM support, low power consumption of only 3.5W max, and robust operating temperatures ranging from 0°C to 70°C. This makes it a dependable solution for mobile professionals, everyday users, or content creators looking for consistent performance without excessive heat or energy drain. Whether you're editing high-resolution videos, loading game files, or simply upgrading from a traditional hard drive, the Hiksemi E100 2TB SSD is a smart investment for enhanced storage performance and data security. With universal compatibility and easy installation in any 2.5" SATA-equipped system, it offers a powerful, cost-effective solution for improving computing speed and extending the life of your device. Elevate your system’s responsiveness and efficiency today with a drive designed for speed, stability, and endurance. FEATURES: High R/W Speed SATA interface Max. item.g:title: FSP S380 M-ATX ARGB Gaming Chassis and VITA GM 750W Power Supply Bundle
item.g:description: Elevate your gaming experience with the FSP S380 M-ATX ARGB Gaming Chassis and VITA GM 750W Power Supply Bundle. This dynamic duo combines sleek design with powerful performance, perfect for gamers who want to stand out and dominate. Ideal for a system upgrade or building a new gaming rig, this bundle lets you show off your system while giving it stable and efficient power. The FSP S380 ARGB M-ATX Gaming Chassis is designed to impress, featuring a striking 3D curved glass panel that provides a seamless 270° panoramic view of your gaming setup. The elegant chamfered front panel edges enhance the case’s premium aesthetic, making it a standout addition to any build. This design not only showcases your hardware in style but also adds a refined touch that complements high-performance gaming systems. Built for both visual appeal and optimal cooling, the S380 comes equipped with three pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans, including two reverse silent fans on the side and one at the rear. The fans, fully controllable via the motherboard, offer stunning synchronized lighting effects while ensuring efficient airflow to maintain system stability. With support for up to a 360mm radiator on the top panel, this case delivers exceptional cooling performance, allowing you to push your hardware to its limits without overheating concerns. Built to handle the demanding power requirements of tomorrow, these PSUs support total power excursion as per ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 specifications, ensuring they deliver peak performance for future hardware upgrades. Certified with 80 PLUS® Gold efficiency and achieving platinum-level efficiency at typical loads, these power supplies minimise power loss, heat, and noise, offering a cooler and quieter operation. The advanced LLC resonant-converter topology with synchronous rectification reduces switching losses and keeps the output voltage stable, even under heavy loads, maximising overall system efficiency. The +5V and 3.3V DC to DC circuit design ensures consistent voltage and system stability, while premium 105°C Japanese bulk capacitors provide top-tier reliability and longevity, making them the ideal choice for high-performance PCs. Whether you’re a gamer or a power user, these PSUs deliver lasting power and performance you can count on. Together, the FSP S380 M-ATX ARGB Gaming Chassis and VITA GM 750W power supply provide the perfect foundation for your dream gaming PC. Whether you’re battling it out in the latest FPS or exploring vast open worlds, this bundle ensures your system performs at its best while looking stunning. Level up your gaming setup and unleash your true potential with this unbeatable combination. item.g:description: The Patriot Viper VP4300 Lite 1TB Gen4 NVMe SSD is engineered for gamers and power users who demand peak performance, durability, and compatibility across platforms. Whether you're booting up your PC or loading next-gen games on your PlayStation® 5, the VP4300 Lite guarantees a seamless experience with PS5-compatible read speeds up to 6,100MB/s. Designed with a DRAMless architecture for power efficiency, the VP4300 Lite supports Host Memory Buffer (HMB), Toggle 5, and ONFi 5 mode flash to enable double data rates of up to 2,400MT/s. It also incorporates SmartECC™ technology and an embedded thermal sensor that actively manages heat and prevents performance throttling. The ultra-slim graphene heatshield not only maintains consistent thermal levels but also ensures universal fit inside compact gaming laptops, desktops, and PlayStation 5 consoles. With an endurance rating of 800TBW and an impressive 1.8 million-hour MTBF, this SSD is built for long-term reliability. item.g:title: ASRock X870 Riptide AM5 Wi-Fi Phantom Gaming Motherboard
item.g:description: Experience the cutting edge of gaming performance and system flexibility with the ASRock X870 Riptide AM5 Wi-Fi Phantom Gaming Motherboard, engineered for enthusiasts who demand power, precision, and personalization. Designed around the powerful AMD X870 chipset and AM5 socket, this high-performance motherboard supports the latest Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, delivering exceptional responsiveness across gaming, streaming, and content creation. Featuring an 8-layer PCB, the X870 Riptide ensures superior thermal and power efficiency—perfect for extreme DDR5 memory overclocking up to 8000+ MHz. Whether you're fine-tuning performance via AMD EXPO™ profiles or pushing your system to the edge, the Riptide offers rock-solid reliability with a sleek, gamer-centric aesthetic. Connectivity and expansion are at the heart of the X870 Riptide. It supports PCIe 5.0 graphics cards and Gen5 NVMe SSDs, with a Blazing M.2 slot that achieves up to 128 Gb/s transfer rates for next-gen storage. Users benefit from USB4 Type-C ports offering up to 40 Gb/s of data throughput, along with USB 3.2 Gen2x2 front panel Type-C, making high-speed data access simple and future-proof. Networking is equally robust with Killer 2.5Gb LAN and Wi-Fi 7 + Bluetooth 5.4, delivering seamless online gameplay and ultra-low latency. Audio and aesthetics haven't been overlooked. Nahimic 7.1 HD Audio powered by the Realtek ALC4082 codec immerses gamers with crisp, spatial sound, while Polychrome SYNC and SignalRGB support allow for synchronized, addressable RGB lighting across your entire rig. The advanced aluminum heatsink design and M.2 heatsinks ensure top-tier thermal performance, keeping even the most demanding setups cool. Whether you're building your dream gaming PC or an elite workstation, the ASRock X870 Riptide delivers everything you need—and more—to ride the wave of next-gen performance. item.g:title: ASUS PRO B760M C CSM LGA 1700 M-ATX Motherboard
item.g:description: The ASUS PRO B760M-C-CSM LGA 1700 mATX Motherboard is a robust and reliable business-class solution designed to meet the demands of modern enterprise computing. Built on the Intel® B760 chipset and supporting 13th and 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors, this micro-ATX motherboard delivers advanced performance, enhanced durability, and enterprise-grade features. With support for PCIe® 4.0 and DDR5 memory, the board offers lightning-fast data throughput and improved multitasking, making it ideal for performance-driven office builds or commercial applications. ASUS’ long-standing reputation for quality and its Corporate Stable Model (CSM) program ensures long-term availability and consistent support for IT departments. Designed with reliability in mind, the ASUS PRO B760M-C-CSM features anti-sulfur resistors, corrosion-resistant stainless steel I/O panels, and a moisture-resistant PCB coating to ensure continued operation in challenging environments such as factories or internet cafés. ASUS LANGuard and ESD Guards offer robust protection against power surges and electrostatic discharge, further extending component lifespan and network stability. The board is also tested for 24/7 durability in temperatures up to 45°C and 80% relative humidity—perfect for mission-critical deployments and demanding usage scenarios. Customization and management are streamlined through the ASUS Control Center Express, an intuitive IT monitoring and maintenance software suite. Built-in features like Q-LED Core, COM debug headers, and event logging tools help administrators diagnose and resolve issues efficiently. The motherboard also includes a DASH LAN header for remote management, allowing IT teams to monitor and manage devices over the network, significantly improving fleet maintenance and deployment time across large-scale environments. With a versatile feature set that includes two M.2 slots, front USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C®, 7.1 surround sound audio, and dual DisplayPort, HDMI®, and VGA outputs, the ASUS PRO B760M-C-CSM is as flexible as it is powerful. The consistent internal connector layout and box-style USB headers ensure easier integration, saving time on training and hardware compatibility. Whether you're upgrading your business infrastructure or building a new enterprise workstation, this motherboard offers efficiency, security, and longevity, making it a smart investment for professionals and IT departments alike. item.g:description: The MSI PRO X870-P WIFI AM5 ATX DDR5 Motherboard is purpose-built for professionals and power users who demand both performance and reliability. Sporting a clean and modern silver design, this motherboard seamlessly complements both black and white PC builds. At its core, the PRO X870-P is optimized for the latest AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, delivering future-ready computing with support for ultra-fast DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0 slots, and lightning-fast M.2 storage. With MSI’s exclusive features like EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II, EZ Antenna, and Supplemental PCIe Power, this board ensures effortless installation and thermal efficiency for next-gen performance. item.g:title: Patriot Signature Line 16GB 5600MHz DDR5 UDIMM Desktop Memory
item.g:description: Upgrade your desktop with Patriot’s Signature Line 16GB DDR5 5600MHz UDIMM, engineered to meet the growing demands of next-generation computing. Tailored for Intel’s latest platforms, this DDR5 memory module delivers a massive leap in bandwidth and responsiveness, with a blazing 5600MT/s data rate (PC5-44800). Designed to optimize both power efficiency and thermal performance, it runs on just 1.1V, generating less heat without compromising speed—ideal for performance enthusiasts and professional-grade system builds. The module features a Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC), providing precise local voltage regulation and advanced monitoring to ensure peak efficiency under heavy workloads. Integrated thermal sensors offer real-time temperature management to safeguard against overheating, while on-die ECC (Error-Correcting Code) boosts system stability by ensuring accurate data processing. Built to exacting standards and rigorously 100% tested, the Signature Line DDR5 module guarantees compatibility, reliability, and endurance under demanding conditions. With a limited lifetime warranty and support for the latest DDR5 standards, Patriot’s Signature Line memory is the perfect drop-in upgrade for desktops seeking faster multitasking, lower latency, and long-term durability in everyday and intensive use scenarios. item.g:title: Patriot Signature Line 8GB 5600MHz DDR5 SODIMM Notebook Memory
item.g:description: Unlock powerful performance in your next-generation laptop with the Patriot Signature Line DDR5 8GB 5600MHz SODIMM. Engineered to meet the increasing demands of modern computing, this high-efficiency DDR5 module brings next-level speed, energy savings, and stability to your system. With a base frequency of 5600MT/s (PC5-44800) and ultra-low 1.1V operating power, this module is the ideal upgrade for users looking to enhance multitasking, improve load times, and maximise system responsiveness in compatible Intel platforms. Designed specifically for compact laptops and small form factor systems, this 262-pin DDR5 SODIMM utilises Single Rank, single-sided architecture for optimal compatibility. Whether you’re handling everyday productivity, intensive applications, or multitasking environments, the Patriot DDR5 ensures a smooth, reliable computing experience. Each module is 100% factory tested to ensure consistency, reliability, and top-tier performance. The onboard Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC) offers granular control over voltage delivery, improving efficiency while also enabling smarter thermal and power management. Combined with on-die ECC (Error-Correcting Code), the module ensures data integrity by correcting minor errors in real time, boosting system reliability and overall operational stability—ideal for professionals, students, and system integrators. Additionally, the integrated thermal sensors help monitor internal temperature in real time, proactively preventing overheating and enhancing the long-term durability of your device. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this DDR5 memory upgrade from Patriot offers peace of mind and future-ready performance, making it the smart choice for any new Intel-powered build or laptop upgrade. item.g:title: ASRock B860M-X WIFI Micro ATX DDR5 Motherboard (PCIe 5 and Wi-Fi 6E)
item.g:description: For system builders who want performance without the bulk, the ASRock X-Series Micro ATX DDR5 Motherboard with PCIe Gen5 & Wi-Fi 6E stands out as a compact powerhouse engineered for serious productivity. It’s designed to support the latest Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 2 CPUs on the LGA1851 socket, combining next-gen processing with high-speed memory and lightning-fast connectivity. The Micro ATX form factor makes it ideal for compact setups, but there’s nothing small about what it delivers. Dual DDR5 DIMM slots support up to 128GB with overclocking speeds north of 9066MHz. This level of headroom means smoother multitasking, faster compile times, and more responsive virtualisation—especially useful for professionals working across demanding workflows. Storage is handled with equal ambition: a blazing PCIe Gen5 M.2 slot on the CPU lane delivers up to 128Gb/s, complemented by Gen4 M.2 and four SATA ports with RAID support. Visual output is equally robust, with support for 4K 120Hz via HDMI 2.1 and up to 8K 60Hz through DisplayPort 1.4, ideal for content creators and multi-monitor users. Networking and I/O are where the board quietly excels. You get 2.5GbE LAN with smart bandwidth controls and Wi-Fi 6E for reliable wireless throughput—even in congested environments. Add BIOS Flashback, driver-free installation, and ASRock’s signalRGB lighting control, and you’ve got a board that’s as functional as it is forward-looking. This is more than just a Micro ATX DDR5 motherboard with PCIe Gen5—it’s a strategic backbone for professionals who demand desktop-grade stability in a smaller footprint. If versatility, speed, and build efficiency matter, this board deserves a serious look. item.g:title: LG UltraGear 27" QHD IPS Gaming 180/200Hz Overclock 1ms
item.g:description: Level up your competitive edge with the LG UltraGear 27GS75Q 27" QHD IPS Gaming Monitor, engineered to deliver lightning-fast responsiveness, brilliant visuals, and precision control. Designed for hardcore gamers and content creators, this high-performance display offers a native 180Hz refresh rate that can be overclocked to a blistering 200Hz, ensuring seamless motion clarity in every frame. Combined with a rapid 1ms GtG response time, it delivers the split-second responsiveness needed to dominate high-speed titles. Dive into rich, vibrant colour with the 2560x1440 QHD resolution and 99% sRGB colour gamut, bringing your games and content to life with exceptional clarity and detail. Whether you're exploring fantasy landscapes or engaged in fast-paced FPS combat, HDR10 support enhances contrast and colour depth for a more immersive viewing experience. With AMD FreeSync™ and NVIDIA G-SYNC® Compatibility, screen tearing and stuttering are effectively eliminated, giving you buttery-smooth gameplay every time. The LG UltraGear 27GS75Q is packed with gamer-centric features, including preset display modes for Gamer, FPS, and RTS, an FPS counter, and intuitive OnScreen Control. Two HDMI ports, a DisplayPort 1.4, and a USB-C port provide wide-ranging connectivity, allowing you to hook up consoles, PCs, and peripherals with ease. The display is fully tilt, height, and pivot adjustable, so you can set it to your ideal viewing angle for comfort during long sessions. Built with a three-sided, virtually borderless design, this monitor maximizes screen real estate while delivering a modern, minimalist aesthetic that fits any gaming setup. With 300cd/m² brightness, 1000:1 contrast ratio, and wall mountable 100 x 100mm compatibility, the LG UltraGear 27GS75Q is a versatile, future-ready choice for anyone seeking premium performance without compromise. item.g:title: ASRock Radeon RX 9060 XT Challenger 16GB OC Graphics Card (RDNA™ 4, PCIe 5.0)
item.g:description: The ASRock Radeon™ RX 9060 XT Challenger 16GB OC is more than a graphics card—it’s your new performance anchor. Built on AMD’s latest RDNA™ 4 architecture and fine-tuned for uncompromising 1440p gaming, this GPU pairs raw silicon muscle with refined efficiency. Whether you're pushing frame rates in ray-traced blockbusters, accelerating AI-enhanced workflows, or streaming crisp, artefact-free footage, the RX 9060 XT delivers every frame with clarity and composure. Under the hood, 2,048 Stream Processors and 32 Compute Units—each equipped with 3rd Gen Ray Accelerators and 2nd Gen AI Accelerators—form the computational backbone of the card. Bolstered by a Boost Clock of up to 3290MHz and a blazing-fast 16GB of GDDR6 memory running at 20Gbps, the RX 9060 XT is primed for high-intensity scenarios and multitasking madness. It supports DirectX® 12 Ultimate, OpenGL 4.6, and AMD’s FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 4, letting you game smarter, not harder—with enhanced detail, smoother performance, and jaw-dropping visuals. Thermal control is where the Challenger earns its name. This model integrates a sophisticated dual-fan cooling system, featuring Striped Axial Fans that channel more air, a high-density fin stack with ultra-fit heatpipes, and Nano Thermal Paste that bridges every microscopic gap for optimal heat transfer. And when the system is idle? The 0dB Silent Cooling mode stops the fans entirely, keeping your setup both cool and quiet. Structurally, the Challenger is built with finesse. A full metal backplate adds rigidity and acts as a passive heatsink, while subtle LED lighting provides ambient flair without overstatement. Prefer a darker aesthetic? Flip the onboard LED switch and keep it stealthy. With a matte black PCB, high-density glass fabric layering, and a Dr.MOS power stage delivering up to 50A per phase, this card balances engineering prowess with visual sophistication. Optimised for AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series processors and AM5 platforms, the RX 9060 XT takes full advantage of Smart Access Memory™ to maximise CPU-GPU bandwidth. Meanwhile, AMD’s Adrenalin Edition software puts one-click performance tuning and real-time AI-powered enhancements at your fingertips. Whether you’re a competitive gamer, creative professional, or performance enthusiast, this GPU is ready to raise the bar. item.g:title: PCBuilder FLEX 15.6" Full HD IPS Portable Monitor
item.g:description: The PCBuilder FLEX 15.6” Full HD IPS Portable Monitor is the ultimate portable computer monitor designed for versatility, convenience, and stunning visual performance. Whether you're on a business trip, working remotely, or simply need a flexible second screen, this ultra-slim and lightweight display makes productivity and entertainment possible anywhere. It’s the perfect portable monitor for laptop users who need a reliable screen extension while traveling, at a café, or even in a hotel room. Equipped with a crisp 15.6-inch Full HD IPS display, the FLEX delivers vibrant visuals with rich detail and colour accuracy. Its bright colour clarity and wide 178° viewing angles ensure everything from work presentations to movies looks sharp and consistent from any angle. With a contrast ratio of 1000:1 and up to 250 nits of brightness, this portable computer monitor holds its own even in brightly lit environments, making it a dependable screen in any situation. Designed with portability in mind, the FLEX features an ultra-thin build that slides effortlessly into backpacks or laptop bags. The foldable magnetic cover doubles as a stand, allowing for instant setup wherever you are - no tools or extra gear required. This makes it a standout portable desktop monitor that adapts to your workflow on the fly, whether you're presenting to clients or extending your display space at a coffee shop. The monitor offers universal compatibility with two Type-C ports, one Mini HDMI input, and a 3.5mm AUX audio output. Whether you're connecting to a laptop, smartphone, console, or tablet, you’ll appreciate the seamless plug-and-play experience. The two Type-C ports supports both power and video, so you can keep cables to a minimum - an ideal setup for the modern, mobile user in need of a compact portable computer monitor. With a 60Hz refresh rate, 8ms response time (GTG), and support for HDR and FreeSync, this monitor also handles multimedia content and casual gaming with ease. If you’re in need of a second screen that doubles as a portable monitor for laptop setups or serves as a compact, efficient portable desktop monitor, the PCBuilder FLEX is your all-in-one solution. So whether you’re jumping between client meetings, creating on the move, or simply kicking back with a movie after hours, the PCBuilder FLEX is your go-anywhere, do-anything screen. More than just a portable computer monitor, it’s your everyday advantage - helping you stay productive and inspired no matter where you are. FEATURES: Your full setup, without the full desk - perfect for travel and remote work Crisp 15.6-inch Full HD IPS display brings your content to life in rich detail Stay connected with easy Type-C and HDMI support for all your devices Effortless setup with power and video in one connection. Wide viewing angles keep visuals sharp and colors true from any position 250 nits of brightness for easy viewing in any light Set up anywhere in seconds with a fold-to-stand magnetic cover Ultra-thin and lightweight build slides neatly into any work or travel bag SPECIFICATIONS: Panel type: IPS Size: 15.6-inch Aspect Ratio: 16:9 Resolution: 1920 x 1080 Viewing Angle: 178°(H) / 178°(V) Refresh Rate: 60Hz Response Time: 8ms (GTG) Brightness (typ): Up to 250 cd/m² Colour Depth: 262k (6-bit) Contrast Ratio: 1000:1 Default Colour Temperature: 6500 Freesync: Yes HDR Support: Yes I/O interface: 1x Mini HDMI 2x Type-C DP™ & PD™ (5V/2A) 1x 3.5mm AUX audio (line-out)" Power Rating: Type-C (5V/2A) VESA Mount: Yes (75x75mm) Colour: Black Materials: PC+ABS Operating Temperature: 0ºC to 50ºC Product Dimensions: 36 x 23.1 x 1.1 cm Product Weight: 1kg WHAT'S IN THE BOX: PCBuilder FLEX 15.6 inch Full HD IPS Portable Monitor - Black x1 Type-C to Type-C Cable (power and display) x1 USB to Type-C Cable (power only) x1 Mini HDMI to HDMI Cable (display only) x1 PU Leather Cover x1 User Manual x1

item.g:title: Acer Travelmate P4 16″ Laptop | Intel U5-125U | 8GB DDR5 | 1TB NVMe | Windows 11 Pro
item.g:description: The Acer TravelMate P4 16″ is a business-class powerhouse, purpose-built for professionals and small businesses that demand reliable, high-performance computing for daily operations. Combining cutting-edge processing power with efficient design, this laptop offers the perfect blend of productivity, connectivity, and mobility — making it ideal for users who work in dynamic, fast-paced environments. Powered by a 14th Gen Intel® Core™ Ultra 5-125U processor, this TravelMate P4 delivers exceptional computing capabilities with a base clock speed of 1.3GHz and Turbo Boost up to 4.4GHz, supported by 12MB of Intel® Smart Cache. As part of Intel’s next-generation platform, the Ultra series processor integrates advanced AI-enhanced performance, security features, and power management for smarter multitasking and higher efficiency across professional workloads. Whether you're crunching spreadsheets, attending virtual meetings, or managing multiple cloud-based apps, the TravelMate P4 keeps you performing at peak productivity. This system includes 8GB of DDR5 RAM, with support for up to 64GB, ensuring your laptop is future-ready for more demanding applications. The high-speed 1TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD provides ample space for documents, large media files, and enterprise software, while dramatically reducing load times and enabling faster data access and system boot-up. Enjoy superior visuals on the 16-inch Full HD+ Acer ComfyView™ LED-backlit IPS display (1920 x 1200 resolution). With 400 nits of brightness, the screen delivers sharp, clear visuals in a 16:10 aspect ratio—perfect for reviewing documents, video conferencing, or streaming presentations. Integrated Intel® Graphics further ensures smooth rendering of multimedia content, business visuals, and daily productivity tasks. Designed with modern business users in mind, the TravelMate P4 includes advanced wireless and wired connectivity. Featuring Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth® 5.3, and dual USB Type-C ports supporting USB4 and Thunderbolt™ 4, this laptop delivers ultra-fast data transfer, video output, and charging capabilities. Additional ports include HDMI® 2.1, two USB-A ports, and an RJ-45 Ethernet port, offering compatibility with all your devices and peripherals. Security and collaboration tools are equally robust. The IR webcam with privacy shutter and integrated fingerprint reader support Windows Hello for quick and secure login. Two digital microphones enhanced by Acer Purified Voice™ AI noise reduction and dual stereo DTS® Audio speakers ensure clear communication during virtual meetings. The 3-cell Lithium-Ion battery provides up to 11 hours of runtime, keeping you powered throughout your workday. With a durable chassis and business-focused design, the Acer TravelMate P4 offers unmatched reliability and functionality in its class. The multi-gesture touchpad, international keyboard layout, and Windows 11 Pro Operating System enhance usability, allowing you to work smarter and more securely across business platforms. item.g:title: Acer X1228i DLP XGA 4800Lm 20000:1 EMEA, Bag, Data Projector, SA Power
item.g:description: The Acer X1128i DLP XGA Projector is a cost-effective, high-performance solution built for both work and entertainment. Part of Acer’s renowned Essential Series, this projector delivers reliable, sharp visuals with a brightness of up to 4,800 ANSI lumens, making it ideal for use in daylight or medium-to-large rooms. Whether you’re delivering impactful business presentations or enjoying immersive home entertainment, the X1128i ensures your content always stands out with stunning clarity. With its native XGA (1024 x 768) resolution, this projector provides crisp images and vibrant video playback. It’s equipped with Acer LumiSense™ technology, which intelligently adapts image brightness and colour saturation based on the content you’re viewing. Add in ColorBoost3D™ and ColorSafe II™ technologies for lifelike colour reproduction and long-lasting performance, and you’ve got a visual powerhouse built to perform. The projector also supports HDMI 3D, giving your visuals a cinematic upgrade that jumps off the screen. Wireless-ready for added convenience, the Acer X1128i eliminates cable clutter with optional dongle support. Engineered for 24/7 operation, it’s a solid choice for public installations or extended daily use. The integrated BlueLightShield™ technology helps protect eyes from fatigue, making it a thoughtful companion for longer viewing sessions. item.g:title: Xiaomi Mi Box S and TV Stick Remote Control
item.g:description: Control your Xiaomi Mi TV Stick or Xiaomi Mi Box S easily with the Xiaomi Mi Remote Control. This device features everything you would expect from the base remotes that come with the TV Stick and Mi Box. The remote connects easily to your Mi TV Stick or Mi Box S via Bluetooth. No need to worry about typing anymore thanks to Google Assistant. Press the mic button on your remote to quickly find what you’re looking for, whether you’re searching for your favourite show, song or asking about the weather. It also features one-click access with dedicated Netflix and Prime Video buttons. You can use voice commands to control other smart devices in your home as well. item.g:title: ASROCK B850 RIPTIDE WIFI AM5 ATX 4X DDR5
item.g:description: Dominate the battlefield with the ASRock B850 Riptide WiFi AM5 ATX Motherboard, a high-performance solution crafted for gamers who demand power, precision, and stability. Inspired by the force of ocean riptides, this board combines calm efficiency with relentless strength, designed to deliver next-gen computing with stunning overclocking capabilities and immersive visuals. Powered by the AMD B850 chipset, this ATX motherboard supports AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors on the AM5 socket, providing a future-ready platform for gamers and creators alike. The 8-layer PCB ensures efficient power delivery, signal stability, and better heat dissipation—ideal for those pushing their systems with DDR5 memory up to an impressive 8000+ MHz (OC), backed by support for both XMP and EXPO memory profiles. The 14+2+1 phase power design with 80A Dr.MOS VCore+SOC phases guarantees stable overclocking and power efficiency under intense workloads. For storage, unleash ultra-fast performance with 1x Blazing M.2 PCIe Gen5x4 and 3x Hyper M.2 Gen4x4 slots, alongside 4 SATA3 ports for legacy drives. And when speed matters, the onboard Killer 2.5G LAN and next-gen Wi-Fi 7 with Bluetooth 5.4 provide seamless wired and wireless connectivity for low-latency gaming and streaming. With rich expandability including PCIe 5.0 x16 and PCIe 4.0 x16 slots, the Riptide allows for powerful GPU support. The board's USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C, multiple USB 3.2 Gen2/Gen1, and eight USB 2.0 ports deliver blazing-fast data transfer and peripheral compatibility. HDMI 2.1 supports up to 4K@120Hz, perfect for modern gaming displays. Audio is powered by the Realtek ALC4082 7.1 CH HD codec with Nahimic Audio, offering immersive surround sound with 600-ohm headphone amp support for crystal-clear audio in games or content creation. Built with gamers in mind, the ASRock B850 Riptide features extensive ARGB/RGB headers and is Polychrome RGB Sync certified, ready for full system lighting synchronization. It also supports SignalRGB for unified control across devices and reactive lighting effects. item.g:title: ASRock B850 Pro RS Wi-Fi ATX Motherboard (AMD AM5, DDR5, PCIe 5.0)
item.g:description: Meet the ASRock B850 Pro RS Wi-Fi Motherboard—a no-compromise platform engineered for next-generation AMD performance, precision tuning, and seamless connectivity. Built on the robust AMD B850 chipset, this ATX motherboard is tailor-made for Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, delivering exceptional compatibility and headroom for creators, gamers, and power users alike. From the moment you power up, the ASRock B850 Pro RS Wi-Fi Motherboard asserts its prowess with a fortified 14+2+1 phase power design featuring 80A Dr.MOS and an 8-layer PCB that promotes thermal efficiency and rock-solid voltage delivery. Whether you're pushing memory to 8000+ MHz or fine-tuning every watt, this board is primed for precision overclocking and long-haul durability. Connectivity is where this board truly shines. It offers one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot reinforced with steel, complemented by support for blazing-fast Gen5 and Gen4 M.2 storage. You get up to four M.2 slots and four SATA3 ports, optimised for high-speed NVMe boot drives and bulk storage alike. A 2.5G Realtek Dragon LAN ensures lightning-fast wired networking, while onboard Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.2 futureproofs your wireless experience—just make sure you're running Windows 11 to unlock the full 6GHz spectrum. The ASRock B850 Pro RS Wi-Fi Motherboard is also a DIYer’s dream. Features like BIOS Flashback, a flexible I/O shield, reinforced PCIe slots, and the ASRock Post Status Checker make installation and troubleshooting easier than ever. Meanwhile, SignalRGB support and Polychrome RGB headers provide customisable lighting that syncs beautifully across your build. Whether you're upgrading for gaming, content creation, or future-ready productivity, the ASRock B850 Pro RS Wi-Fi Motherboard delivers a perfect blend of high-end performance, intelligent design, and next-gen technology. It’s not just a motherboard, it’s a foundation for your next big build. item.g:title: WINX POWER Max 65W GaN Wall Charger
item.g:description: The WINX POWER Max 65W GaN Wall Charger is engineered for users who demand fast, flexible, and reliable charging across multiple devices. Built using advanced GaN (Gallium Nitride) technology, this powerful Type-C and USB charger delivers high-speed performance in an ultra-compact form - ideal for both everyday use and travel. Delivering up to 65W of total output, this 65W travel charger is capable of charging everything from smartphones and tablets to cameras and even lightweight laptops. With both Type-C and USB options, it functions as a powerful 3-port charger, allowing you to charge three devices simultaneously. Whether you're powering your phone and tablet during a business trip or keeping your camera and earbuds topped up on the go, the WINX POWER Max makes multitasking effortless. This smart Type-C and USB charger features intelligent power output that automatically adjusts to match the requirements of your connected devices. It ensures each device receives optimal charging speeds while safeguarding against overheating, overcharging, and short-circuiting. You get fast, efficient power with built-in safety - without ever needing to think twice. Compact and lightweight, this 65W travel charger is designed with mobility in mind. Thanks to GaN technology, it runs cooler and more efficiently than traditional silicon-based chargers, all while fitting easily into your backpack, tech pouch, or pocket. item.g:description: The Cudy SM220 SFP-T 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 Ethernet Module delivers dependable and high-speed wired network connections for enterprise, SMB, and advanced home networking environments. Using the SFP's RX_LOS pin for link indication, it provides reliable connectivity feedback to network administrators. The robust electrical design ensures minimal latency and consistent throughput, making it ideal for bandwidth-intensive tasks like VoIP, video conferencing, and large-scale file transfers. With an operating temperature range of 0°C to +70°C, the Cudy SM220 is suited for diverse networking environments, from climate-controlled server rooms to active office floors. Its RoHS-compliant, lead-free construction ensures eco-friendly operation, while the single +3.3V power supply simplifies integration into existing setups. Perfect for upgrading to gigabit speeds or enhancing network flexibility, this module offers a dependable and scalable solution for modern networking needs. item.g:title: FSP PRO 65W Universal Laptop Adapter – Dell
item.g:description: Keep your laptop fully charged with the FSP PRO 65W Universal Laptop Adapter. It features an output wattage of 65W and an output voltage of 19V. Ideal for Dell laptops, the power adapter comes with additional exchangeable tips for various laptop and notebook charging ports. This makes it more versatile than a traditional power adapter that only has one port for your laptop only. Its high-efficiency rating ensures you get constant and reliable power to your devices at all times. For additional safety, it features 360° safety circuit protection, which means you get over-voltage protection(OVP), short circuit protection(SCP), and over-temperature protection(OTP) which helps prevent damage during use. With all these great features the FSP PRO 65W is a great choice for anyone looking to add safe, reliable power to their laptop. This model comes with tip No.7, No.14 and No.U7 for Dell laptops only. item.g:title: ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5080 16GB OC Edition GDDR7 Graphics Card
item.g:description: Experience next-generation power and precision with the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card, expertly engineered for elite gamers and creative professionals. Built on NVIDIA’s latest architecture, this premium GPU delivers outstanding AI acceleration, exceptional thermal performance, and cutting-edge display capabilities, all housed in a compact, SFF-Ready 2.5-slot design for maximum build compatibility. Equipped with 16GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 video memory and a robust 256-bit memory interface, the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card runs at memory speeds of up to 30 Gbps. With a GPU boost clock of up to 2685 MHz in OC mode and 10752 CUDA cores, it offers uncompromising speed for 4K gaming, real-time ray tracing, and high-throughput content rendering. Supporting PCIe 5.0 and OpenGL 4.6, this card ensures optimal performance across modern platforms and software environments. AI performance is at the forefront, delivering up to 1827 TOPs, enhanced further with NVIDIA DLSS 4 and fifth-gen Tensor Cores for real-time frame generation and AI-powered graphics enhancement. The card supports a maximum digital resolution of 7680 x 4320 and accommodates up to four simultaneous displays via one native HDMI 2.1b and three DisplayPort 2.1b outputs. HDCP 2.3 support is included for protected content playback. Thermal management is handled by triple Axial-tech fans with dual-ball bearings for extended durability, backed by a vapour chamber, vented backplate, and MaxContact technology for superior heat transfer. Silent operation is achieved with 0dB technology, while Dual BIOS allows users to select between Quiet and Performance modes based on their workload. The ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card includes essential accessories such as a Velcro hook & loop, adapter cable, and Speedsetup manual. Supported by ASUS GPU Tweak III, MuseTree, and the latest Game Ready and Studio Drivers, it is an ideal choice for users who demand high-performance computing in a compact footprint. Build small. Play big. Create without limits. Choose the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card for ultimate power, reliability, and creative freedom. item.g:title: Keychron K4 HE Wireless Magnetic Switch Mechanical Keyboard (96% Layout, Gateron Hall Effect Switches)

item.g:description: Dominate every level with the Hiksemi FUTURE G3 512GB MicroSDXC Gaming Card, engineered specifically for the next generation of mobile gamers. Built to handle the intense speed and storage demands of today’s high-performance mobile games, this card ensures that lag, long load times, and stuttering gameplay become a thing of the past. With blazing-fast read speeds of up to 200MB/s and write speeds of 150MB/s, the Hiksemi FUTURE G3 512GB MicroSDXC Gaming Card dramatically reduces loading times and allows for rapid data access during gameplay. Rated U3, V30, and A2, this card is optimised to run game apps directly from the card, providing enhanced app launch speeds, fluid in-game transitions, and improved system responsiveness. This is particularly critical for gamers using Android smartphones, tablets, or portable gaming consoles who require top-tier performance under pressure. With 128GB of high-speed storage, gamers can download, install, and update multiple large game titles without worrying about running out of space. The card utilises reliable TLC NAND flash memory and is built to operate in extreme temperatures, ranging from 0°C to 70°C, with storage durability down to -40°C—ideal for South Africa’s varied environments. The Hiksemi FUTURE G3 512GB MicroSDXC Gaming Card is also fully compatible with a wide range of MicroSDXC-enabled devices, including smartphones, handheld consoles, drones, and action cameras, offering versatility beyond gaming. If you’re a mobile gamer looking for elite-level speed, superior stability, and ample storage in a compact form factor, the Hiksemi FUTURE G3 512GB MicroSDXC Gaming Card is your go-to upgrade. This MicroSDXC card is perfect for shooting high-quality images and 4K Ultra HD video recording, ensuring your footage is smooth and uninterrupted. Featuring ultra-fast read speeds of up to 180MB/s and write speeds of up to 150MB/s, the HIKSEMI Capture V30 512GB MicroSDXC Card accelerates file transfers and post-production workflows. From capturing fast-action sequences to transferring large media files, the card’s speed class ratings of Class 10, U3, and V30 guarantee optimal performance across a wide range of professional applications. Built with advanced TLC NAND flash memory, this card ensures data integrity and longevity. With a capacity of 512GB, it offers ample storage for extended shoots, high-bitrate video footage, and large image libraries—all in a compact micro form factor. The HIKSEMI Capture V30 512GB MicroSDXC Card is highly compatible with a variety of host devices, including MicroSDHC, MicroSDXC, MicroSDHC UHS-I, and MicroSDXC UHS-I systems. Its durable construction is waterproof, shockproof, X-ray proof, and resistant to both high and low temperatures, making it ideal for extreme shooting environments. Measuring just 1.49 x 1.09 x 0.1 cm, the card is designed to be lightweight and portable without compromising on performance. It operates reliably within a temperature range of -10°C to 70°C and can be safely stored in environments from -25°C to 80°C. For professionals who demand both reliability and speed, the HIKSEMI Capture V30 512GB MicroSDXC Card is the optimal choice to enhance workflow and safeguard valuable content. item.g:title: Asus Cobble M.2 SSD Enclosure - Grey
item.g:description: The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure combines style and performance in a sleek, cobble-stone-inspired design. Its durable aluminium-alloy top cover offers robust protection, while IP55 water and dust resistance ensures data stays safe when on the go. A USB Type-C® 3.2 Gen 2x1 connection enables superfast and reliable transfer speeds of up to 10 Gbps, while maintaining consistent data performance. An aluminium-alloy top cover and an internal thermal pad ensure efficient heat dissipation to help extend the lifespan of the SSD. Overall, the lightweight and portable ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is the perfect solution for fast, on-the-go storage for PCs, mobile devices, and gaming consoles. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure design allows for screw-free installations and can accommodate both SATA and NVMe M.2 SSDs, making it easy to repurpose older storage drives. The nature-inspired, cobble-stone-shaped design of ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure gives it sleek, rounded curves that give users a comfortable grip. The soft tones and speckled finishes bring a touch of nature into the tech world, making it the perfect blend of style, practicality, and innovation. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is ideal for those looking for a highly customizable, compact external SSD storage solution with optimal performance and sleek aesthetics. This versatile enclosure is compatible with a wide range of SSDs to meet specific needs. Lightweight and durable, the ASUS Cobble offers on-the-go professionals and photographers a reliable and stylish way to safeguard creative projects, precious memories, and critical files, even while on the go. The ASUS Cobble SSD Enclosure seamlessly blends aesthetics with high performance. It features robust internal and external protection mechanisms, ensuring uninterrupted data transfers even in the face of everyday spills, dust, and temperature fluctuations. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure supports up to 4TB of storage, providing space for approximately 80 4K movies, 200,000 photos, 800,000 files, 1,777 hours of FHD videos, or 40 AAA games. ASUS Cobble is treated with a special coating that safeguards the enclosure and the SSD from minor impacts. The speckled paint finish on the robust metallic chassis makes it scratch-proof and able to resist high temperatures. The built-in thermal pad keeps the SSD cool even under heavy loads, preventing overheating and ensuring lasting performance. The ASUS Cobble is IP55-rated, offering adequate protection against dust and water. The innovative Q-Latch, together with a simple locking mechanism, secure the drive, making it easy to install or remove an M.2 SSD without the need for tools or screws. ASUS Cobble is compatible with both PCIe NVMe and SATA interfaces, and can accommodate 2242, 2260, and 2280 form factor SSDs. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure offers comprehensive compatibility with Windows 11, macOS, mobile devices, and the latest gaming consoles. Built with Asus Auto-Extreme Technology, this graphics card is manufactured in a fully automated process to ensure consistent quality and enhanced durability. The 100% solid capacitors offer improved reliability, thermal efficiency, and lifespan—key considerations for long-term gaming builds. Additionally, its passive cooling system ensures completely silent operation, making it ideal for noise-sensitive environments or stealth gaming setups. The Asus GT730 2GB GDDR5 low-profile graphics card is compatible with a wide range of systems thanks to its compact size and energy-efficient design. It doesn’t require external power connectors, making it perfect for upgrading OEM or pre-built PCs where PSU capacity may be limited. If you're looking for a reliable, quiet, and space-saving GPU solution for light gaming or multimedia use, the Asus GT730 2GB GDDR5 graphics card is a strategic addition to your build. Built with M-DISC support, the ASUS external DVD writer ensures your data is preserved for generations, with archival-grade storage designed to last 1,000 years or more. The intuitive Drag-and-Burn interface allows you to complete disc burning in just three simple steps, streamlining workflows for users at all skill levels. With write speeds of up to 24X for CD-R and 8X for DVD formats, and bundled software including Nero BackItUp, CyberLink PowerBackup, and Power2Go, the ASUS external DVD writer meets the demands of high-throughput environments. Compact and lightweight at just 250g, and measuring only 14.2 x 14.2 x 2 cm, the ASUS external DVD writer is the perfect solution for on-the-go data handling, whether at the office, in the studio, or on site. item.g:title: Asus A31 PLUS Mid Tower ATX Chassis - White
item.g:description: Build the setup you’ve always imagined with the ASUS A31 PLUS Mid Tower, a case designed to match your ambition. Whether you're upgrading or starting from scratch, this chassis gives you the performance headroom, visual impact, and build flexibility to bring your desktop gaming rig to life. You’ll enjoy wide motherboard support, including ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX, and BTF compatibility, giving you the freedom to build with future-ready components. The ASUS A31 PLUS Mid Tower doesn’t just house your hardware – it showcases it. With 4 mm tempered glass panels on both the front and left sides, your RGB lighting, clean cable runs, and premium components are always on full display. Out of the box, you get four pre-installed ARGB 120 mm fans – three mounted on the side and one at the rear – delivering strong airflow and stunning lighting without the need for additional upgrades. Cooling flexibility is extensive, with support for up to three 12 mm or two 140 mm fans on the top, and space for a 140 mm or 120 mm fan at the rear. Radiator support includes 360 mm, 280 mm, 240 mm, 140 mm, and 120 mm options on the top, plus a 120 mm radiator at the rear. Internally, there’s space to support high-performance components, including graphics cards up to 380 mm in length, CPU air coolers up to 165 mm in height, and power supplies up to 200 mm long. Two combo drive bays accommodate either 2.5" SSDs or 3.5" HDDs, giving you storage flexibility without sacrificing space. Seven expansion slots ensure full upgrade capability, whether you're adding capture cards, GPUs or high-speed networking. The front I/O is built for speed and convenience, featuring one USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C port, two USB 3.2 Gen1 ports, and a 3.5 mm combined headphone/microphone jack. With 34 mm of cable management space and removable dust filters at the top and bottom, you’ll find it easy to keep things clean and efficient over the long run. Measuring 23.8 x 51.1 x 43.5 cm and weighing 9100 g, the ASUS A31 PLUS Mid Tower strikes the perfect balance between size, durability and airflow — giving you a solid foundation to build a high-performance gaming PC you can be proud of. item.g:title: Asus ROG Ryujin III ARGB AIO Liquid Cooler - 3.5" LCD Display
item.g:description: The Asus ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB AIO Liquid CPU Cooler is engineered to redefine thermal performance and visual immersion for high-performance gaming builds and professional systems. Built with premium components and advanced cooling innovations, the Asus ROG Ryujin III Liquid Cooler delivers superior heat dissipation and unmatched personalisation. At the heart of the cooler is the latest 8th-generation Asetek pump, driven by a 3-phase motor that delivers high flow rates with reduced impedance and minimal operational noise. This ensures reliable thermal control even under heavy CPU loads. Enhancing the cooling architecture further is an embedded fan with a new ring-shaped frame and optimised airflow channels, specifically designed to target the VRM area for enhanced motherboard longevity. The cooler features a robust 399.5 mm aluminium radiator paired with three 120 mm ROG magnetic daisy-chainable ARGB fans. Each fan operates between 600 to 2200 RPM, delivering up to 70.07 CFM of airflow with a static pressure of 3.88 mmH₂O. These fans are equipped with Gen 2 ARGB LEDs, enabling dynamic lighting effects that can be fully customised through Armoury Crate. A standout feature of the ASUS ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB AIO Liquid CPU Cooler is its integrated 3.5-inch full-colour LCD screen. With double the storage of previous iterations, users can showcase system stats, custom animations, or logos directly on the CPU block. The display, fans, and pump can all be finely tuned via Armoury Crate for complete control and synchronisation. Supporting the latest AMD AM5/AM4 and Intel LGA 1851/1700/1200/115x sockets, this cooler is future-ready and highly versatile. It also includes a free one-year AIDA64 Extreme license for advanced system monitoring. item.g:title: Asus Cobble M.2 SSD Enclosure - Black
item.g:description: The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure combines style and performance in a sleek, cobble-stone-inspired design. Its durable aluminium-alloy top cover offers robust protection, while IP55 water and dust resistance ensures data stays safe when on the go. A USB Type-C® 3.2 Gen 2x1 connection enables superfast and reliable transfer speeds of up to 10 Gbps, while maintaining consistent data performance. An aluminium-alloy top cover and an internal thermal pad ensure efficient heat dissipation to help extend the lifespan of the SSD. Overall, the lightweight and portable ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is the perfect solution for fast, on-the-go storage for PCs, mobile devices, and gaming consoles. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure design allows for screw-free installations and can accommodate both SATA and NVMe M.2 SSDs, making it easy to repurpose older storage drives. The nature-inspired, cobble-stone-shaped design of ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure gives it sleek, rounded curves that give users a comfortable grip. The soft tones and speckled finishes bring a touch of nature into the tech world, making it the perfect blend of style, practicality, and innovation. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is ideal for those looking for a highly customizable, compact external SSD storage solution with optimal performance and sleek aesthetics. This versatile enclosure is compatible with a wide range of SSDs to meet specific needs. Lightweight and durable, the ASUS Cobble offers on-the-go professionals and photographers a reliable and stylish way to safeguard creative projects, precious memories, and critical files, even while on the go. The ASUS Cobble SSD Enclosure seamlessly blends aesthetics with high performance. It features robust internal and external protection mechanisms, ensuring uninterrupted data transfers even in the face of everyday spills, dust, and temperature fluctuations. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure supports up to 4TB of storage, providing space for approximately 80 4K movies, 200,000 photos, 800,000 files, 1,777 hours of FHD videos, or 40 AAA games. ASUS Cobble is treated with a special coating that safeguards the enclosure and the SSD from minor impacts. The speckled paint finish on the robust metallic chassis makes it scratch-proof and able to resist high temperatures. The built-in thermal pad keeps the SSD cool even under heavy loads, preventing overheating and ensuring lasting performance. The ASUS Cobble is IP55-rated, offering adequate protection against dust and water. The innovative Q-Latch, together with a simple locking mechanism, secure the drive, making it easy to install or remove an M.2 SSD without the need for tools or screws. ASUS Cobble is compatible with both PCIe NVMe and SATA interfaces, and can accommodate 2242, 2260, and 2280 form factor SSDs. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure offers comprehensive compatibility with Windows 11, macOS, mobile devices, and the latest gaming consoles. item.g:description: Engineered for uncompromising performance and seamless integration with next-gen hardware, the Asus ROG Strix B760-F Gaming WiFi motherboard is the ideal foundation for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts. Powered by the Intel B760 chipset and compatible with 12th, 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors, it supports the LGA1700 socket and unleashes the full potential of Intel’s hybrid architecture. With support for up to 128GB of ultra-fast DDR5 memory across four DIMM slots, the Asus ROG Strix B760-F Gaming Motherboard ensures accelerated multitasking, faster data handling, and superior bandwidth. PCIe 5.0 x16 graphics support offers next-level performance for the latest GPUs, while three M.2 slots with PCIe 4.0 deliver rapid storage with reduced latency and higher throughput. WiFi 6E and Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet provide ultra-reliable, low-latency networking for competitive online gaming and streaming. Enhanced cooling is assured via large VRM heatsinks, hybrid fan headers, and M.2 heatsinks that maintain system stability during high-load operations. Advanced connectivity includes rear USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C®, front USB Type-C®, and HDMI® 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 outputs for modern displays. The ROG Strix B760-F Gaming also incorporates intuitive features like Q-LED diagnostic indicators, BIOS FlashBack™, and a pre-mounted I/O shield for streamlined assembly and maintenance. Designed with bold cyberpunk-inspired styling, premium components, and Aura Sync RGB lighting, the Asus ROG Strix B760-F Gaming delivers a visually immersive and technically advanced platform for next-gen PC builds. item.g:title: Asus ROG Crosshair X870E HERO ATX Gaming Motherboard
item.g:description: Unleash the full potential of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors with the ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E HERO ATX Gaming Motherboard—a platform built for high-end overclocking, AI-enhanced performance, and future-proof connectivity. This AI PC-ready motherboard boasts an advanced 18+2+2 power stage design, featuring 110A-rated power stages and reinforced thermal solutions to ensure clean, stable power delivery under the most demanding workloads. Its signature Polymo Lighting II I/O shroud adds dynamic RGB brilliance to your rig, delivering not only elite performance but also unmistakable ROG style. With Dynamic OC Switcher, users can seamlessly toggle between Precision Boost Overdrive and manual overclocks based on workload intensity, while Overclocking Load Guard prevents instability during extreme performance pushes. The Crosshair X870E HERO takes memory tuning further with support for DDR5 speeds up to 8600+ MT/s (OC), NitroPath DRAM Technology, and ASUS-exclusive Enhanced Memory Profile (AEMP) for PMIC-restricted DIMMs. DIMM Fit further ensures compatibility and stability by analyzing module characteristics for optimal configuration—making it ideal for overclockers, gamers, and creative professionals alike. Built for speed, the motherboard offers five M.2 slots, including PCIe 5.0 support for next-gen NVMe SSDs, and dual PCIe 5.0 x16 slots for powerful GPU configurations. It features Wi-Fi 7, Realtek 5Gb and 2.5Gb Ethernet, and dual USB4® Type-C® (40Gbps) ports for ultrafast data transfers, along with front USB Type-C® with 60W Power Delivery for high-speed charging and device support. These high-performance specs are complemented by seamless Thunderbolt™ 4 video output, giving users the ability to connect external 8K displays or ultra-fast storage drives without compromise. Thermal management is finely tuned with expansive VRM heatsinks, hybrid fan headers, and AI Cooling II, which intelligently balances noise and thermals with a single click. DIY builders will appreciate ASUS Q-Design for simplified assembly and error-free installation. Sync your RGB components using Aura Sync to achieve a cohesive visual setup, and enjoy pristine audio with ESS® ES9219 QUAD DAC and SupremeFX Shielding Technology. Whether you're chasing competitive edge, professional-grade production, or cutting-edge AI performance, the ROG Crosshair X870E HERO delivers unrivaled control and power for next-gen PC builds. item.g:title: Asus PRIME B840M-A WIFI M-ATX Gaming Motherboard
item.g:description: Designed to fully leverage the power of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, the ASUS PRIME B840M-A WIFI motherboard is an advanced, feature-rich platform built for DIY builders, gamers, and creative professionals alike. It’s expertly engineered with ASUS' AI Advisor and Advanced AI PC-ready architecture, making it ideal for handling heavy workloads and next-gen AI applications. The board’s robust 8+2+1 power phase design with discrete MOSFETs ensures smooth and efficient power delivery, enabling stable performance across demanding tasks. The PRIME B840M-A WIFI supports up to 256GB of blazing-fast DDR5 memory with speeds up to 7600+MT/s (OC), along with ASUS AEMP and AMD EXPO™ profiles for streamlined overclocking. Comprehensive memory tuning tools are embedded within the UEFI BIOS, giving both newcomers and veterans the flexibility to fine-tune for performance or efficiency. Storage options are future-ready with three M.2 slots—two PCIe 4.0 and one PCIe 3.0—allowing faster boot times, lightning-quick application launches, and expansive SSD capacity. Q-Design innovations such as Q-Antenna and Q-LED Core make system assembly and troubleshooting quick and intuitive. Stay ahead of the curve with cutting-edge connectivity options, including integrated Wi-Fi 6E, Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet, and USB 10Gbps Type-A and 5Gbps Type-C® ports for high-speed data transfer and reduced latency. Onboard HDMI, dual DisplayPort, and Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound offer seamless multimedia integration for gaming, streaming, and content creation. The motherboard’s thermal design includes a VRM heatsink, passive chipset heatsink, hybrid fan headers, and AiO pump support, ensuring optimal cooling even during peak performance sessions. Compact in size but packed with features, the ASUS PRIME B840M-A WIFI M-ATX motherboard is built to make your build stand out—both inside and out. Onboard Aura Sync-compatible RGB headers support Gen 2 addressable devices, giving you full control of system lighting via ASUS’ intuitive software suite. Whether you're customizing airflow, syncing RGB effects, or pushing your system to the limit, this motherboard offers a balance of premium performance, simplified DIY experience, and future-forward connectivity—all wrapped in a sleek, modern form factor ready for Windows® 11. item.g:title: Asus GeForce® GT 1030 2GB GDDR5 Low Profile Graphics Card
item.g:description: The Asus GeForce® GT 1030 2GB GDDR5 Low Profile Graphics Card delivers an ideal balance of power, performance, and compact design, making it the perfect choice for space-constrained builds. Whether you're enhancing your desktop setup for general use or looking to boost casual gaming and multimedia experiences, this graphics card provides reliable, efficient performance without overwhelming your system. Optimised for compact chassis, this single-slot, low-profile card ensures that your build remains sleek and functional while offering impressive visual output. The Asus GT 1030 is powered by the NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 GPU and built on the NVIDIA Pascal architecture, providing a substantial boost in performance compared to previous generations. Featuring 2GB of GDDR5 memory and a 6008 MHz memory clock, it ensures smooth handling of everyday tasks and light gaming. Equipped with Auto-Extreme Technology, the card guarantees high-quality components through a fully automated production process, ensuring long-lasting durability and minimal risk of failure, even in demanding environments. The Super Alloy Power II technology further enhances efficiency by reducing power loss, lowering temperatures, and minimising electrical buzzing, improving overall reliability. For users looking to fine-tune their performance, the GPU Tweak II software offers a redesigned UI with an easy-to-use interface for overclocking. The Gaming Booster function allows for instant performance optimisation with just one click, boosting your system’s potential by disabling unnecessary processes and optimising memory without closing applications. This graphics card is perfect for users who require dependable, space-saving solutions for multi-monitor setups, supporting resolutions up to 7680 x 4320 across two monitors. With its 1x HDMI 2.0b and 1x DisplayPort 1.4, it provides versatile display connectivity. The Asus GT 1030 is well-suited for budget-conscious gamers, content creators, and general users who value versatility, efficiency, and smooth, high-resolution visual output. item.g:description: Built to endure and engineered for performance, the Asus TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5080 delivers next-generation graphics power for serious gamers and creators. Designed by ASUS and reinforced with military-grade durability, this overclocked edition graphics card harnesses the latest NVIDIA Blackwell architecture to deliver remarkable efficiency and stunning realism in every frame.
