With support for NVIDIA Reflex 2 and G-SYNC, it’s built to accelerate workflows, enhance visuals, and maximise in-game responsiveness. item.g:title: Port Connect Bluetooth Wireless and Rechargeable Executive Mouse - Black
item.g:description: The Port Connect Bluetooth Wireless & Rechargeable Executive Mouse is designed for professionals who demand both performance and versatility in their workflow. Offering dual connectivity via Bluetooth® and 2.4GHz wireless technology, this premium mouse ensures a reliable, lag-free connection across multiple devices. A built-in selector allows you to connect and switch between three devices effortlessly, while the included USB-A and USB Type-C connectivity options guarantee compatibility with laptops, desktops, tablets, and more. Whether you’re at the office, at home, or on the go, this mouse adapts seamlessly to your needs. Engineered for optimum control, the Port Connect Executive Mouse features five adjustable speed levels ranging from 800 to 3200 DPI, allowing you to fine-tune cursor sensitivity for different tasks, from precision design work to fast-paced navigation. Its ergonomic and lightweight design reduces wrist strain during extended use, while the dual scroll wheel system—including a side wheel—maximizes productivity for multitaskers, creatives, and spreadsheet power users. With WPA3 encryption, your wireless communications stay protected against data breaches and unauthorised access. Manage your network anytime, anywhere with the Cudy App, which offers both cloud-based and local control options. Monitor system activity, adjust settings, or troubleshoot remotely with ease. Designed with practical physical features like WPS and reset buttons, signal strength LEDs, and low 8W power consumption, the LT300 balances performance, security, and convenience in one streamlined unit. Certified by FCC and CE, it’s built for reliability across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. item.g:description: The UGREEN RJ45 Splitter Adapter is a practical networking solution designed to optimise cable management and connectivity. Ideal for home, office, or industrial use, this adapter allows a single network cable to be physically split into two, enabling two devices to share a single Ethernet connection. It is particularly useful in environments with limited network ports or when additional wiring is impractical. Built for 100Mbps LAN cables, this ethernet splitter ensures a stable and reliable wired connection for devices such as PCs, laptops, routers, and switches. When used individually, it functions as a network cable extender—but when used in pairs, it effectively splits one Ethernet cable into two functional connections. Constructed with a high-quality ABS casing, the adapter is both durable and lightweight, making it easy to carry and install. The metal shield protection structure enhances signal integrity while minimising interference, ensuring smooth data transmission. Compact and efficient, the UGREEN RJ45 Splitter Adapter provides a cost-effective networking solution for users looking to extend or optimise their Ethernet setup. item.g:title: Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier
item.g:description: Cleaner air, calmer pets, healthier homes | Smart odour and allergen control for pet owners | Ideal for small-to-medium spaces, multi-pet households, and allergy-sensitive environments The Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier redefines indoor air quality for homes with pets. Engineered with animal comfort and owner well-being in mind, this intelligent purifier merges pet-safe innovation with Xiaomi’s trusted air filtration technology. From fur and dander to odours and allergens, it actively targets airborne pollutants to create a fresher, cleaner environment, optimised for the unique needs of pet owners, children, and allergy-sensitive individuals. At its core is a triple-layer composite filtration system, combining a primary filter, a high-efficiency Xiaomi filter, and a specialised activated carbon layer. This intelligent filtration suite effectively captures and neutralises pet hair, dander, fine particles, and odours, ensuring a consistently breathable environment. With CADR ratings of 230m³/h (particles) and 237.4m³/h (pollen), it offers high-volume purification for spaces between 16m² and 27m² — ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, or home offices. Smart functionality underpins the purifier’s performance. Its Automatic Anti-Stress Algorithm ensures that airflow adjustments happen gradually, minimising noise and avoiding sudden changes that could startle pets. A laser particle sensor provides real-time monitoring of airborne particulates, with a large LED display offering at-a-glance pollution level updates. When it’s time to rest, Sleep Mode dims the display for uninterrupted sleep while maintaining continuous purification in near-silent operation. Certified by SGS and tested by ITS, the Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier is verified safe for pets and humans alike. The pet safety lock prevents accidental activation, while the one-step bottom-pull design simplifies filter replacement. All core functions — from speed adjustments to remote scheduling — can be controlled via the Xiaomi Home App or compatible voice assistants, integrating seamlessly into any smart home ecosystem. Whether you're combating daily pet shedding, reducing allergy triggers, or simply elevating air quality, the Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier delivers quiet, efficient, and intelligent performance — day in and day out. item.g:title: Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000 (Integrated Cable) - Blue
item.g:description: The Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000 (Integrated Cable) redefines portable charging with a streamlined, all-in-one design tailored for fast, on-the-go power delivery. Engineered with dual 5000mAh lithium-ion cells, this high-capacity 10,000mAh power bank supports up to 33W fast charging, ideal for smartphones, tablets, handheld consoles, and other USB-powered devices. At the core of its design is an integrated Type-C cable that doubles as a retractable lanyard, eliminating the need for extra accessories while enhancing portability. Whether commuting, travelling, or working remotely, users benefit from fast, reliable energy replenishment without compromise. Supporting a broad range of charging protocols—including PD 3.0, QC 3.0, and Apple 2.4—the Xiaomi 33W Power Bank ensures compatibility across Android, iOS, and other platforms. With the ability to charge up to three devices at once via the Type-C cable, Type-C port, and USB-A port, it’s a versatile solution for modern, multi-device lifestyles. Engineered with an intelligent identification chip, the power bank automatically adapts voltage and current to each connected device for optimal charging performance. Fast recharge functionality allows the unit itself to be fully recharged at up to 30W via Type-C input, significantly reducing downtime. Housed in a compact form factor—roughly the size of a makeup compact—the unit slips easily into a pocket or bag. Backed by comprehensive safety protocols, including temperature and overvoltage protections, the Xiaomi 33W Power Bank is as safe as it is convenient. Designed for high-efficiency performance, mobility, and multi-device utility, this is the ultimate portable charging companion for professionals, students, and tech enthusiasts alike. Boasting a multi-stage filtration system, this kit captures particles as small as 0.3μm with up to 99.9% filtration efficiency, ensuring that your home remains free of dust, allergens, and fine particles. The included hall magnetic linear pedal set delivers superior responsiveness by detecting precise pressure variations for lifelike throttle, brake, and clutch input. With plug-and-play USB connectivity, the PXN V9 Gen 2 is compatible with a wide range of platforms (refer to supported systems), ensuring seamless integration with your favorite racing titles across PC and consoles. item.g:title: Giada DN24 Raspberry Pi Compact Signage Player - CM4 Lite

item.g:title: Asus TUF B850 Gaming Plus WI-FI AM5 ATX Motherboard
item.g:description: ASUS TUF GAMING B850-PLUS WIFI takes all the essential elements of the latest AMD Ryzen™ processors and combines them with game-ready features and proven durability. Engineered with military-grade components, an upgraded power solution and a comprehensive cooling system, this motherboard goes beyond expectations with rock-solid and stable performance for marathon gaming. TUF GAMING motherboards also undergo rigorous endurance testing to ensure that they can handle conditions where others may fail. This platform delivers the power and connectivity that advanced AI PC applications demand. Stable power is crucial for maximizing the performance of AMD processors. The motherboard is designed to meet the needs of high-core-count CPUs. It features 14(80A) + 2(80A) + 1(80A) power stages that integrate high-side and low-side MOSFETs and drivers into packages rated for up to 80A each. This configuration ensures optimal power delivery, efficiency, stability and performance for both current and future AMD processors. For those who want to fly past stock DDR5 speeds, this motherboard is primed and ready for enthusiast-grade kits, courtesy of vast AMD Extended Profiles for Overclocking (EXPO™) support. Seasoned veterans can further tweak performance via an extensive array of settings in the UEFI. Comprehensive memory tuning options are the cornerstone of TUF GAMING motherboards. With the motherboard, you can extract all the potential out of your DDR5 modules, whether they're from an extreme-speed kit or an entry-level set that would otherwise be locked. ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile (AEMP) is an exclusive firmware feature for PMIC-restricted memory modules. AEMP automatically detects the memory chips on your kit and then presents optimized frequency, timing and voltage profiles that you can quickly apply. This motherboard also features one PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot to enjoy the fastest data transfers of up to 128Gbps, and all M.2 slots support NVMe RAID configurations to take advantage of the latest available speeds. This motherboard offers a versatile range of connectivity with PCIe 5.0, rear USB 20Gbps Type-C® port, front USB 10Gbps Type-C® connector and Thunderbolt™ (USB4®) header support. Extensive USB support ensures connections to a wide array of external devices. This motherboard includes a USB 20Gbps Type-C® port on the rear I/O panel that delivers transfer speeds of up to 20Gbps. This motherboard features a USB 10Gbps Type-C® front panel connector for speedy data transfers of up to 10Gbps. FEATURES: Supports AMD Ryzen™ 8000/7000/9000 Series Desktop Processors Support for DDR5 up to 8000+MT/s, AEMP PCIe 5.0 support for graphics cards Rear USB 20Gbps Type-C and front USB 10Gbps Type-C support Wi-Fi 7 with Asus Wi-Fi Q-Antenna and 2.5Gb Ethernet for faster data transfer PCIe Slot Q-release, Q-Antenna, M.2 Q-Latch, Q-LED and BIOS Flashback buttons for convenience Pre-mounted I/O shield to protect your ports Full RGB lighting control with Asus Aura Sync support ATX Form Factor SPECIFICATIONS: Socket: AMD Socket AM5 CPU: Supports AMD Ryzen™ 8000/7000/9000 Series Desktop Processors Chipset: AMD B850 DDR5 Memory: Support DDR5 8000+MT/s, ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile (AEMP) supported Memory Channel: Dual DIMM Slots: 4 Max Memory (GB): 256 PCI-E 5.0 x16: 1 PCI-E 4.0 x16: 1 PCI-E 4.0 x1: 2 SATA 6G: 4 M.2 Slot: 3 RAID: 0/1 (8000 Series CPU), 0/1/10 (7000 Series CPU), 0/1/5/10 (9000 Series CPU) LAN: Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet, TUF LANGuard Wi-Fi and Bluetooth: 2x2 Wi-Fi 7 USB Ports Rear: 1 x USB 20Gbps port (1 x USB Type-C®) 3 x USB 10Gbps ports (3 x Type-A) 4 x USB 5Gbps ports (4 x Type-A) 2 x USB 2.0 ports (2 x Type-A) USB Ports Front: 1 x USB 10Gbps connector (supports USB Type-C®) 1 x USB 5Gbps header supports 2 additional USB 5Gbps ports 2 x USB 2.0 headers support 4 additional USB 2.0 ports * USB Type-C® power delivery output: max. 5V/3A Audio ports (Rear): Realtek ALC1220P 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio CODEC HDMI: 1 DisplayPort: 1 DirectX: 12 Form Factor: ATX Operating System: Support for Windows® 10 64-bit/11 64-bit WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Asus TUF B850 Gaming Plus WIFI ATX Motherboard - Black x1 SATA 6Gb/s Cables x2 Asus Wi-Fi Q-Antenna x1 M.2 Rubber Packages x2 Quick Start Guide x1

item.g:title: UGREEN 2.5'' SATA Hard Drive USB 3.0 Enclosure, UASP, 6Gbps
item.g:description: Got an old laptop hard drive lying around? Or need an easy way to back up important files? The UGREEN USB 3.0 to 2.5'' SATA Hard Drive Enclosure lets you repurpose your 2.5" HDD or SSD as a portable external drive. Simply pop in your drive, connect it to your computer, and enjoy fast, reliable storage. With support for SATA III and UASP technology, this enclosure delivers transfer speeds of up to 6Gbps—up to 70% faster than standard USB 3.0. That means quicker file transfers, smoother backups, and better overall performance. It works with 7mm and 9.5mm 2.5" SATA drives up to 10TB, including popular models from WD, Seagate, Samsung, Kingston, and more. No tools? No problem. The tool-free design lets you install or swap drives in seconds. Plus, it’s lightweight and compact, so you can take your files with you wherever you go. Whether you’re upgrading storage, backing up data, or recovering files, this enclosure makes the process simple and stress-free. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, it’s a plug-and-play solution for anyone who needs extra storage on the go. item.g:title: UGREEN NW102 Cat6 U/UTP Flat Ethernet Cable 5m - Black
item.g:description: The UGREEN NW102 Cat6 U/UTP Flat Ethernet Cable is designed for fast and stable wired internet connections, making it an ideal solution for home and office networks, gaming setups, and professional environments. Delivering speeds of up to 1000 Mbps (1 Gbps) with a 250MHz bandwidth, this UGREEN NW102 Cat6 cable ensures smooth data transfer for activities such as high-definition video streaming, online gaming, cloud computing, and business communications. Built with 32AWG copper-clad aluminium conductors, the cable offers low interference and minimal signal loss, maintaining a reliable connection for your devices. The RJ45 connectors are precision-moulded for durability, while the unshielded twisted pairs (UTP) design helps reduce crosstalk and electromagnetic interference. A snag-less moulding makes installation easy, preventing tangles and damage when routing through tight spaces. Whether you are linking computers via a network switch, connecting to a router, or setting up a gaming console, the UGREEN NW102 Flat Ethernet Cable provides a secure, high-speed connection for uninterrupted performance. Designed to be versatile, durable, and efficient, it is an essential networking accessory for any modern digital setup. FEATURES: High-speed 1000Mbps connectivity 250MHz stable signal transmission Durable and secure pure copper-plated RJ45 connectors Uses 4PR UTP interference resistance Secure connection with 586B wiring standard Universal compatibility with all RJ45-equipped devices SPECIFICATIONS: Connection Type: RJ45 Cable Type: UTP Cat6 Conductor: 32AWG Copper-Clad Aluminium Outer Diameter (OD): 6mm Connector: Pure Copper Gold-Plated Connection Method: 586B Ethernet Speed: 1000Mbps Channel Bandwidth: 250MHz Stranding Method: 8-core twisted pair Interference Protection: 4PR UTP Copper Strands Colour: Black Compatibility: PCs, laptops, printers, modems, routers, and switches Cable length: 5m WHAT’S IN THE BOX: UGREEN NW102 Cat6 U/UTP Flat Ethernet Cable 5m - Black x1

item.g:description: The UGREEN 3.5mm Aux Cable provides an exceptional audio experience, allowing you to effortlessly stream your music playlist from an aux output device (e.g., smartphone, tablet) to an aux input device (e.g., speakers, car stereo, headphones). Whether at home, in the car, or on the go, the UGREEN 3.5mm Aux Cable provides seamless connectivity and premium audio quality wherever you need it. item.g:description: Augment your workspace with the Xiaomi Desk Lamp Lite, designed for optimal eye comfort and wide-area illumination. Featuring a high colour rendering index (CRI) of Ra90, this lamp closely mimics natural light, ensuring true-to-life colours and reducing eye strain. Whether you need soft lighting for reading, focused brightness for work, or a balanced glow for relaxation, the three-level brightness adjustment allows you to customise the illumination to suit your needs. Built for versatility and convenience, the lamp offers 25° up and down adjustment and a three-shaft flexible design, enabling precise positioning to direct light exactly where you need it. When not in use, it folds compactly for easy storage. The RG0 blue light hazard exemption level and flicker-free technology help protect your vision, minimising glare and delaying eye fatigue even during extended use. With a large illumination area, this desk lamp provides uniform lighting across your workspace, preventing harsh contrasts between light and dark spots. The simple touch control makes operation effortless—just press to turn it on/off or hold to adjust brightness. Designed for home offices, study desks, and creative workspaces, the Xiaomi Desk Lamp Lite combines functionality with sleek, modern aesthetics, making it a must-have lighting solution. item.g:title: Xiaomi Wireless Mouse 3 - Blue
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Wireless Mouse 3 delivers a seamless and comfortable user experience with its ergonomic design and smooth contours. Crafted for efficiency and precision, this lightweight mouse features a refined surface texture, providing a soft, skin-friendly grip for extended use. Whether for work, study, or everyday browsing, its sleek design ensures both style and comfort. Equipped with dual-mode connectivity, the mouse supports 2.4GHz wireless and Bluetooth connections, allowing effortless pairing with up to three devices and switching between them quickly and intuitively, ensuring uninterrupted workflow across multiple platforms. The silent primary buttons offer a quiet yet tactile response, ideal for offices, libraries, and shared workspaces. The high-precision 1200DPI Pixart sensor guarantees smooth and accurate tracking, making navigation effortless. Designed for durability, the mouse features Teflon foot pads, offering exceptional wear resistance and a frictionless surface glide. With a lightweight build of just 57g (excluding batteries) and compact dimensions of 11.9 x 6.4 x 4.1 cm, the Xiaomi Wireless Mouse 3 is highly portable without compromising functionality. Powered by a single AA battery, it ensures long-lasting performance with minimal maintenance. item.g:title: Redmi Buds 6 Play
item.g:description: The Redmi Buds 6 Play combines sleek design, lightweight comfort, and powerful performance to deliver an exceptional audio experience. Weighing only 3.6g per earbud, they fit snugly in your ears without causing discomfort, making them perfect for all-day wear. The charging case features a smooth, four-sided curved design, offering a compact and elegant form factor that easily fits in your pocket or hand. With a focus on both aesthetics and ergonomics, these earbuds provide a seamless blend of style and functionality. Equipped with a finely tuned 10mm dynamic driver, the Redmi Buds 6 Play delivers rich and immersive sound. The audio has been optimized by Xiaomi Acoustic Lab to enhance clarity, depth, and bass response. For those who love personalized sound experiences, the earbuds offer five preset EQ modes, including standard, bass boost, voice enhancement, treble enhancement, and volume boost. Whether you're enjoying deep bass beats, crystal-clear vocals, or balanced audio, these earbuds cater to every preference with precision. Clear communication is guaranteed with advanced AI noise reduction technology, which effectively distinguishes human voices from background noise. This ensures that calls remain crisp and intelligible, even in noisy environments. Additionally, the latest Bluetooth® 5.4 technology provides a stable and low-latency connection, making these earbuds perfect for seamless audio streaming and gaming. With intuitive touch controls, users can easily manage playback, calls, and voice assistants without reaching for their device. Designed for endurance, the Redmi Buds 6 Play offer up to 7.5 hours of continuous playback on a single charge, extending up to an impressive 36 hours with the charging case. A quick 10-minute charge provides up to 3 hours of music playback, ensuring you’re never without your favorite tunes. With an IPX4 water-resistance rating, these earbuds can withstand sweat and splashes, making them ideal for workouts and outdoor use. Whether you're commuting, working out, or simply relaxing, the Redmi Buds 6 Play provide a premium listening experience with lasting comfort and reliability. item.g:title: MSI B760 GAMING PLUS WIFI DDR5 LGA1700 ATX Motherboard
item.g:description: The MSI B760 GAMING PLUS WIFI DDR5 ATX Motherboard is engineered for gamers and PC enthusiasts who demand top-tier performance and connectivity. Designed for Intel® Core™ 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen processors, this motherboard supports the latest DDR5 memory technology, delivering enhanced speed and efficiency. With MSI’s Memory Boost and SMT welding process, users can experience world-class memory performance, ensuring seamless multitasking and gaming. Whether you're overclocking or running high-demand applications, the B760 GAMING PLUS WIFI is built to handle it all. Heat management is a priority with this motherboard, featuring an extended heatsink design that maximizes surface area for better heat dissipation. The VRM heatsink effectively covers the upper MOS for improved thermal efficiency, while high-quality 7W/mK MOSFET thermal pads and choke thermal pads provide stability during heavy loads. To maintain peak SSD performance, the strengthened M.2 thermal solution keeps storage devices cool, ensuring lightning-fast load times and system responsiveness. Additionally, the chipset heatsink is designed to minimize dust buildup and noise while maintaining efficient cooling for the PCH. For gamers and content creators, the MSI B760 GAMING PLUS WIFI offers cutting-edge storage and connectivity options. With dual PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots featuring M.2 Shield Frozr, users can enjoy ultra-fast storage speeds that significantly reduce game load times. The inclusion of Turbo USB 3.2 Gen 2 ensures rapid data transfer, while 2.5G LAN and Intel® Wi-Fi 6E provide seamless, low-latency networking. With multiple USB ports, HDMI, and DisplayPort support, this motherboard is built to accommodate a wide range of peripherals and high-resolution displays for a next-level gaming and productivity experience. Aesthetics and customization are also at the forefront, thanks to MSI’s Mystic Light Extension pin header. This allows users to effortlessly synchronize additional RGB lighting and peripherals, enhancing their setup without needing an external RGB controller. The motherboard’s high-quality 6-layer PCB with 2oz thickened copper ensures durability and stable power delivery. Coupled with MSI’s Audio Boost technology, gamers can immerse themselves in high-fidelity, studio-grade sound for an unparalleled gaming experience. The MSI B760 GAMING PLUS WIFI is a powerhouse motherboard that brings together performance, cooling, and connectivity, making it an excellent choice for any high-performance gaming build. item.g:description: The Hiksemi T300S Shield Type-C Portable SSD is a compact yet powerful storage solution designed to expand the capacity of your Android phone, tablet, PC, or laptop. Whether you're a designer, video editor, photographer, or business professional, the T300S ensures you have reliable storage on the go. Its sleek and modern design makes it a perfect companion for individuals who need high-speed, high-capacity storage in a compact form. Its compact design makes it easy to carry, allowing you to secure important files anywhere you go. Additionally, the SSD is equipped with a blue LED indicator, providing a clear visual cue of its operational status. Designed for convenience and portability, the T300S is a dependable storage companion for any situation. Compatible with a wide range of devices, including Android smartphones and tablets via OTG data cable, as well as Windows and Mac systems, the Hiksemi T300S Shield offers versatile connectivity. Its plug-and-play functionality ensures quick setup without the need for additional drivers. Whether you're backing up important data, enhancing your gaming experience, or improving workflow efficiency, the T300S is a faster, safer, and better choice for modern storage needs. item.g:title: Cudy BE9300 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 | Bluetooth 5.4 PCIe Adapter
item.g:description: Upgrade your PC’s wireless connectivity with the Cudy BE9300 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 & Bluetooth 5.4 PCIe Adapter, delivering next-generation speeds and seamless reliability. Powered by the Intel BE200 chipset, this adapter offers blazing-fast Wi-Fi 7 speeds with up to 5760Mbps on 6GHz, 2882Mbps on 5GHz, and 688Mbps on 2.4GHz, ensuring low latency and ultra-smooth streaming, gaming, and multitasking. By leveraging Multi-Link Operation (MLO), it can aggregate multiple bands for a more stable and efficient multi-gig connection when paired with an MLO-supported router. Whether you're gaming, streaming in 4K, or handling intensive workloads, the Cudy BE9300 provides superior wireless performance with minimal interference. Beyond Wi-Fi, the integrated Bluetooth 5.4 ensures faster pairing, reduced power consumption, and improved signal reliability for all your Bluetooth devices, including keyboards, mice, headphones, and game controllers. With enhanced power efficiency, your Bluetooth peripherals benefit from longer battery life and lower latency, creating a more responsive and seamless wireless experience. This makes the Cudy BE9300 the perfect choice for users who demand both high-speed networking and stable Bluetooth connectivity in one compact package. Designed for maximum compatibility and easy installation, the Cudy BE9300 fits into any PCIe 1x, 4x, 8x, or 16x slot on your motherboard, while Bluetooth functionality requires a USB 9-Pin connector. It supports both standard tower PCs and compact Mini-ITX or HTPC builds, thanks to its included low-profile bracket. Equipped with two high-gain detachable RP-SMA antennas, this adapter ensures superior signal reception—simply adjust and position the antennas toward your router for the best possible performance. Whether you're upgrading an aging Wi-Fi card or building a cutting-edge gaming rig, this adapter ensures rock-solid connectivity in any setup. Compatible with Windows 11 (64-bit) on Intel-based PCs, the Cudy BE9300 provides a smooth and optimized wireless experience. While manual driver installation is required, setup is straightforward via Cudy’s Download Center. With its tri-band support, advanced MIMO technology, and cutting-edge Bluetooth 5.4, this PCIe adapter is an essential upgrade for users seeking top-tier wireless performance, reduced interference, and ultra-low latency networking. Whether you're an avid gamer, content creator, or power user, the Cudy BE9300 ensures future-proof connectivity with blazing speeds and exceptional reliability. item.g:title: Antec NOVA PWM 120mm Case Fan White
item.g:description: The Antec NOVA 120 PWM Fan with Speed Controller delivers exceptional cooling performance, precision control, and durability. Designed with a three-phase PWM speed controller, it offers adjustable speed modes to adapt to different hardware environments and workloads. The fan can even cease operation when the PWM signal drops below 6%, enhancing energy efficiency and reducing wear during low-demand periods. Its computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-optimized 9-blade design ensures superior airflow and cooling efficiency, while a minimized clearance between the fan frame and blades prevents backflow and boosts air pressure. At the heart of the NOVA 120 is a three-phase six-pole drive motor, engineered for optimal performance and reduced noise. This advanced motor delivers greater output power, better torque, and faster startup while minimizing electromagnetic interference and vibration. Complementing this is a strong neodymium magnet in the frame, stabilising the fan during high-speed operation to ensure smooth and steady performance. Additional features like anti-vibration rubber pads and a dustproof structure further enhance reliability, longevity, and quiet operation. Constructed from industrial-grade LCP material, the NOVA 120 combines durability with precision. Its robust design reduces resonance and improves structural rigidity, while its metal shaft ensures long-lasting stability. With a lifespan of 50,000 hours and an impressive airflow range of up to 95.32 CFM at high speeds, this fan is an ideal choice for demanding cooling applications. Whether optimizing your system’s thermal performance or maintaining silent operation, the Antec NOVA 120 offers unparalleled versatility and efficiency. item.g:title: Keychron K1 Max QMK/VIA 80% Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard | BROWN Switches
item.g:description: The Keychron K1 Max QMK/VIA Low Profile Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard is a cutting-edge, ultra-slim TKL (80%) mechanical keyboard designed for seamless wireless and wired connectivity. With support for 2.4GHz, Bluetooth 5.1, and USB Type-C wired connections, it offers versatility for both work and play. The Keychron Launcher web app allows users to remap keys, program macros, and fine-tune their setup for a fully customized experience. Built with LSA (low-profile spherical-angled) keycaps for both macOS and Windows, it ensures a comfortable and intuitive typing experience straight out of the box. Engineered for high-performance gaming and professional use, the 2.4GHz wireless mode delivers an ultra-fast 1000Hz polling rate, ensuring near-zero latency even in competitive settings. The low-profile Gateron Jupiter Brown switches, which are 31% slimmer than standard mechanical switches, provide a responsive, tactile feel while maintaining a sleek and lightweight design. For those who love customization, the hot-swappable version enables effortless switch swapping without the need for soldering, giving users full control over their typing experience. The K1 Max is powered by QMK/VIA firmware, offering limitless customization possibilities, including key remapping, shortcuts, and macros. The ARM Cortex-M4 32-bit MCU with 256KB Flash ensures smooth performance and long-term reliability. Designed for comfort, the keyboard features IXPE acoustic foam for silent keystrokes, latex foam for enhanced switch support, and redesigned stabilizers to minimize wobble on larger keys like space bar, Shift, Enter, and Backspace. These refinements contribute to a quieter, more stable, and premium typing experience. Aesthetically, the K1 Max boasts double-shot PBT keycaps, offering oil resistance and durability for long-term use. The keyboard features more than 22 types of RGB backlight effects (with additional fine-tuning for hue, brightness, and speed), as well as a white backlight option for a more subtle look. With a 2000mAh battery, it provides up to 95 hours of use with backlight off or 50 hours on the lowest brightness RGB setting, ensuring long-lasting wireless performance. Whether for productivity, gaming, or daily use, the Keychron K1 Max sets a new standard for low-profile mechanical keyboards. With a boost clock of up to 1537 MHz in OC mode and 6GB of GDDR6 memory, this graphics card delivers the power and speed needed for AAA gaming and demanding creative workflows. Its 2-slot design ensures broad compatibility with various chassis, offering heavyweight performance in a space-saving form factor. This card’s IP5X dust-resistant fans and innovative shroud and heatpipe layout enhance cooling while ensuring durability. The IP5X rating protects internal components from dust ingress, eliminating the need for deep cleaning and prolonging the lifespan of the fans. The advanced thermal performance is further complemented by Auto-Extreme Technology, an automated manufacturing process that minimizes thermal strain and reduces environmental impact, delivering a more reliable and eco-friendly product. The NVIDIA® Ampere architecture powers next-gen features such as 2nd Generation RT Cores for realistic ray tracing, 3rd Generation Tensor Cores for AI-enhanced NVIDIA DLSS performance, and Ampere Streaming Multiprocessors for improved power efficiency and throughput. This GPU also supports NVIDIA® G-SYNC® technology, enabling buttery-smooth gaming by synchronizing the display’s refresh rate with the graphics card to eliminate tearing and stuttering. With a digital max resolution of 7680 x 4320, it’s primed for immersive 4K and 8K experiences across multiple displays. The ASUS Dual GeForce RTX™ 3050 OC Edition is built to last, featuring a 304 stainless steel mounting bracket for added strength and corrosion resistance. Additionally, the included GPU Tweak III software provides intuitive controls for performance tweaking, thermal management, and real-time monitoring, giving you total control over your system. Whether you’re gaming, streaming, or creating, this graphics card delivers exceptional power, efficiency, and reliability. item.g:title: Xiaomi Motion Sensor 2S
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Motion Sensor 2S is a compact, versatile device designed to enhance your smart home experience by monitoring movements and light levels in your environment. With advanced motion and micro-motion detection capabilities, the sensor is ideal for keeping track of people and pets, enabling you to create tailored automation scenarios. Whether it's syncing with other smart devices for lighting adjustments or setting up alerts for unexpected activity, the Motion Sensor 2S helps achieve a seamless smart lifestyle. One of the standout features of the Xiaomi Motion Sensor 2S is its precision illuminance detection, which measures ambient light levels up to 1000 lux. This allows the sensor to adapt to various lighting conditions and automate your home’s lighting systems intelligently. Whether it’s dimming the lights in the evening or brightening up a room during the day, this sensor ensures your lighting is always optimized for comfort and energy efficiency. Designed for reliability and convenience, the sensor boasts a 7-meter detection range with a 130° monitoring angle. It instantly detects movement and sends alert notifications when someone enters the monitored area. Equipped with a new Bluetooth Low Energy chip, it minimizes power consumption, achieving an impressive battery life of up to three years. This reduces the need for frequent battery replacements, making it a cost-effective and hassle-free addition to your smart home setup. The Xiaomi Motion Sensor 2S is built with flexibility in mind, featuring a compact design and adhesive mount that allows for easy angle adjustment. You can rotate the sensor up to 90° vertically and 360° horizontally to fit your specific needs. Its compatibility with other smart products and Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity ensures a seamless integration into your smart home ecosystem, making it a reliable and versatile tool for automation and security. item.g:title: Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20
item.g:description: [embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kOnhLMSzHAE[/embed] The Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20 is a powerful, versatile, and innovative cleaning solution designed to tackle the toughest messes in your home. With its upgraded high-performance brushless motor delivering a maximum suction power of 150AW—25% higher than its predecessor—this vacuum effortlessly removes large debris, pet hair, and dust from deep within carpets and hard-to-reach gaps. Its long-lasting battery, featuring seven large-capacity cells and three cleaning modes, ensures you can clean your entire house in one go without interruptions. Designed for maximum versatility, the G20 adapts seamlessly to different surfaces with its electric brush bar, which is suitable for floors, carpets, and tiles. The integrated LED searchlight enhances visibility in dimly lit areas, allowing for a more thorough and precise clean. For specialized tasks, the mini electric brush, which operates at 1500 rpm, effectively removes dust mites and allergens hidden in mattresses and sofas, promoting a healthier living environment. Equipped with advanced filtration technology, the G20 boasts a 12-cone cyclone-dust separation system that generates strong centrifugal forces to separate large particles while maintaining smooth airflow. Its five-stage filtration system captures suspended particles as small as 0.3μm with an impressive 99.9% efficiency, ensuring clean air and preventing secondary pollution. This vacuum not only cleans your home but also improves indoor air quality. Convenience is at the forefront of the G20's design, with features like a 600mL extra-large dust compartment, an easy-to-empty mechanism, and washable filter components. A wall-mounted storage solution keeps your vacuum neatly stowed when not in use. Combining powerful suction, intelligent design, and user-friendly features, the Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20 delivers a comprehensive cleaning experience for a spotless home. item.g:title: Intel Core Ultra 5 245K LGA1851 4.2Ghz 14-Core CPU
item.g:description: The Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 245K CPU is a robust processor tailored to power modern digital workloads, from AI-driven tasks to intense gaming sessions. Part of Intel’s Core Ultra Series, this CPU is designed for creators and gamers seeking cutting-edge performance with AI integration. With a combination of performance cores (P-cores) and eight efficient cores (E-cores), the Core Ultra 5 245K handles multitasking seamlessly, offloading background tasks to the E-cores, which frees up the P-cores to drive demanding applications and maintain top-notch responsiveness. The processor’s powerful Intel® Smart Cache (24MB) and support for DDR5 memory (up to 6400MHz) make it a versatile choice for creators who rely on high data throughput for large files and smooth, efficient workflow. Gamers and Esports professionals will benefit from the Core Ultra 5 245K’s performance-focused architecture, which provides a Max Turbo Frequency of up to 5.20GHz for intense gaming moments. With 24 PCIe lanes and Thunderbolt™ 5 support, this CPU is optimized for maximum expandability and high-speed connectivity. Built-in Intel® Killer™ Networking reduces lag and packet loss, offering a more seamless online gaming experience, while AI features like Intel® Gaussian & Neural Accelerator (GNA) help ensure clear communication by filtering background noise in voice comms. The processor’s graphics capabilities also support high-resolution displays, including up to 8K resolution on DisplayPort and HDMI, making it a powerful engine for immersive gaming experiences. For content creators, the Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 245K’s intelligent performance shines in AI-driven applications like generative AI and video production. Intel® Deep Learning Boost enhances AI workloads directly on the CPU, speeding up AI model processing for creators working with machine learning or neural networks. The integrated Intel® Connectivity Performance Suite optimizes network performance for smoother streaming, and Quick Sync Video accelerates video encoding, making this processor ideal for creators, streamers, and freelancers aiming to elevate their productivity. Together, these features make the Core Ultra 5 245K a powerhouse for users who need reliable, top-tier performance in both creative and gaming environments. item.g:title: ASRock TRX50 WS AMD TR5 EATX Gaming Motherboard
item.g:description: [embed]https://youtu.be/5eHAHQ4soHQ[/embed] The ASRock AMD TRX50 WS AM5 EATX Gaming Motherboard is a high-performance, workstation-class motherboard engineered for intensive computing environments, providing powerful manageability and reliability. Built with a server-grade, low-loss PCB, this motherboard enhances signal integrity and supports PCIe 5.0 for both graphics cards and M.2 SSDs, unlocking extreme performance potential. Designed for demanding applications like deep learning, rendering, and simulation, the TRX50 WS is compatible with AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ PRO 7000 and AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ 7000 Series processors, bringing elite computing capabilities to professional setups. Its impressive 18+3+3 power phase design and 110A SPS for VCore ensure efficient and stable power delivery to support top-tier performance. Equipped with an XXL aluminum heatsink, active cooling fans, and heat pipes, the TRX50 WS motherboard provides advanced thermal management to maintain peak operation under heavy loads. Supporting up to 1TB of DDR5 RDIMM ECC memory, it allows for extreme memory performance and overclocking while also automatically detecting and correcting data errors to reduce system crashes. The board’s Blazing M.2 slots accommodate PCIe 5.0 SSDs with speeds up to 128Gb/s, preparing it for next-generation storage. Additionally, SlimSAS (SFF-8654) and MCIO server-grade connectors support stable and scalable storage expansions, ideal for users who require fast, reliable access to large data files. Networking and connectivity are robust, featuring Marvell 10 GbE and Realtek 2.5 GbE LAN ports for ultra-fast file transfer speeds to local servers, NAS, or cloud storage. With Wi-Fi 6E providing access to the 6GHz spectrum, users benefit from faster internet speeds, lower latency, and performance equivalent to 5G networks. USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C delivers 20Gbps transfer rates, doubling the speed of previous generations. For audio, Nahimic technology offers vibrant, detailed sound, enhancing the experience whether using headphones, external speakers, or HDMI. The TRX50 WS also includes onboard RGB and addressable headers, fully customizable with Polychrome RGB Sync to create unique lighting effects, making it an ideal solution for gamers, creators, and power users alike. item.g:title: Keychron K7 Max QMK/VIA 65% Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard | BROWN Switches
item.g:description: The Keychron K7 Max QMK/VIA Low Profile 65% Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard is an ultra-slim yet highly functional keyboard designed for versatility and performance. With its compact 65% layout, it provides an efficient and clutter-free typing experience while retaining essential keys for productivity and gaming. Equipped with 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.1, and wired connectivity, the K7 Max allows seamless switching between multiple devices. Its LSA (low-profile spherical-angled) keycaps cater to both Windows and macOS users, ensuring a comfortable and ergonomic feel for long hours of use. Designed for speed and responsiveness, the K7 Max features a 1000Hz polling rate in both 2.4GHz and wired modes, ensuring ultra-low latency, making it a reliable option for competitive gaming and fast-paced workflows. The Gateron Low Profile Brown switches offer a responsive, tactical keystroke with medium noise, providing a perfect balance between comfort and precision. With the hot-swappable version, users can effortlessly swap out switches without soldering, enabling a fully customizable typing experience. The redesigned stabilizers further enhance key consistency, especially for larger keys like Spacebar, Shift, and Enter, ensuring a stable and wobble-free feel. Built on QMK/VIA firmware, the K7 Max offers limitless customization through the Keychron Launcher web app, allowing users to remap keys, create macros, and configure shortcuts to enhance efficiency. A powerful ARM Cortex-M4 MCU with 256KB Flash provides smooth processing, while IXPE acoustic foam reduces keystroke noise, making typing quieter and more comfortable. The keyboard's durable aluminium frame adds both stability and elegance, ensuring long-term reliability without sacrificing its ultra-slim form factor. For aesthetics and personalization, the K7 Max features 22 RGB backlight modes, with the ability to fine-tune brightness, speed, and color effects. The 1550mAh battery delivers up to 73 hours of wireless usage with the backlight off and 42 hours with RGB at the lowest brightness, ensuring extended use between charges. Whether for gaming, professional work, or casual typing, the Keychron K7 Max sets a new standard for compact wireless mechanical keyboards, combining sleek design, powerful features, and extensive customization options. item.g:title: Keychron K2 HE Wireless Special Edition Magnetic Custom Keyboard | NEBULA Switch – White
item.g:description: The Keychron K2 HE Wireless Special Edition Magnetic Custom Keyboard is a revolutionary leap in gaming and typing technology, merging advanced Hall Effect magnetic switches with an elegant aluminum and wood design. A 2025 CES Innovation Award winner, this 75% layout keyboard features natural rosewood accents, available in both light wood (white version) and dark wood (black version). Engineered for precision, it exclusively supports Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic NEBULA switches, ensuring unmatched responsiveness and customizable actuation to fit any typing or gaming style. Combined with OSA profile double-shot PBT keycaps, it offers a smooth and satisfying typing experience with exceptional durability. Built for next-level customization, the K2 HE Special Edition lets users fine-tune each key’s actuation point from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm with 0.1 mm precision. With Rapid Trigger technology, keystrokes reset instantly upon release, while Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS) enable up to four distinct actions per key, streamlining complex inputs for seamless gameplay and efficient workflows. The keyboard also introduces Last Key Press (LKP) and Snap Click technology, optimizing directional changes and counter-strafing mechanics in competitive FPS games like Valorant. Additionally, Analog Mode mimics controller-like precision, translating keystroke depth into variable movement speeds, perfect for racing and simulation games. The K2 HE Special Edition offers versatile connectivity options, including a 1000Hz polling rate on 2.4GHz wireless and wired modes, delivering ultra-low latency for competitive gaming. For seamless multitasking, Bluetooth 5.2 allows effortless switching between up to three devices, making it a powerful tool for both gaming and professional setups. Engineered with QMK open-source firmware, it supports extensive remapping, macros, and shortcuts, all customizable via the Keychron Launcher web app. Users can also personalize their keyboard with laser-engraved designs or text on the wooden siding, adding a unique, nature-inspired aesthetic to their setup. Designed for an exceptionally smooth and immersive typing experience, the K2 HE Special Edition integrates pre-lubed switches, a 3.5mm thick EVA acoustic foam, EPDM foam, and a silicone pad to create a satisfying, soft, and thocky sound profile. The keyboard’s north-facing RGB LEDs provide 22+ customizable lighting effects, allowing users to fine-tune hue, saturation, brightness, and effect speeds. With hot-swappable support for Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic switches, screw-in PCB stabilizers, and adjustable typing angles (5°, 9.34°, and 12.43°), the Keychron K2 HE Special Edition offers an unparalleled blend of style, customization, and high-performance precision for gamers, creators, and professionals alike. FEATURES: Customisable keyboard Aluminium and wood frame Gateron Double-rail Magnetic NEBULA Switch 2.4GHz & Bluetooth connection ARM architecture MCU with 256K flash OSA Profile Double-shot PBT keycaps Adjustable actuation point Hot-swappable North-facing RGB LED lights Lightning fast response time SPECIFICATIONS: Colour: White Number of Keys: 84 (75%) Switches: Gateron Double-rail Magnetic NEBULA Switch Keycaps: OSA Profile Double-shot keycaps, not shine-through Stabilizer: Screw-in PCB stabilizer Switch: Gateron double-rail magnetic switch MCU: ARM Cortex-M4 32-bit STM32F402RC (256KB Flash) Angle: 5° / 9.34° / 12.43° Backlight: North-facing RGB LED Frame Material: Aluminium + Wood Plate Material: Aluminium Sensitivity: 0.1 mm Rapid Trigger: Yes Adjustable Actuation Points: 0.2 - 3.8 mm Dynamic Keystrokes: 4-in-1 action keys Mount Style: Tray Mount Design Cable: Type-A to Type-C cable Connectivity: 2.4 GHz / Bluetooth / Type-C wired Bluetooth Version: 5.2 Bluetooth Device Name: Keychron K2 HE Battery: 4000mAh Rechargeable li-polymer battery Wireless Working Time (Backlit off): Up to 110 hours (Lab test results may vary based on actual use) N-Key Rollover (NKRO) : Yes for both wireless and wired modes Hot-swappable Support: Yes, compatible with Gateron double-rail magnetic switch only. Built with a sleek, minimalistic design and crafted from high-quality materials, this stand offers a stable and adjustable platform for your projector, camera, or compatible AV device. Whether you’re hosting a movie night, delivering a presentation, or setting up a mobile studio, this floor stand is engineered to give you convenience, flexibility, and peace of mind. Its telescopic column allows height adjustments from 80 cm to 100 cm, making it suitable for various setups — from tabletop viewing to elevated cinema projection. The top tray features a durable anti-slip surface and an elastic safety strap to ensure your device stays securely in place, even in busy or slightly uneven environments. With a 30° horizontal rotation range, the tray can easily be adjusted without having to move the base — offering quick alignment in tight spaces. The stand supports devices up to 5 kg and includes a universal 1/4” screw mount, making it compatible with most projectors, DSLR cameras, webcams, or other AV tools. Despite its solid construction, it’s lightweight enough to carry and reposition easily, perfect for users who need a portable setup for travel, events, or multi-room use. Whether you’re a content creator, teacher, remote worker, or cinema enthusiast, the WANBO Floor Stand Pro Tray gives you the freedom to elevate your viewing and presentation experience with reliability and style. item.g:title: Xiaomi Uniblade Trimmer Replacement Head
item.g:description: Innovative three-way blade enables an easy clean shave. The two-way blade at the edge is suitable for cutting longer hair, while the middle foil is effective in removing leftover stubble. The three-way blade cuts hair of any length and thickness, as well as bent and flat-lying hair. Achieving a clean shave has never been more effortless. The full-covering foil acts as a barrier of the blade to the skin. The foil covers the blade and captures the hair with its holes, eliminating any skin irritation during the shaving process. The flexible trimmer head is designed to follow the unique contours of your face and neck. item.g:title: Xiaomi Dust Mite Vacuum Cleaner
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Dust Mite Vacuum Cleaner offers an advanced four-in-one mite removal solution, ensuring pristine bedding and fabrics while safeguarding your family's health. Dust mites, a common household allergen, are a leading cause of conditions such as dermatitis and rhinitis, making their immediate removal essential. This innovative device combines beating, UV irradiation, powerful suction, and hot air drying to eliminate mites, bacteria, and allergens, delivering a deeper clean for healthier living. With a newly designed three-zone beating system, the vacuum generates 12,000 high-frequency beats per minute to dislodge and extract deeply embedded mites and dust particles from bedding and fabrics. Its 254nm UV light sterilizes surfaces by disrupting the cellular structure of bacteria and mites, providing a cleaner and more hygienic environment for restful sleep. A powerful motor generates up to 12,000Pa cyclone suction, efficiently capturing dust, mites, hair, and debris for a thorough and effective cleaning experience. The vacuum also incorporates 50°C hot air drying, which dries bedding and fabrics while disrupting bacterial habitats, reducing the proliferation of allergens. A sophisticated four-layer cyclone dust filtration system traps fine dust and mites, ensuring clean exhaust air and minimizing secondary pollution. The transparent dust compartment enables easy monitoring of the cleaning process and allows for quick disposal with its one-click disassembly. Ergonomically designed for effortless use, this vacuum weighs just 1.63kg and features an open handle for comfortable, one-handed operation. A long 3.5-meter power cord adds convenience, allowing you to clean larger areas with ease. item.g:title: Antec Connect 120 Reverse ARGB PWM Fan 3 Pack – White

item.g:title: Antec FLUX PRO E-ATX Full Tower Gaming Chassis – White
item.g:description: The Antec FLUX PRO E-ATX Full Tower Gaming Chassis is designed for high-performance gaming with its revolutionary F-LUX platform, which optimizes airflow for maximum cooling efficiency. Featuring six pre-installed high-performance PWM fans, this case delivers superior ventilation to keep high-end components running at peak performance. With a dedicated Antec FLUX airflow channel, the chassis enhances GPU cooling through a multi-directional vent design that draws air from the bottom, PSU chamber, and lower sides, ensuring exceptional heat dissipation. Aesthetically striking, the FLUX PRO combines functionality with style by integrating a premium walnut wood finish on the front panel, creating a refined and modern look that complements any gaming setup. The front mesh design allows for unrestricted airflow, while the top and bottom vents work together to establish a smooth and efficient cooling system. With extensive radiator support, accommodating up to 420mm radiators on both the top and front, this case is ideal for enthusiasts looking to incorporate advanced liquid cooling solutions. Designed with convenience in mind, the FLUX PRO offers tool-free access with a detachable left-side PSU chamber, making power supply installation effortless. The removable cooling brackets on the PSU shroud and front panel further simplify component installation and customization. With support for E-ATX motherboards up to 285mm wide, this full-tower chassis provides ample space for high-performance builds, allowing gamers and content creators to push their systems to the limit. Equipped with modern connectivity options, the FLUX PRO features front-panel access to USB 3.0 ports, a high-speed Type-C 10Gbps port, and a temperature display switch for real-time system monitoring. The built-in ARGB and PWM fan controller provides seamless lighting and fan speed adjustments, ensuring both aesthetic appeal and optimized cooling. With its exceptional airflow, premium design elements, and user-friendly features, the Antec FLUX PRO E-ATX Full Tower Chassis is a top-tier choice for PC builders who demand both performance and style. item.g:title: PCBuilder AMD Ryzen 7 5700G HOME MASTER Windows 11 Desktop PC
item.g:description: QUICK SPEC: AMD Ryzen 7 5700G 8-Core 3.8GHz AM4 (Up to 4.6GHz) A520M Chipset AM4 Micro-ATX Motherboard 16GB DDR4 3200MHz Desktop Memory Radeon Built-in graphics 480GB M.2 NVMe Solid State Drive (SSD) Built-in 300W ATX Power Supply PCBuilder Bunker M-ATX Chassis Operating System – Microsoft Windows 11 Strategise and reach your targets easily with the PCBuilder AMD Ryzen 7 5700G Home Master Windows 11 Desktop PC. This pre-built desktop PC is designed for use at home or in the office and is powered by an AMD Ryzen 7 5700G CPU with Radeon built-in graphics. It also comes with an A520 chipset motherboard, 16GB of high-speed DDR4 memory, and an M.2 NVMe SSD. Built with efficiency in mind so you can reach your deadlines on time, this pre-built PC has everything you need to hit those daily targets. With Microsoft Windows 11 already installed, you can also run the latest versions of all your apps with more features and better security. Its built-in Radeon graphics are also a great option for presentations and video content or editing. The Home Master features an AMD Ryzen 7 5700G CPU and DDR4 memory, which will ensure that every task gets completed quickly and efficiently. With 8 cores and 16GB of DDR4 memory, no task is too much for it to handle. Data can be transferred, and applications can be loaded at lightning-quick speeds thanks to the included M.2 NVMe SSD. This makes using apps like Microsoft Word and Excel run even more smoothly, so you can get more work done. All the components are held together with a high-performance AM4 Motherboard with Lightning Gen 3 support. The motherboard delivers an efficient and productive experience with stable functionality and maximum performance. Everything is protected and held together inside a sleek-looking Micro-ATX Chassis. This modern-looking compact chassis is easy to maintain and upgrade, while its smaller form factor is great for saving some space in the home or office. The Home Master comes installed with Windows 11, which has easy-to-use tools that can help you optimise your screen space and maximise your productivity. It features great tools like Microsoft Edge, the new and improved Microsoft Store, Snap Layouts to arrange your open windows into grids, Desktops for better organisation, as well as Widgets. item.g:title: Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 - 3 Pack
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 - 3 Pack delivers seamless, whole-home Wi-Fi coverage with advanced self-developed Mesh technology. Designed to eliminate dead zones, it supports both wired and wireless networking or a combination of the two, providing flexibility for any setup. The system boasts millisecond-level link self-healing capabilities, which optimise network topology in real-time, ensuring a stable and uninterrupted connection throughout your home. With dual-band support for 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequencies, the Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 achieves wireless speeds of up to 1200Mbps, effortlessly handling high-bandwidth activities like streaming, gaming, and video conferencing. Its smart roaming feature automatically connects your devices to the nearest and fastest node as you move around, providing consistent, high-speed internet access no matter where you are in the house. The system is equipped to handle up to 192 devices with the 3-pack configuration, making it an excellent choice for smart homes with multiple connected devices. Featuring two gigabit WAN/LAN auto-sensing ports, it delivers gigabit-level performance without needing to distinguish port functionality, simplifying installation. Pre-paired units make setup a breeze—just designate any router as the main unit, power on the others, and the system automatically forms a Mesh network. Enhanced with Xiaomi’s Easy Connect for smart devices, the Mesh System integrates seamlessly with the Xiaomi Home/Mi Home app, allowing for easy password management and synchronisation. The exclusive gaming acceleration channel for Xiaomi and Redmi smartphones reduces lag, ensuring a superior gaming experience. Encased in a sleek, minimalist design, the Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 not only enhances your home’s connectivity but also complements your living space with its compact and elegant form factor. https://youtu.be/GOeuLEmL5G0 FEATURES: Whole-Home Wi-Fi Coverage Dual-band 1200Mbps Mesh Seamless Roaming Multiple Device Connect Full Gigabit Ethernet Ports Easy to Use Xiaomi Easy Connect 3x mesh units included SPECIFICATIONS: Wi-Fi standard: 2*2MIMO, 802.11n, 300Mbps | 2*2MIMO, 802.11ac, 867Mbps Modulation: 11b: DSSS: DBPSK (1Mbps), DQPSK (2Mbps), CCK (5.5/11Mbps) 11a/g: OFDM:BPSK (6/9Mbps), QPSK (12/18Mbps), 16QAM (24/36Mbps), 64QAM (48/54Mbps) 11n: MIMO-OFDM: BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM 11ac: MIMO-OFDM: BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM Ethernet ports: 2 x 10/100/1000Mbps WAN/LAN auto-sensing port Power adapter: 12V/1A Indicator Light: Indicator light × 1 (Used for instructing the system and internet status at the same time) Temperature: Operating: 0-40℃ | Storage: -40-70℃ Product Dimensions: 8.9 x 8.9 x 15.3 cm (per unit) Product Weight: 250g (per unit) WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 - White x3 Power Adapter x3 Network Cable x1 User Manual x1

item.g:title: Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 - Black
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 combines a sleek, minimalist design with impressive performance, making it a versatile choice for both home and office setups. With its streamlined aesthetic, lightweight feel, and ergonomic design, the Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 offers a comfortable, efficient experience, perfectly blending form and function to meet the demands of modern users. item.g:title: AMD RYZEN 9 9900X 12-Core 4.4GHZ AM5 CPU
item.g:description: Elevate your computing to new heights with the AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series CPUs. These processors represent the pinnacle of desktop performance, engineered for those who demand the best from their systems. With integrated AMD Radeon™ Graphics, enjoy breathtaking visuals and seamless gameplay without the need for a separate graphics card, making these CPUs ideal for gamers and creators alike. The AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series features AMD EXPO™ Technology, delivering optimised settings and enhanced gaming performance. This technology ensures that your games run smoothly and look stunning, providing an immersive experience that takes your gaming to the next level. At the heart of the Ryzen 9000 Series are advanced AMD Ryzen™ Technologies. Precision Boost optimises performance for every task, dynamically adjusting clock speeds to deliver the power you need when you need it most. Smart Access Memory allows the CPU to fully utilise the GPU’s memory, resulting in faster performance and reduced latency, perfect for intensive gaming and creative workloads. The Ryzen 9000 Series supports the latest DDR5 memory and PCIe 5.0, preparing your system for the future with the bandwidth and speed necessary for next-generation graphics and storage solutions. This future-proofing ensures that your system remains cutting-edge, capable of handling the most demanding applications and games with ease. Security and efficiency are paramount with the Ryzen 9000 Series. Integrated security features protect your system from modern threats, while advanced thermal solutions keep your CPU cool and efficient, even under heavy loads. This ensures that your system remains reliable and secure, allowing you to focus on what matters most. item.g:title: WINX DOODLE Max USI 2.0 Stylus
item.g:description: Unlock your creativity with 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity for natural drawing and note-taking, all while enjoying the convenience of a magnetic attachment and tail eraser. Quick Specs Experience natural writing and drawing with 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity. Enjoy seamless compatibility with USI 2.0 enabled devices, plus backward compatibility with USI 1.0. Benefit from palm rejection and magnetic attachment for uninterrupted workflow and easy storage. Utilise the convenient tail eraser for quick corrections and the LED indicator for battery status. Achieve up to 110 hours of operating time on a single charge via USB Type-C. Unleash your digital artistry with the WINX DOODLE Max USI 2.0 Stylus Designed for creators, students, and professionals in South Africa, the WINX DOODLE Max is more than just an input device; it is an extension of your thoughts and ideas. This USI 2.0 stylus is engineered to bring the precision and feel of traditional drawing and writing to the digital realm. Whether you are sketching a new design, annotating important documents, or taking lecture notes, the DOODLE Max offers an unparalleled level of control and responsiveness. Its robust build quality and advanced features make it the ideal companion for a wide range of USI 2.0 enabled tablets, ensuring your creative flow is never interrupted. This stylus is for the discerning user who demands accuracy, comfort, and versatility in their digital tools. Precision and comfort for every stroke At the core of the WINX DOODLE Max's performance lies its exceptional sensitivity. With 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity, the stylus for Chromebook translates the subtlest nuances of your hand movements into precise on-screen actions. This means that the harder you press, the thicker the line, and the angle of your stroke influences the shading, much like a real pencil or brush. This intuitive control is further enhanced by advanced palm rejection technology, which ensures that only the stylus interacts with the screen, preventing accidental marks from your resting hand. The ergonomic design, crafted from durable aluminium alloy, ensures comfort even during extended creative sessions. Seamless integration and intuitive control The WINX DOODLE Max is built on the universal stylus initiative (USI) 2.0 standard, offering broad compatibility with leading USI 2.0 enabled devices. This ensures that your USI stylus will work effortlessly with a wide array of popular tablets and Chromebooks. For those with slightly older devices, backward compatibility with USI 1.0 provides extended usability. Beyond its core function, the DOODLE Max features a convenient tail eraser, allowing for quick and easy corrections without needing to switch tools. The magnetic attachment offers a secure and accessible place to store your stylus when not in use, preventing loss and keeping it readily available. Power and efficiency for uninterrupted creativity Never be caught with a dead stylus again. The WINX DOODLE Max boasts an impressive operating time of up to 110 hours on a single charge, powered by a rechargeable battery that is easily replenished via the included USB Type-C port. Charging takes approximately 60 minutes, ensuring minimal downtime. Furthermore, intelligent power management features, including an auto power-saving mode that activates after 5 minutes of inactivity and a standby time of up to 180 days, maximise battery longevity. The integrated LED indicator provides a clear visual cue of the battery status, so you are always aware of when a charge is needed. Features Create with unparalleled accuracy thanks to 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity that mimic real-world tools. Draw and write naturally without unwanted marks using advanced palm rejection technology. Effortlessly attach and store your stylus with the convenient magnetic mounting feature. Make quick corrections on the fly with the integrated tail eraser functionality. Stay informed about your stylus's power status with the clear LED battery indicator. Enjoy broad compatibility with USI 2.0 enabled devices, plus backward compatibility with USI 1.0. Experience extended usage with up to 110 hours of operating time and efficient USB Type-C charging. Utilise mapped custom functions for a personalised and efficient workflow. This ensures a superior experience for any user seeking a reliable USI 2.0 stylus. item.g:title: V-Sol V1600GS-F Single Port GPON Optical Line Terminal
item.g:description: The VSOL V1600GS-F Single Port GPON OLT is a high-performance, cost-effective optical line terminal purpose-built for delivering ultra-fast and reliable fiber optic connectivity across small to medium-sized networks. Designed in a compact 1U box form factor, the V1600GS-F integrates GPON OLT functionality with gateway and AC controller features, making it an all-in-one solution for FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home), SOHO environments, SMBs, and rental housing network upgrades. Equipped with one GPON port and supporting a splitting ratio of up to 1:128, this device can handle large-scale user deployments while maintaining excellent performance. With transmission distances of up to 20km, the V1600GS-F ensures stable and long-range coverage, perfect for delivering gigabit broadband services over passive optical networks. Capable of 1.25Gbps upstream and 2.5Gbps downstream, the V1600GS-F is ideal for applications that demand high throughput such as HD video streaming, IP telephony, cloud access, and enterprise-level data management. Its flexible deployment makes it suitable for both urban and rural network topologies where performance and affordability are critical. The device features three uplink ports — two Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 and one SFP/SFP+ combo port supporting up to 10Gbps — ensuring fast and scalable backhaul connectivity. It includes centralized network management through WEB, Telnet, CLI, and SNMP, offering streamlined deployment and simplified administration across a range of network architectures. With support for plug-and-play AP control and centralized AC management, it forms the backbone of a POL (Passive Optical LAN) setup for modern offices and enterprise parks. Additionally, the V1600GS-F is engineered for resilience and durability, featuring 4KV lightning protection for power and 1KV surge protection on device interfaces. It also supports both AC (100~240V) and DC (12V/2A) power inputs, offering flexibility across installation scenarios. FEATURES: All-in-one Single Port GPON OLT Integrated OLT, Gateway and AC Function High-Speed Fiber Optic Coverage Easy Installation Saves Investment Centralized Management and Plug & Play AC+AP Solution POL Network of Small & Medium-sized Enterprises Rental Housing Network Renovation SPECIFICATIONS: Rack: 1U Uplink Port QTY: 3 RJ45(GE): 2 SFP(GE)/SFP+(10GE): 1 GPON Port Specification QTY: 1 Fiber Type: 9/125μm SM Connector: SC/UPC, TX: 7.5±0.5dBm, Sen: -32dBm GPON port speed: Upstream 1.244Gbps | Downstream 2.488Gbps Wavelength: TX 1490nm, RX 1310nm Max splitting ratio: 1:128 Transmission Distance: 20KM Management Ports: 1 x USB-COM(Type-C) port Backplane Bandwidth: 16Gbps Port Forwarding Rate: 23.808Mpps Management Mode: WEB/Telnet/CLI/SNMP Power Supply AC Power Adapter: Working Voltage Range: 100~240V | Rated Voltage: 110V/220V DC Power Adapter: DC 12V/2A Lightning Protection Level Power supply: 4KV Device Interface: 1KV Product Dimensions: 21 x 17.3 x 4.36 cm Product Weight: 1070 g WHAT'S IN THE BOX: V-Sol V1600GS-F Single Port GPON Optical Line Terminal x1

item.g:title: Keychron Double Shot PBT OSA Full Keycap Set - Black/White
item.g:description: The Keychron Double-Shot PBT OSA Full Keycap Set is designed to bring both durability and style to your mechanical keyboard setup. Featuring an OSA profile, which combines the height of OEM keycaps with a gently spherical angled surface, this keycap set offers a comfortable and ergonomic typing experience. The double-shot legends ensure long-lasting visibility, preventing wear and fading over time while adding a unique flair to your keyboard. Made from high-quality PBT material, these keycaps provide excellent oil resistance, preventing the glossy sheen that often appears with prolonged use. This enhances the typing feel, offering a more satisfying and consistent keystroke. The robust construction ensures that your keycaps remain in pristine condition for years to come, making them a reliable choice for any keyboard enthusiast. With a thickness of 1.3mm, these keycaps are designed for stability and precision. The OSA profile delivers a tactile and comfortable experience suitable for both gaming and professional use. As a non-backlit keycap set, it emphasizes a clean and sophisticated aesthetic, making it perfect for those who prefer a minimalist desk setup. This keycap set is widely compatible with a variety of Keychron keyboards, including the V, Q, K, L, P, and C series. Designed for MX-style switches, it ensures a secure and seamless fit. Whether you’re upgrading your existing keyboard or customizing a new build, the Keychron Double-Shot PBT OSA Full Keycap Set is an excellent choice for those seeking both durability and refined design. item.g:title: Keychron M3 RGB Wireless Optical Mouse - White
item.g:description: The Keychron M3 RGB Wireless Optical Mouse is engineered for gamers, professionals, and creative users who demand precision, speed, and reliable wireless performance. Built around the powerful PixArt 3395 sensor, the M3 delivers ultra-accurate tracking with a DPI range of 100 to 26,000, ensuring pixel-perfect control whether you are editing images, navigating complex workflows, or competing in fast-paced gaming environments. With IPS speeds of up to 650 and an impressive 1000Hz polling rate in wired and 2.4GHz modes, this mouse provides near-instant response times, delivering the smooth, lag-free performance expected from high-end peripherals. Its ergonomic shape and ultra-lightweight 79g design ensure exceptional comfort during long sessions, making it an excellent choice for both productivity and competitive gameplay. Designed for versatility, the Keychron M3 supports three connection modes — USB wired, ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless, and Bluetooth 5.1, allowing seamless switching between devices such as laptops, desktops, and tablets. The durable Kailh GM 8.0 micro switches offer crisp tactile feedback and extended durability, ensuring reliable clicks through thousands of hours of use. A 600mAh rechargeable battery provides up to 70 hours of usage, making the mouse ideal for both office and gaming setups where uninterrupted performance is essential. Complementing its performance is customisable RGB backlighting, adding a sleek modern aesthetic that fits perfectly into any RGB-enabled workstation or gaming battle station. item.g:title: Keychron B6 Pro Ultra-Slim 100% Wireless Keyboard – Ivory White
item.g:description: The Keychron B6 Pro Ultra-Slim 100% Wireless Keyboard is a sleek, full-size keyboard designed to deliver high performance and versatility in a lightweight and ultra-thin package. It supports 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired modes, allowing seamless connectivity with phones, tablets, PCs, and Macs. ZMK customisation enables users to tailor settings for home, office, or on the go, offering a truly personalised experience across multiple devices. Its ultra-slim body and lightweight design strike a balance between portability and functionality, making it an excellent choice for users who need mobility and productivity. The B6 Pro’s battery life is one of its standout features, offering up to 1200 hours of continuous use, which is about 8 months with 5 hours of daily typing. This extended battery performance ensures long-term reliability, and the keyboard can even be used while charging, allowing uninterrupted productivity. The 2.4 GHz wireless connection delivers a responsive 1000 Hz polling rate, ideal for a clutter-free setup, while Bluetooth 5.2 makes switching between devices fast and effortless. Whether for work or leisure, the B6 Pro provides a smooth, high-performance wireless experience that enhances multitasking across different devices. Designed with both Mac and Windows users in mind, the B6 Pro maintains a Mac layout while offering full compatibility with Windows, providing the same multimedia and function key support found in Apple keyboards but with improved tactile feedback. The concave keycaps ensure precise typing, reducing errors and improving comfort during long sessions. With features like emoji shortcuts, customisable keymaps through the Keychron Launcher, and a protective silicone key skin, the B6 Pro is a versatile, user-friendly keyboard that offers a premium typing experience with enhanced protection against spills and wear. FEATURES: Ultra-slim and lightweight design Scissor mechanism for switches 1000Hz Polling Rate 8 months battery life 2.4GHz and Bluetooth connection Support for Mac OS and Windows ZMK support for more customisation SPECIFICATIONS: Number of Keys: 109 (100%) Number of Multimedia Keys: 17 Typing Angle: 3.2º Frame Material: ABS Keycap Material: ABS Layout: ANSI Polling Rate: 1000 Hz (2.4 GHz & wired) / 90 Hz (Bluetooth) Backlight: Non-Backlit NKRO Support: No Battery: 800mAh rechargeable li-polymer battery Wireless Working Time: Up to 8 months (Lab test result may vary by actual use) Charging Time: Around 2.5 hours Connection: 2.4 GHz / BT / Type-C Wired Bluetooth version: 5.2 Bluetooth Device Name: Keychron B6 Pro Compatible System: macOS / Windows / Linux Colour: Ivory White Product Dimensions: 42.9 x 13 x 0.5~1.7 cm Product Weight: 623g WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Keychron B6 Pro Ultra-Slim 100% Wireless Keyboard – Ivory White x1 Type-C Cable x1 USB Type-A to Type-C Adapter x1 USB Type-A 2.4GHz Wireless Receiver x1 Silicone Skin x1

item.g:title: Keychron B1 Pro Ultra-Slim 75% Wireless Keyboard - Ivory White
item.g:description: The Keychron B1 Pro Ultra-Slim 75% Wireless Keyboard is a highly portable and lightweight keyboard designed for seamless multitasking across various devices. With support for 2.4GHz, Bluetooth, and wired modes, it offers incredible versatility for users who need to connect multiple devices simultaneously. Thanks to its ZMK customisation, you can connect up to four devices, including your phone, tablet, PC, and Mac, using three Bluetooth connections and a dedicated 2.4GHz dongle. This flexibility ensures you can switch between devices effortlessly, making it ideal for professionals who require reliable, multi-device support. The B1 Pro also boasts a remarkable battery life, providing up to 1200 hours of continuous use, or around 8 months with 5 hours of daily usage. This extended battery performance allows you to use the keyboard for months without frequent charging, ensuring it remains a dependable tool for long-term use. Additionally, it supports uninterrupted operation while charging, so you never have to pause your work. For gamers and fast typists, the 1000 Hz polling rate on the 2.4 GHz connection delivers a responsive, cable-free experience, while Bluetooth 5.2 offers smooth connectivity for multitasking across devices. Designed for both Mac and Windows users, the B1 Pro features a Mac layout but remains fully compatible with Windows, offering the same multimedia and function key capabilities that Apple users expect. The concave keycaps, optimized for ergonomic typing, reduce input errors and ensure comfort, while the ultra-thin 5.2mm frame and 3.2-degree typing angle provide stability during extended typing sessions. Additional features, such as a silicone key skin for protection, emoji shortcuts, and the Keychron Launcher for keymap customization, make this keyboard a versatile and user-friendly option for everyday use.
