item.g:title: Xiaomi AC1200 Whole Home Mesh Wi-Fi System (1-Pack)
item.g:description: The Xiaomi AC1200 Mesh System Router 1 Pack is designed to provide comprehensive, high-speed Wi-Fi coverage for large homes while seamlessly blending into your home decor. Its sleek, white, minimalist design enhances the aesthetic of any living space, making it both a functional and stylish addition to your home network. The compact size ensures that it fits effortlessly in any room without taking up too much space. Setting up the Xiaomi Mesh System is incredibly easy. All units are pre-paired before leaving the factory, allowing any unit to serve as the main router. Once the network configuration is completed on the main router, the other units can be powered on to automatically form a Mesh network. This mesh technology from Xiaomi ensures that signal blind spots are eliminated, providing strong and consistent Wi-Fi coverage even in complex housing layouts. The Xiaomi AC1200 Mesh System supports multiple routers to form wired, wireless, or hybrid Mesh networks. It features millisecond-level roaming latency and automatic network optimisation, ensuring real-time, uninterrupted Wi-Fi throughout your home. With dual-band wireless speeds of up to 1200Mbps, the system provides fast and reliable internet. The 2.4GHz band excels at penetrating walls for better coverage, while the 5GHz band offers higher bandwidth for faster speeds. This system is equipped with two Gigabit WAN/LAN auto-sensing Ethernet ports for flexible use and supports connectivity for over 120 devices. Whether you're streaming films, attending online classes, gaming, or controlling smart home devices, the Xiaomi Mesh System handles it all effortlessly. item.g:title: Cudy AX3000 Wi-Fi 6 Mesh Kit 3 Pack - White
item.g:description: The Cudy AX3000 Mesh Wi-Fi 6 System is a powerful networking solution designed to meet the demands of modern homes with high-bandwidth activities like 4K streaming, online gaming, and smart home integration. Featuring five advanced antennas and Wi-Fi 6 technology, it delivers blazing speeds of up to 2402Mbps on 5GHz and 574Mbps on 2.4GHz, ensuring seamless connectivity across your home. With coverage options for spaces up to 6500 sq ft using a three-pack system, it’s the perfect choice for large households or multi-level homes with demanding internet needs. Advanced parental controls allow you to manage online activity by setting time limits and blocking inappropriate websites, ensuring a safe browsing environment for kids. Security is enhanced with WPA3 encryption, protecting your network from brute-force attacks, while a Guest Network feature keeps your personal devices separated from visitors’ devices for an added layer of privacy. Additionally, the system supports six built-in VPN protocols, offering compatibility with over 50 VPN providers and enabling you to host your own VPN server for secure remote access. With a 1.3 GHz dual-core CPU and efficient system tools, the Cudy AX3000 ensures reliable performance and easy network management. The intuitive system panel provides clear insights into network status, while the built-in diagnostic tool simplifies troubleshooting. Whether you’re managing over 200 connected devices, running simultaneous streams, or maintaining a secure and private network, the Cudy AX3000 Mesh Wi-Fi 6 System offers a dependable and versatile solution tailored for today’s connected lifestyle. FEATURES: 1.3 GHz Dual-Core CPU 4-Stream Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 2402Mbps + 574Mbps Wi-Fi 1 200 Connected Devices 2 Fast Roaming Cudy Mesh, VPN Server and Client Multi-Band Simultaneous Backhaul Cudy App, Cloud Control Contains 3 x Mesh Units SPECIFICATIONS: Chipset: MT7981 CPU Details: 1.3 GHz Dual-Core, ARM Cortex-A53 Flash/ROM: 128 MB (1Gbit) NAND DDR/RAM: 256 MB (2Gbit) DDR3 5.0GHz Wi-Fi Speed: 2402Mbps 2.4GHz Wi-Fi Speed: 574Mbps 5.0GHz Wi-Fi Streams: 2T2R (2×2 MIMO) 2.4GHz Wi-Fi Streams: 2T2R (2×2 MIMO) Wi-Fi Antennas: 5× Internal 5.0GHz Antenna Gain Max: 5.1dBi 2.4GHz Antenna Gain Max: 4.2dBi FEM or PA/LNA: 5 GHz: 3× Internal | 2.4 GHz: 2× Internal Beamforming: True Range Performance: Max: 220 m (722 ft) Indoor Wi-Fi range varies depending on the layout and wall materials. See Wall Performance spec for placement suggestions. Wall Performance: Two wooden walls with thickness < 10 cm (4”) | One concrete wall with thickness < 20 cm (7”) or two concrete walls with thickness < 10 cm (4”) Multi-Pack Indoor Coverage: 2 Pack: 400 m² (4300 sq ft) 3 Pack: 600 m² (6500 sq ft) Applied to wireless backhaul situation. Place in the center of each floor, with a maximum of three obstacles to each room. item.g:title: Antec P12 PWM 120mm ARGB Reverse Case Fan - White
item.g:description: The Antec P12R ARGB 120 PWM Case Fan combines innovative design, powerful performance, and vibrant aesthetics to elevate your PC's cooling and style. Featuring a reverse fan blade design, it delivers smoother air intake while presenting a cleaner, more streamlined appearance. With its 9-blade structure, the fan ensures efficient ventilation and robust airflow, even under high air resistance, maintaining superior cooling performance for demanding gaming and workloads. Dynamic ARGB lighting adds a stunning visual dimension, offering a full spectrum of customizable colours to match any gamer's setup. The vibrant illumination brings your build to life, making it a standout centrepiece for any rig. This fan also supports precise PWM control, allowing users to fine-tune their ideal balance of low noise and high performance, with a speed range from 600 to 1500 RPM. Engineered for quiet operation and durability, the P12R features hydraulic bearings and eight anti-vibration rubber pads, which reduce noise and minimize vibrations during operation. With a noise level as low as 14.2 dB(A) and a maximum of just 29.5 dB(A), this fan delivers efficient cooling without compromising your system's acoustic profile. Its long lifespan of up to 40,000 hours at 25°C ensures reliable and consistent performance over time. Designed with both performance and convenience in mind, the Antec P12R ARGB 120 PWM Fan is equipped with a 4-pin PWM connector for fan control and a 3-pin connector for ARGB lighting synchronization. Whether you're optimizing cooling for intense gaming sessions or enhancing your build's aesthetic appeal, this fan provides an exceptional combination of functionality, style, and quiet efficiency. item.g:title: Xiaomi Outdoor Camera CW300
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Outdoor Camera CW300 has a 4MP Camera with an f/1.6 large aperture lens that delivers 2.5K ultra-clear picture quality, capturing detailed and sharp images even when zoomed in. With a white light that activates at night upon detecting a human figure, the camera provides coloured images in dark conditions. Its dual-motor pan-tilt-zoom design allows for comprehensive 360° rotation via a smartphone, offering a broader viewing angle and enhanced security. The IP66 rating ensures stable performance in rain, dust, and harsh weather conditions, making it a reliable choice for any environment. Advanced features include a next-generation local AI human-detection algorithm, providing fast and accurate human recognition without cloud processing. The camera automatically tracks and records human movement, sending real-time alerts and alarm messages to the Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app. To deter potential intruders, it triggers high-frequency flashing lights and audible alarms. Additionally, the high-sensitivity microphone and high-power speaker, enhanced with AI noise cancellation, ensure clear audio even in complex outdoor conditions. For seamless connectivity, the camera supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and includes an Ethernet port, offering a stable connection to reduce disruptions. Each built-in MJA1 security chip provides a unique key and credential for financial-grade data protection, ensuring your privacy is safeguarded. Choose the 4MP Camera with an f/1.6 large aperture lens for exceptional image quality and intelligent features designed to enhance security and convenience in any weather. item.g:title: Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400 is an essential tool for anyone committed to a healthy lifestyle. This advanced scale measures body fat percentage and muscle mass to provide a comprehensive analysis of your physical health. Utilising high and low dual-frequency alternating currents, it accurately assesses the electrical impedance of intracellular and extracellular fluids, delivering precise data on body fat, water content, and muscle mass. Benchmarking against the gold standard of Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry (DEXA), the Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400 achieves a remarkable correlation coefficient of ≥0.93* for key metrics like body fat percentage and fat mass. This high level of accuracy ensures reliable data, helping you identify hidden factors that may contribute to obesity. With this detailed analysis, you can scientifically manage your body shape and overall health more effectively. item.g:title: Xiaomi Automatic Soap Dispenser
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Mi Automatic Foaming Soap Dispenser allows you to clean your skin in a convenient and safe manner. The soap dispenser creates lather in a quarter of a second using a special mesh that provides both gentle action on the skin and thorough cleansing of dirt and bacteria by penetrating deeply into the pores. Simply reach into the dispenser to dispense some foam. The sensitive infrared sensor responds only to movement in close proximity, so no foam spills through. The air-to-soap ratio is strictly controlled at 12:1 for lather. The unique mesh with microscopic holes quickly and effectively produces a soap lather that gently envelops the skin, penetrating deep into pores and cleansing it on a micro level. The dispenser's compact, minimalist design makes it suitable for any room. At the same time, the powerful motor operates almost completely silently, and special rubber pads dampen the dispenser's vibrations during operation. The dispenser requires no mains power; only four AA batteries are sufficient for nine months of operation. Please note this product does not come with the Xiaomi Foaming Hand Soap Refill. Please see the link below in the tech specs for more info. item.g:title: Gizzu Patrol Walkie Talkie Set
item.g:description: Stay connected on your adventures with the Gizzu Patrol Walkie Talkie Set. They're engineered for clear and reliable communication, featuring a range of up to 3km in open areas, ensuring you can stay in touch over long distances. With 16 available channels, including 10 standard and 6 encrypted, you can enjoy secure and private conversations, making it ideal for security companies, family outings, group activities, events, and adventurous kids. The Gizzu Patrol's 2W transmit output ensures that every message is delivered with clarity, while the squelch sensitivity feature eliminates up to 20dB of transmitted noise, so you only hear what matters. its robust 1500mAh lithium-ion battery provides up to 24 hours of operation on a single charge. The Type-C port ensures easy, hassle-free recharging, eliminating the need for bulky base stations or proprietary chargers, allowing you to recharge anywhere, anytime. Designed for convenience, the Gizzu Patrol includes a hands-free mode with an earpiece, perfect for multitasking during your activities. The compact design, coupled with the included belt clip and carry handle, makes it easy to carry and keep within reach. The intuitive volume and channel controls are user-friendly, even for children, making it an excellent choice for family use. Whether you're coordinating with family members during a camping trip, staying connected on a hike, or giving kids a safe way to explore, the Gizzu Patrol Walkie Talkie Set delivers exceptional performance and reliability. Designed to withstand outdoor conditions, operating effectively in temperatures from -20°C to 55°C, making them your ultimate companion for any adventure. item.g:title: Cudy AX3000 2.5G Dual Band Ceiling Access Point- Outdoor
item.g:description: The Cudy AX3000 2.5G Dual Band Ceiling Access Point - Outdoor is an excellent choice for converting LAN networks into high-speed, dependable wireless networks. This pole or wall-mounted WiFi 6 AP with eFEM provides excellent range performance, making it ideal for high-density environments like parks, farms, and parking lots. Its robust IP65 casing, Power over Ethernet (PoE), and Cudy Mesh features make it ideal for outdoor use. It achieves total throughput of up to 3 Gbps by using the highest 160 MHz channel width and 1024-QAM modulation. OFDMA and MU-MIMO technologies can support over 100 devices with low latency, with a maximum capacity of 512 devices. The AP's five power amplifiers and 3+2 antenna structure provide excellent signal navigation through obstacles. The IP65 case protects it from rain and dust, and the 6 kV Lightning/Surge and 8 kV ESD protection ensures stability during thunderstorms. It can operate at temperatures ranging from -40°F to 158°F (-40°C to 70°C). Mesh technology provides a unified Wi-Fi name across the premises, allowing for seamless roaming without the need for manual switching. Connecting the PoE adapter's LAN port to various Cudy devices integrates the AP into the Mesh network, with the option of using Ethernet backhaul after pairing. Adaptive Routing improves network performance by switching to better paths when the original ones become congested. item.g:title: Intel 14th Gen Core i5-14400 LGA1700 2.5GHz 6-Core CPU
item.g:description: The 14th Generation Intel® Core™ processors offer a performance hybrid architecture, allowing for the next evolutionary leap. Get the performance you need, right where you need it, whether you're a gamer, creator, streamer, or regular user. With Intel® 14 Generation processors, you can do more of what you enjoy, whenever you want. The 14th generation Intel® Core™ processors feature a hybrid architecture that combines performance and efficiency (P-core and E-core). That translates to real-world performance, intuitively scaled to match your work. The Performance-core is Intel's most powerful CPU core ever. It's also optimised for single-thread performance and responsiveness in compute-intensive workloads such as gaming and 3D design. The Efficient-core provides multithreaded performance for tasks that can run concurrently (such as image rendering), as well as efficient offloading of background tasks for modern multitasking. Intel built Intel® Thread Director directly into the hardware to ensure that Performance and Efficient cores work seamlessly with the operating system. Intel® Thread Director guides the operating system by automatically monitoring and analysing on the fly, ensuring that the right thread is placed on the right core at the right time. And it does it all dynamically, adapting scheduling guidance to actual computing needs rather than static rules. The 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors support the next generation of discrete graphics cards and storage devices. These devices take advantage of the increased throughput provided by PCIe 5.0, as well as the faster speeds and bandwidth of DDR5 memory. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors include built-in features for noise suppression, auto-framing, and optimised bandwidth and video resolution for gaming. This saves you time and allows you to multitask in ways you couldn't have imagined before. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors enable various tasks, including gaming, browsing, streaming, and creating masterpieces. item.g:title: Intel 14th Gen Core i3-14100 LGA1700 3.5GHz 4-Core CPU
item.g:description: The 14th Generation Intel® Core™ processors offer a performance hybrid architecture, allowing for the next evolutionary leap. Get the performance you need, right where you need it, whether you're a gamer, creator, streamer, or regular user. With Intel® 14-generation processors, you can do more of what you enjoy, whenever you want. The 14th generation Intel® Core™ processors feature a hybrid architecture that combines performance and efficiency (P-core and E-core). That translates to real-world performance, intuitively scaled to match your work. The performance core is Intel's most powerful CPU core ever. It's also optimised for single-thread performance and responsiveness in compute-intensive workloads such as gaming and 3D design. The efficient core provides multithreaded performance for tasks that can run concurrently (such as image rendering), as well as efficient offloading of background tasks for modern multitasking. Intel built Intel® Thread Director directly into the hardware to ensure that Performance and Efficient cores work seamlessly with the operating system. Intel® Thread Director guides the operating system by automatically monitoring and analysing on the fly, ensuring that the right thread is placed on the right core at the right time. And it does it all dynamically, adapting scheduling guidance to actual computing needs rather than static rules. The 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors support the next generation of discrete graphics cards and storage devices. These devices take advantage of the increased throughput provided by PCIe 5.0, as well as the faster speeds and bandwidth of DDR5 memory. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors include built-in features for noise suppression, auto-framing, and optimised bandwidth and video resolution for gaming. This saves you time and allows you to multitask in ways you couldn't have imagined before. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors enable various tasks, including gaming, browsing, streaming, and creating masterpieces. item.g:title: Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus 3840Wh UPS Power Station
item.g:description: Deliver power wherever and whenever you need it with the portable Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station. The Hero Ultra Plus offers 3840Wh of battery capacity. It’s great for keeping your devices charged during outdoor adventures and powering most household appliances during loadshedding. The elegant design is durable, robust, and can be taken with you on any adventure. The Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station features three 220V AC plugs, two USB ports, four Type-C ports, two DC ports, a car socket port, and an XT60 port. These ensure that you can charge or power multiple devices simultaneously. Pure Sine Wave technology and the ability to function like a UPS ensures that the Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus seamlessly switches over to battery power during loadshedding or a power outage, resulting in zero downtime for your connected essential devices. The Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station is compatible with most large household appliances and power tools during loadshedding. Electric chainsaws, electric irons, air conditioners, hairdryers, and air fryers are just some of the products that you can still enjoy during a blackout. The Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station features Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries that recharge from 0% to 100% within 2.2 hours and has a rated lifespan of 3500 cycles. You can recharge the Hero Ultra Plus in multiple ways – Recharge from your car, solar panel, or from traditional wall sockets at the home or office. A battery management system helps to proactively monitor and manage the rechargeable battery. In addition, the Hero Ultra Plus also features safety features like short-circuit, over-current, over-voltage, under-voltage, over-load, and temperature protection. Please Note: The total power consumption for all connected appliances must be less than 3600W. If the power requirement draw exceeds 3600W, the wattage overdraw protection will provide up to 10 seconds of runtime before the unit shuts itself down. Wattage draw exceeding 7200W peak will cause the device to immediately shut down and this may cause damage. The Hero Series Power Stations use Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFeP04) batteries. After 2 days in UPS mode, the battery capacity will throttle between 90-100%. The Battery Management System will drop the capacity after a full charge to around 90% to prevent overcharging. (This will not affect life cycles) FEATURES: 3840Wh Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries with 3x more battery cycles than a typical lithium-iron battery Ideal power solution to run a wide variety of large household appliances and power tools during loadshedding. Features UPS functionality with 10milliseconds switchover Recharge the battery from 0% to 100% within 2.2 hours Features 15 outlets – 3x 220V South African plugs, 2x battery expansion ports, 3x Type-C PD20W ports, 1x Type-C PD100W port, 2x USB ports, 2x DC 5521 ports, 1x car socket port, and 1x XT60 port Add up to 2 extra Gizzu batteries to expand capacity to 11520Wh. Great for even the most extreme outdoor adventures or extended loadshedding. item.g:title: Giada H611 I5-11300H High-end Medical Computer
item.g:description: The Giada H611 High-End Medical Computer is engineered to meet the demanding requirements of today’s healthcare environments. Compliant with IEC 60601-1 and EN 60601-1 medical safety standards, this ultra-thin PC is the perfect fit for hospitals, clinics, and medical institutions seeking high-performance, secure computing in critical applications. Powered by Intel’s 11th Gen Tiger Lake UP3 processors, specifically the Core i5-11300H, the H611 delivers exceptional speed and responsiveness, supported by a robust 35W thermal design power (TDP) that balances efficiency and power for continuous medical workloads. Integrated with Intel® Iris® Xe graphics, the H611 offers a 50% improvement over the previous generation, enabling smooth 4K and even 8K visual output for diagnostic imaging and multi-monitor setups. Display support includes one DisplayPort 1.4 for up to 8K @60Hz and dual HDMI 2.0 outputs for simultaneous 4K @60Hz playback. Whether managing medical imaging software or patient data, the H611 provides the clarity and capability required in professional medical environments. The unit supports 32GB DDR4 3200MHz memory across dual SO-DIMM slots and integrates a PCIe M.2 SSD slot for high-speed storage, ensuring fast boot times and quick data access. For next-generation connectivity, the H611 includes support for 5G via a Quectel RM50XQ module, enabling ultra-fast mobile broadband ideal for telehealth and remote patient monitoring systems. Additionally, Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth® support ensures seamless wireless integration in modern hospital networks. The H611 is fortified with Infineon TPM 2.0, delivering hardware-based encryption and secure boot functionality to protect sensitive patient data and medical records. The rugged metal chassis in medical-grade white is compact (just 18.96 x 14.83 x 2.6 cm), making it ideal for space-limited installations on medical carts or in wall-mounted solutions. item.g:title: Gizzu SURF Simple 18W 55Wh LiFePO4 MINI DC UPS - Black
item.g:description: Stay connected, even when the lights go out, with the Gizzu Surf Simple 18W 55Wh LiFePO₄ Mini DC UPS. Whether you’re working from home, streaming your favourite series, or just trying to keep your WhatsApp chats going during loadshedding, this compact backup power solution is here to keep your WiFi router running smoothly for up to six hours. Thanks to its powerful 55Wh lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO₄) battery, the Gizzu Surf Simple gives you a reliable way to keep your internet online when you need it most. It’s built with four high-quality 4350mAh cells, giving you a total capacity of 17400mAh. That’s enough juice to outlast most power cuts - and because LiFePO₄ batteries are safer and longer-lasting than standard lithium-ion, you can trust it to perform over and over again. In fact, it’s rated for up to 2000 charge cycles while still holding 80% of its original capacity. It’s also really easy to set up. Just plug your WiFi router into the DC output, and you’re good to go. The device comes with three output options - 12V, 9V, and 5V - so it can power more than just your router if needed. And with a max output of 18W, it’s perfect for low-power devices like modems, fibre boxes, or even charging your phone during a blackout. What makes the Gizzu Mini UPS extra smart is its built-in protection features. It’s designed to guard against short circuits, overloads, temperature spikes, overcharging, and more. So not only are your devices safe, but the UPS itself stays protected too. It automatically switches over to battery power during an outage and starts charging itself again as soon as the power comes back on. Compact, lightweight, and built for everyday convenience, the Gizzu Surf Simple fits right into your home or small office setup. If you’re tired of losing connection every time Eskom flips the switch, this is your no-fuss solution to staying online. No more dropped Zoom calls, missed emails, or buffering videos - just reliable internet, no matter what. The Gizzu Surf Simple 18W Mini DC UPS is your go-to backup power buddy for smooth, stress-free connectivity during loadshedding. FEATURES: Power your internet router during power outages 55Wh high-capacity lithium-iron phosphate batteries (LiFePO4) 18W max output Multiple 5/6/12V DC outputs Power your router for up to 6 hours Intelligent protective design with over-charge, over-discharge, and short-circuit protection 744 joules of built-in surge protection to guard your devices from power spikes SPECIFICATIONS: Capacity: 55Wh Power Output: 18W Input Voltage: 100-240V AC DC Output Voltage: 1x 12V (1.5A MAX) 1x 5V (2.4A) 1x 9V (2A) Battery Capacity: 17400mAh Battery Information: 4350mAh x4 lithium iron phosphate batteries (LiFePO4) Battery Cycles: 2000 cycles to 80% Protection Features: Auto on/off Surge protection (up to 744J) Short-circuit protection Over-voltage & under-voltage protection Over-load & temperature protection Product Dimensions: 19.7 x 13.2 x 34.1 cm Product Weight: 0.55kg WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Gizzu SURF Simple 18W 55Wh LiFePO4 MINI DC UPS - Black x1

item.g:title: Xiaomi Smart Air Fryer 6.5L
item.g:description: Enjoy delicious low-fat food by using less oil and a smoke-free cooking experience with the Xiaomi Mi Smart Air Fryer. The oil inside the food is thoroughly fried through the 360° heated air circulation, providing delicious food with less grease and fat. High-speed circulation of the heat current ensures that the food is heated evenly, creating a crispy outer layer while keeping the inside soft. The temperature can also be adjusted between 40℃ to 220℃. The modern-looking minimalistic design will fit right into your kitchen and add some style. The sleek OLED touch-screen makes knobs and buttons a thing of the past and simplifies cleaning the controls. With the configuration of the dual-speed fan, the air fryer can do more than just fry your food. It can also defrost your frozen goods, dry fruits, and ferment vegetables. Thanks to its large 6.5L capacity, you can now prepare more food than before, enough for the family to enjoy. The 1800W heating power enables rapid temperature increase and more balanced heat distribution inside the fryer, shortening the cooking time, and offering a faster, healthier, and more convenient lifestyle. Low temperatures are automatically paired with the low rotating speed of the dual-speed motor for a slow temperature increase. The medium to high-temperature range is automatically paired with a high rotating speed of the dual-speed motor for rapid temperature increase. It can do all of this over a cooking time of up to 24 hours, giving you more options and versatility in the kitchen. Longer continuous heating in conjunction with a broader temperate range offers more cooking possibilities. Make snacks like dried fruit, dried meat, and yoghurt for the entire family. item.g:title: Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2 features increased speed and air volume, to get you back on the road faster. You can fully inflate 2 car tyres or top them up, thanks to enhancements that deliver even more inflation performance on a full charge with up to 25% faster inflation than the Air Compressor 1S. Its 19mm high-precision cylinder block supports pressures up to 150 psi making it ideal for various tyre types. Made from high-quality alloy materials, the portable air compressor inflates from 0 to 150 psi in just 20 seconds, making it suitable for use with shock absorbers on mountain bikes, as well as high-pressure tyres on road bikes. Its highly accurate air pressure sensors mean no more fiddling with manual pumps. The digitally controlled air-pressure sensors improve inflation accuracy to ±1 psi, putting an end to back-and-forth tyre pressure checks as you inflate. It also features six preset tyre pressures, for greater ease and peace of mind. The Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2 automatically stops inflating your tyres when your desired pre-set pressure is reached. It also remembers your pressure values, so you don't have to keep setting it up repeatedly whenever you use it. The Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2 features six different inflation modes, each with preset air pressure values which prevent over-inflation. This makes the Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2 more convenient and easy for anyone to use. Say goodbye to wires, thanks to the internal lithium batteries. Lithium batteries mean no external power source is required, and no more cumbersome power cables are needed. Weighing in at only 490g, it features a lightweight body for greater portability, making it ideal for when you want to travel light. Slip it in your bag, leave it at home, or place it in your car, this beautiful device takes up no space at all, no matter where it's stored. It also features a built-in LED light for night-time use with an SOS flashing feature in case of an emergency. Cudy will let you up your wireless game and experience seamless, high-speed Wi-Fi in any location. item.g:description: Grow what you love all year round with the Kingbrite P55 480W Quantum Bar Grow Light. This product ensures that your seedlings and plants will receive all the necessary light they require to perform photosynthesis regardless of the season, converting the light they capture into sugars necessary for growth. The Kingbrite P55 480W Quantum Bar Grow Light features eight highly efficient light quantum LED bars that can be rotated for the perfect lighting angle. Each quantum bar consists of 224 Samsung LM281B LEDs as well as 32 Epistar 660nm LEDs, 4 Epistar UV LEDs and 4 Epistar IR LEDs which collectively produce the light that is essential for plant photosynthesis, vegetation growth, and the flowering of plants indoors. This LED light is also energy-efficient, consuming less electricity and giving off less heat than other lights. This means they’re better suited to meet the needs of plants grown indoors, are better for the environment and will help save you money in the long term. The Kingbrite P55 480W Quantum Bar Grow Light is optimised for growing a variety of plants indoors, ensuring the production of established roots, healthy stems, and increased flower and leaf density. This, in turn, makes leaves grow stronger and flowers become bright and beautiful. Whatever your requirements, this grow light provides the optimal indoor growing environment for your plants to thrive. item.g:description: Tired of being in a Wi-Fi "dead zone"? Mi Wi-Fi Range Extender Pro can assist you in connecting to a network. item.g:title: Cudy AX3000 Gigabit Wi-Fi 6 Mesh Router
item.g:description: The Cudy WR3000 AX3000 Gigabit Dual Band Wi-Fi 6 Mesh Router features a new Wi-Fi 6 chip with a 4-nm made process, delivering amazing powers and an impressive efficiency bump, enabling the AX3000 to maintain responsiveness and handle intensive transmission tasks such as online gaming streams and 4K live feeds. Equipped with Wi-Fi 6, the AX3000 boasts the highest 160Mhz bandwidth and 1024-QAM to reach up to 3Gbps speeds, which is more than 2.5x faster than the last-gen AC 2×2 Wi-Fi router. item.g:title: Xiaomi Smart Space Heater S EU
item.g:description: Stay warm when temperatures are low with the Xiaomi Smart Space Heater S. This innovative smart heater allows you to control your room temperature anytime and anywhere. Its Smart temperature control allows you to save power while keeping your environment at a comfortable level. When the surrounding temperature is lower than the preset temperature, it will automatically continue heating until it reaches that preset temperature at which point it will automatically reduce the power or stop heating. It can achieve this thanks to its built-in adjustable thermostat, which allows your heater to keep your home at a comfortable temperature while saving energy. The heated air rises and the cool air comes down producing a convective effect for air circulation and room heating. The wide front and top air ducts allow for heating close areas as well as the entire room. It circulates to form convective hot air, which flows in both directions from the top and sides. The airflow is softer than that of an AC and is not as prone to dryness. As a bonus feature, it will not interfere with your sleep at night, and will not cause dry eyes and throat in the morning. With an optimized air duct, the temperature of the Xiaomi Smart Heater S rises faster and the warmth quickly spreads throughout the entire home. With its simple and practical body design, the heater is small, flexible and easy to move. It also comes with an integrated drying rack for clothing to help them dry quicker. The integrated drying rack can load up to 1.5kg of dry clothes while heating. FEATURES: 2200W of power to heat up quickly Quiet and comfortable convection heating technology Accurate digital thermostat with six temperature levels Shut off automatically with overheating and tip-over protection IPX4 splash-proof water-resistance Smart control using the Xiaomi Home app SPECIFICATIONS: Type: Convection heater Rated Power: 2200W Rated Voltage: 230V, 50Hz Temperature: 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28 ℃ Timer on Device 1, 3, 5, 9-hour Timer Adjustable by App: 0-12 hours Connectivity: 2.4GHz Wi-Fi Product Dimensions: 78 x 21.6 x 52.6 cm Net Weight 5700g WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Xiaomi Smart Space Heater S - White x1 Screw Driver x1 Screws x4 Stand x2 User Manual x1

item.g:title: Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Compact Filter
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Compact Filter offers you a high-quality three-layer high-efficiency filtration system to protect your health. The all-in-one powerful filter gives you layers of purification for a much cleaner air output. This filtration system consists of a primary filter, Xiaomi’s high-efficiency filter and a high-quality activated carbon filter that work together to purify your air and keep you healthy. Designed purely for the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Compact, this replacement filter helps bring new life into your Xiaomi Air Purifier. The primary filter allows for 360° blocking of large particles. The primary filter provides an initial filtration by filtering dust, hair, and fine crumbs among other large particles and is resistant to creases, oil, acids, alkalis and more to ensure long service life. Xiaomi’s high-efficiency filter gives you up to 99.97% filtration of 0.3μm particles. The high-efficiency filter removes PM2.5, pollen etc. for consistent clean-air output. The high-quality impregnated activated carbon filter provides powerful odour adsorption. The high-quality activated carbon filter, with the sophisticated pore structure and evenly distributed carbon, effectively removes air pollutants and odours that are harmful in your home. By combining two filter technologies: Electrostatic charge and mechanical filtration, Xiaomi’s high-efficiency filter media can remove 99.97% of airborne particles of 0.3 micrometres in size and traps dust, PM 2.5, pollen, pet dander, smoke and tiny particles. Compared to a conventional HEPA filter, Xiaomi’s high-efficiency Filter allows the air purifier to generate less noise and consume less energy by allowing more air flow to pass through the filter all the while keeping the same cleaning efficiency. item.g:description: The Xiaomi Smart Pet Fountain Filter Set is a great way to breathe new life into the Xiaomi Smart Pet Fountain. item.g:title: Xiaomi Water Ionic Hair Dryer H500
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Water Ionic Hair Dryer H500 uses double water ions which are deeply penetrated into your hair for lasting protection and a smoother shine. With tens of millions of negative ions, this hair dryer can keep the natural moisture in the hair while also effectively reducing split ends and frizz, thus improving hair strength and making it more resilient. The built-in condenser condenses the moisture in the air and two needle-shaped motors rapidly atomize it into tiny negative water ions. Through a separate cold-air channel, these ions are delivered directly to the hair, scalp, and root, which protects your hair from being damaged by excessive temperatures while also hydrating it. Inspired by the principle of aviation engines, the Xiaomi Water Ionic Hair Dryer H500 is equipped with a DC high-speed motor with a speed of 20,000 rpm and seven wing-shaped turbine blades, which generate airflow by squeezing the air out of a conical pressurized air duct. The highest airflow speed is 20m/s, allowing strong airflow to reach the root and dry your hair swiftly without any damage. The glass bead thermal sensor can accurately detect the air outlet temperature 60 times per second, and adjust the airflow temperature in real-time to avoid overheating your hair and scalp. It's hot/cold air alternating mode, which includes hot air for quick drying, and cold air for styling - not only protects the hair surface from getting scorched or damaged but also moisturizes the ends and offers enough care for the sensitive scalp. The NTC smart temperature control automatically adjusts the time interval between hot and cold air based on the detected ambient temperature, so as to provide comfort for the head while also maintaining a healthy scalp and hair. The 360° fully rotatable magnetic nozzle concentrates the airflow for fast drying and tailored styling. The dual-layer design also reduces the temperature of the nozzle and effectively insulates against heat. Three heat settings allow you to switch between hot and cold air, and two-speed speed levels give you more control over the style of your hair. When the air temperature is adjusted to either hot or cold, the dual-color LED indicator light changes colour accordingly. The temperature setting is kept and saved automatically for your next use. Multiple speed and heat settings are provided to make blow-drying and styling easier and more flexible. When NTC detects that the air temperature is too high, it stops heating; the high-precision temperature control module will automatically cut off the power in the event of excessively high temperatures; fuse protection will be triggered when the temperature exceeds the safe range to ensure safety. The ultra-short cylinder is small and exquisite, making it a breeze to pack and carry when travelling for business or pleasure. Its compact and lightweight design won't tire out your arm after a blow-dry. The anodized aluminium alloy finish adds texture and attractiveness to the hair dryer. FEATURES: Double Water Ion Therapy NTC Smart Temperature Control Smart Hot/Cold Air Alternating Mode to Prevent Hair Damage 360° Rotation for Desired Styling Adjustable Temperature and Speed Compact metal Body SPECIFICATIONS: Rated Power: 1800W Wind Speed: 20m/s Noise: ≤75dB Rated Voltage 220V -240V ~ Rated Frequency: 50-60Hz Power Cord Length: 1.7 meters Product Dimensions: 23.7 x 14.4 x 7.9 cm (including air nozzle) Product Weight: 650 g (including air nozzle) WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Xiaomi Water Ionic Hair Dryer H500 - White/Silver x1 Air Nozzle x1 User Manual x1

When using Wi-Fi 6 technology with 1024QAM and 160MHz channels, the Intel® Wi-Fi 6 AX210 module can deliver nearly 3x higher peak data rates (up to 2.4Gbps) and up to 4x capacity improvement in dense or congested environments compared to Wi-Fi 5. item.g:title: Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Lite EU
item.g:description: [embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Vz9BLv0lCk[/embed] The Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Lite offers you peace of mind and all-day protection for those who suffer from rhinitis and allergies. The air purifier protects your respiratory health by keeping the air in your home clean and safe to breathe. It does this thanks to a three-in-one filtration system that can remove up to 99.97% of 0.3μm particles. In addition to your high-efficiency filter system, your purifier also releases negative ions to keep the air fresh, helping you stay refreshed after a hard day’s work. Xiaomi combines two filter technologies to give you the best protection. Xiaomi’s high-efficiency filter media can remove 99.97% of airborne particles of 0.3 micrometres in size and traps dust, PM 2.5, pollen, pet dander, smoke and tiny particles. The activated carbon filter has a high absorption rate and effectively removes common harmful gases such as VOC from your home, as well as eliminating odours to keep your air fresh. Compared to a conventional HEPA filter, Xiaomi’s high-efficiency filter allows the air purifier to generate less noise and consume less energy by allowing more airflow to pass through the filter all the while keeping the same cleaning efficiency. Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Lite has a particle CADR of up to 360m³/h, able to deliver 6000L of purified air per minute, and with 360° all-round air intake, purifying your entire room is effortless. Smart control keeps your home fresh when you’re on the move. With support for smart control, ensure that you always return to a home filled with clean, fresh air. Use the Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app from your smartphone to enable purification when away from home. The purifier also works with Hey Google and Alexa for voice control. It also features a one-touch auto mode making it even more effective for hands-free purification. Its sensitive high-precision laser sensors then monitor changes in air quality. Once it determines the air quality in real-time it then automatically adjusts the purification speeds for automatic purification. Switch to Night Mode to turn off display luminance for no-glare, no-noise purification. Your purifier will keep air circulating, providing you with the perfect environment for some undisturbed shut-eye. Easy-clean air ducts help clean your purifier from the inside out. Unscrew and remove the grille for easy access to the fan blades and air ducts. This makes for easy cleaning for the inside of your purifier to prevent secondary pollution. The air purifier is ideal for those suffering from allergies, or who live in areas where there is a lot of pollen. They are also perfect for newborn babies or children who need to still develop their immune systems. Improve your way of life with the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Lite. item.g:title: Cudy 24-Port Unmanaged POE Switch - Rack Mount
item.g:description: The Cudy FS1026PS1 26-Port 10/100M PoE+ Switch with 1 FSP Slot allows you to manage your home or office network with ease. It features 24 Ethernet PoE ports with 2 uplink ports and 1 SFP slot. It's PoE RJ-45 connectors support any 10/100Mbps Ethernet devices, while the 2 non-PoE uplink ports support 10/100/1000Mbps Ethernet devices and it's compliant with IEEE 802.3af/802.3at network standards. Used for many applications the Cudy FS1026PS1 works with IP Cameras for home, office or small businesses. It also works well with PCs, printers and access points in your home or office, making it ideal for small businesses. It even features a VLAN mode for additional security, this allows the ports to be isolated from one another. Its simple plug and play interface makes it incredibly easy to use. Its sturdy design is made from high-quality metal. This gives you a longer service life and provides better heat dissipation, making it suitable for most environments. It also features a fanless design with venting holes to help dissipate heat with silent operation. Watchdog guarantees the uninterrupted operation of your PoE devices. Installation is simple with a PCIe 2.1 x1 or higher slot, and status LEDs provide instant link and activity feedback. With its robust feature set, energy efficiency, and ultra-fast 2.5G speeds, the Cudy PE25 is the ultimate choice for upgrading your network performance with ease. Turn the brightness high in wardrobes and porches for clear lighting without having to turn on a mains light. Turn the brightness low in staircases and bedrooms for soft, non-disruptive lighting. The Mi Night Light 2 can also be removed from the base to use separately if needed. Thanks to the long battery life you can get many more hours of usage, it can last for up to 180 days of battery life at the highest brightness setting. You can also turn off the night light function via the Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app. The brightness and lighting up time can both be adjusted in the Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app. Using the Bluetooth gateway, the device can be set to connect with different devices at different times. item.g:description: The P300 is Patriot’s next generation of mid-tier PCIe gen 3x4 NVMe SSD to hit the market, offering 25% higher transfer speeds and IOPs than standard PCIe 3x2 solutions. The compact m.2 form factor is designed for easy installation and will fit into any PC or laptop, while its low power consumption helps extend laptop battery life. The P300 is guaranteed to improve start-up, loading, and transfer times over traditional hard disk drives. Advanced wear-levelling and thermal management features extend the life of the drive for maximum use. item.g:title: Xiaomi Wireless Router 4A
item.g:description: The Xiaomi Mi 4A Dual Band Wireless Router allows you to reach 300Mbps over the 2.4GHz band and 867Mbps over the crystal clear 5GHz band, the max wireless speed is up to 1167Mbps over both. The 2.4GHz band offers transmission over greater distances, with better coverage and better penetration through walls, while the 5GHz band adopts 802.11ac technology giving you less interference and higher speeds for a smoother experience watching HD videos and playing multiplayer online games. The Mi Router 4A supports Smart Connect, offering 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands under one Wi-Fi name. This allows you to have no more confusion over which Wi-Fi network to connect to 2.4GHz and offers better performance through walls, while 5GHz provides higher speeds. The optimal frequency band is also automatically selected by a dual-band terminal. The router comes with 4 external antennas so that the signal can travel through walls better. 4 external omnidirectional antennas, which are precision tested, and with a carefully designed internal structure and configuration greatly improves transmission performance, even in complex environments. It also features dual cooling fin heat sinks for better system stability and cooling. A specially treated metal substrate is combined with nanomaterials boasting exceptional thermal radiation features. item.g:title: Cudy 30W Gigabit PoE+ Injector
item.g:description: The Cudy POE200 30W Gigabit PoE+/PoE Injector allows you to easily supply power and data to a single PoE device. It features a Gigabit Ethernet input port and a Gigabit PoE output port. It’s a great option for small surveillance systems or a VOIP phone or a WiFi AP. The 2 port switch supports 30W total PoE power on the PoE output port. It complies with IEEE802.3af/at Standard speeds for great performance. The Injector is powered by an AC power adapter and can be easily mounted to a wall. Used for many applications the Cudy POE200 works with IP Cameras for home, office or small businesses. It also works well with VoIP phones for business conferences and WiFi APs for the office and businesses. Its simple plug and play interface makes it incredibly easy to use. item.g:title: CANYON power bank PB-2001 20000 mAh White
item.g:description: Power bank PB-2001 Every gadget user has faced this problem when a smartphone or headphones battery runs out amidst the most interesting place of a series, a game, or a heated chat discussion! Canyon released the PB-2001 power bank model to help you use a mobile device all day long without worrying about a dead battery. It is notable for its high capacity and fairly compact housing with 2 charging inputs – Micro-USB and Type-C. The battery can charge 2 devices simultaneously via USB-A outputs. If you like to spend a lot of time off the grid, that’s your power bank of choice! item.g:title: 41mm Pride Edition Sport Loop
item.g:description: 41mm Pride Edition Sport Loop A closer look at the new Pride Edition Sport Loop. Pride script woven into the strap Made with pride,featuring vibrantcolours that honourthe strength andinclusivity of theLGBTQ+ community Matching animated Pride watch face Open this page on your iPhone to download Matching animated Pride watch face Open this page on your iPhone to download Apple is proud tofinanciallysupport L G B T Q+ advocacyorganisations Inspired by the strength and inclusivity of the LGBTQ+ community, the Pride Edition Sport Loop displays a vibrant gradient that unites the core Pride flag and five new colours: Black and brown symbolise marginalised LGBTQ+ communities of colour, as well as those currently living with HIV/AIDS and those who have passed away from it. Light blue, pink and white honour trans and gender non-conforming people. Utilising the Sport Loop form, the strap features a double-layer nylon weave composed of soft and breathable textile loops. To create the Pride script, some of these textile loops were removed, resulting in a three-dimensional texture you can see and feel. On the reverse side, the attachment loops are securely anchored for superior durability. The hook-and-loop fastener allows for quick and easy adjustment. Apple is proud to financially support LGBTQ+ advocacy organisations working to bring about positive change: Encircle Encircle provides life-affirming therapy, programmes and services to the LGBTQ+ community and their families. With houses in multiple locations in Utah, they offer safe spaces for LGBTQ+ youth to make new friends, connect with peers and access support. Equality Federation Institute Equality Federation is an accelerator that is building a network of state-based LGBTQ+ advocacy organisations in the US that focus on issues such as advancing workplace fairness and family recognition to defeating anti-transgender bills and HIV criminalisation laws. Equality North Carolina Equality NC is the oldest statewide LGBTQ+ equality organisation in the US and the largest LGBTQ+ rights advocacy group in North Carolina. They provide training and education for individuals, institutions, businesses and governments while uplifting voices of colour and stories of queer and trans North Carolinians. Equality Texas Equality Texas is the largest statewide advocacy organisation working to eliminate discrimination targeting the LGBTQ+ community. They aim to secure full equality for LGBTQ+ Texans through political action, education, community organising and collaboration. Gender Spectrum Gender Spectrum works to create gender-sensitive and inclusive environments for all children and teens, and the organisation provides resources so families can further their understanding of gender. GLSEN GLSEN is an education organisation working to end discrimination, harassment and bullying based on sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression. They conduct research to create evidence-based solutions for primary and secondary educators to use throughout school communities. Human Rights Campaign The Human Rights Campaign is America’s largest civil rights organisation working to achieve equality for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer people. HRC envisions a world where LGBTQ+ people are embraced as full members of society at home, at work and in every community. PFLAG PFLAG is the first and largest organisation for LGBTQ+ people, their parents and families, and allies. PFLAG supports, educates and advocates in support of a world where diversity is celebrated and all people are respected, valued and affirmed. The National Center for Transgender Equality The National Center for Transgender Equality advocates to change policies and society to increase understanding and acceptance of transgender people. NCTE works to replace disrespect, discrimination and violence with empathy, opportunity and justice. SMYAL SMYAL supports and empowers LGBTQ youth by ensuring they have safe and welcoming spaces where they live, work and learn by providing affirming programmes, housing support, mental health services and leadership training. The Trevor Project The Trevor Project is the world’s largest suicide prevention and crisis intervention organisation for LGBTQ young people. ILGA World ILGA World is a worldwide federation committed to advancing the human rights of all people, regardless of their sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expressions and sex characteristics. item.g:title: 41mm Pride Edition Sport Band - M/L
item.g:description: 41mm Pride Edition Sport Band - M/L A closer look at the Pride Edition Sport Band. Vibrant colours symbolise the beauty and diversity of the LGBTQ+ community. Featuring a custom laser-etched message. Matching animated Pride watch face. Open this page on your iPhone to download. Apple is proud to financially support L G B T Q+ advocacy organisations. Designed withpride in California. Featuring a joyful design, the Pride Edition Sport Band incorporates a full range of vibrant colours to celebrate the beauty and diversity of the LGBTQ+ community. In addition to the colours of the core Pride flag, black and brown symbolise marginalised LGBTQ+ communities of colour, as well as those impacted by HIV/AIDS. Light blue, pink and white honour trans and non-binary people. Made from a custom high-performance fluoroelastomer, the Sport Band is durable and strong, yet surprisingly soft. The innovative pin-and-tuck closure is laser-etched with “Designed with pride in California”. The band is complemented by a matching animated watch face and iPhone wallpaper.** Apple is proud to financially support LGBTQ+ advocacy organisations working to bring about positive change: Equality Federation Institute Equality Federation is an advocacy accelerator that is building a network of state-based LGBTQ+ advocacy organisations in the United States. The groups work on critical issues — from advancing workplace fairness and family recognition to defeating anti-transgender bills and HIV criminalisation laws — that affect how LGBTQ+ people experience the world. Encircle Encircle provides life-affirming therapy, programmes and services to LGBTQ+ communities and their families. With houses at multiple locations in Utah, Encircle provides safe spaces for LGBTQ+ youth to make new friends, connect with peers and access support. Equality North Carolina Equality NC is the oldest statewide LGBTQ+ equality organisation in the United States and the largest LGBTQ+ rights advocacy group in North Carolina. Equality NC is committed to embodying an intersectional approach to advocacy that is done with a race equity perspective. They provide training and education for individuals, institutions, businesses and governments while uplifting voices of colour and stories of queer and trans North Carolinians. Equality Texas Equality Texas is the largest statewide advocacy organisation working to eliminate discrimination targeting the LGBTQ+ community. It aims to secure full equality for LGBTQ+ Texans through political action, education, community organising and collaboration. Gender Spectrum Gender Spectrum is a US organisation committed to the health and wellbeing of gender-diverse children and teens through education and support for families, as well as training and guidance for educators, medical and mental health providers, and other professionals. It works with adults and institutions to create gender-inclusive environments for children from birth to young adulthood, and it provides resources so families can further their understanding of gender. GLSEN GLSEN is an education organisation working to end discrimination, harassment and bullying based on sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression. It conducts research to create evidence-based solutions for educators to use throughout school communities. Human Rights Campaign The Human Rights Campaign is America’s largest civil rights organisation working to achieve equality for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer people. HRC envisions a world where LGBTQ+ people are embraced as full members of society at home, at work and in every community. PFLAG PFLAG is the largest organisation in the US dedicated to supporting, educating and advocating for LGBTQ+ people and those who love them. PFLAG’s network of hundreds of chapters and more than 325,000 members and supporters are helping create an equitable and inclusive world where every LGBTQ+ person is safe, celebrated, empowered and loved. The National Center for Transgender Equality The National Center for Transgender Equality advocates to change policies and society to increase understanding and acceptance of transgender people. In the US capital and throughout the country, NCTE works to replace disrespect, discrimination and violence with empathy, opportunity and justice. SMYAL Based in Washington, DC, SMYAL supports and empowers LGBTQ+ youth between the ages of 6 and 24. SMYAL ensures that LGBTQ+ youth have safe and welcoming spaces where they can live, work and learn by providing affirming programmes, housing support, mental health services and leadership training. The Trevor Project The Trevor Project is the leading organisation working to end suicide among LGBTQ young people in the United States and beyond. ILGA World ILGA World is a worldwide federation committed to advancing the human rights of all people, regardless of their sexual orie

And it securely attaches to the Crossbody Strap, allowing you to conveniently wear your iPhone hands-free. This case contains 45 per cent recycled silicone material, with a silky, soft-touch finish on the exterior that feels great in your hand. And on the inside, there’s a soft microfibre lining for even more protection. This case works seamlessly with Camera Control. It features a sapphire crystal coupled to a conductive layer to communicate finger movements to Camera Control. With built-in magnets that align perfectly with iPhone 17, this case offers a magical attach experience and faster wireless charging, every time. When it’s time to charge, just leave the case on your iPhone and snap on your MagSafe charger, or set it on your Qi2 25W or Qi-certified charger. Like every Apple-designed case, it undergoes thousands of hours of testing throughout the design and manufacturing process. So not only does it look great, it’s built to protect your iPhone from scratches and drops. Ubiquiti UniFi Access Point U7 Pro Max The WiFi Industry Standart The Ubiquiti UniFi Access Point U7 Pro Max is a ceiling-mounted WiFi 7 access point designed to deliver superior wireless performance in demanding, large-scale environments. It features 8 spatial streams, 6 GHz support, and a dedicated spectral scanning engine for enhanced channel selection and interference-free WiFi. WiFi 7 with 6 GHz Support Provides interference-free connectivity, ideal for high-density environments. 8 Spatial Streams and Real-time Spectral Analysis Ensures robust and high-speed data transmission, supporting multiple devices simultaneously. Enhances channel selection, optimizing performance and reducing interference. Large Coverage Area And High Device Capacity Covers up to 160 m² (1,750 ft²), making it perfect for large offices and public spaces. Supports over 500 connected devices, ideal for environments with high user density. Easy Deployment The PoE+ support and ceiling-mount design allow for quick and flexible installation. Ways to Use Enterprise Environments: Ideal for large offices and corporate buildings requiring robust and reliable WiFi coverage. Educational Institutions: Perfect for schools and universities with high-density student and staff populations. Hospitality: Ensures seamless connectivity in hotels, resorts, and conference centers. Public Spaces: Suitable for airports, shopping malls, and other large public venues. Healthcare: Provides reliable wireless connectivity in hospitals and clinics, supporting critical applications and devices. The Ubiquiti UniFi Access Point U7 Pro Max is a versatile and powerful solution for any environment requiring high-performance, reliable, and interference-free wireless connectivity. } 6 Ports USB-C HUB DS-17 Experience unparalleled connectivity and productivity with our Ultimate USB Hub, designed to meet the demands of modern professionals and tech enthusiasts. This compact hub features an input Type-C port and six versatile outputs, ensuring all your devices and peripherals are seamlessly connected. Enjoy stunning visuals with the HDMI port that supports 4K Ultra HD at 60Hz. Transfer data at lightning-fast speeds with two USB-A 3.2 ports, each offering 10Gbps. item.g:description: 7-in-1 Hub for a MacBook: USB-C Power Delivery 100W DS-05B Expand your MacBook experience by adding all needed ports in one stylish aluminum hub with seven interfaces. Designed specifically for Usb-C equipped MacBooks, this hub lets you get things done faster and more conveniently, and lets you connect two monitors to your computer at once. The hub has built-in SD and TF card readers. A USB 2.0 port will ensure connectivity and data speed up to 480 Mbps, and USB 3.0 - up to 5 Gbps. 2 HDMI ports (4K at 30Hz, Full HD 1080P at 60Hz) allow to connect monitors, and USB Type C enables fast charging from the power socket. The hub is plug-and-play, it does not require any software to operate. An important feature is its hot-swap connection switching mode. In addition, the design of this multiport hub matches Apple style aesthetics, as it is fully compatible with all up-to date devices. item.g:description: Charge & sync cable CLNM60 Meet the CNS-CLNM60SC10W/B/PS/DB – this cable is all about top-tier performance and style in one package. Built for your Apple devices, this USB-C to Lightning cable delivers up to 60W of power, giving your iPhone or iPad a serious boost in no time. It’s fast, reliable, and ready when you need it. Speeding up your daily routine? With 480MB/s data transfer, syncing your favorite playlists, photos, or even big files happens in a snap. Say goodbye to waiting and hello to instant connections. At 1 meter long, this cable is perfect for on-the-go use: long enough to give you room, short enough to avoid tangles. Plus, the smooth, flexible silicone finish feels amazing in your hands, and you won’t have to wrestle with knots ever again! Want to know the best part? item.g:title: Apple MagSafe Power Adapter - 85W (MacBook Pro 2010) Model: A1343
item.g:description: 85W MagSafe Power Adapter (for 15- and 17-inch MacBook Pro) The 85 Watt MagSafe Power Adapter features a magnetic DC connector that ensures your power cable will disconnect if it experiences undue strain and helps prevent fraying or weakening of the cables over time. In addition, the magnetic DC helps guide the plug into the system for a quick and secure connection. When the connection is secure, an LED located at the head of the DC connector will light; an amber light lets you know that your portable is charging, while a green light tells you that you have a full charge. An AC cord is provided with the adapter for maximum cord length, while the AC wall adapter (also provided) gives users an even easier and more compact way to travel. Designed to be the perfect traveling companion, the adapter has a clever design which allows the DC cable to be wound neatly around itself for easy cable storage. This power adapter recharges the lithium polymer battery while the system is off, on, or in sleep mode. It also powers the system if you choose to operate without a battery. Compatible with 15- or 17-inch MacBook Pro. item.g:description: CANYON cross-body bag CB-2 The Canyon CB-2 is your next favourite cross-body bag. It’s fairly compact, measuring 35 centimeters on the longest side, and it will fit most of your everyday stuff. The shoulder strap is adjustable, and the bag can be worn on both sides. Be sure to use up its three outside pockets and two internal ones; all 3.5 liters of volume are at your disposal. Buying this bag might free your pockets but save your money! With its symmetrical shape, it’s perfect for left-handers, right-handers, or anyone who just wants a comfortable grip. Convenience never looked (or felt) this good before. Featuring 1200 DPI sensitivity, the M-5 provides smooth and accurate tracking for everyday tasks like browsing or light gaming. Built from durable ABS material and tested for an impressive 3 million clicks, the M-5 is prepared for heavy use. The 1.5m cable will give you plenty of freedom to set up your workspace just the way you like it, while the lightweight design (just 95g) ensures effortless handling throughout long hours of work or play. For those who appreciate practicality and performance, the M-5 Wired Mouse is the perfect choice. Simple, durable, and reliable…it’s everything a mouse should be. item.g:description: Vertical Wireless Mouse CNS-CMSW16B This vertical wireless mouse is a great tool for those who spend a lot of time with the computer and care about their muscle health. The improved vertical mouse design helps to reduce pressure on the wrist and lower the muscular tension of the forearm. This model differs from other vertical mice due to its arrangement of buttons and a pleasant-touch rubberized surface. } Mesh Office/Gaming Chair Ventra MOCH01 Meet the Ventra MOCH01 Mesh Office/Gaming Chair, where comfort, functionality, and style come together. It’s perfect for logging long hours at your desk, getting into the groove of your favorite game, or taking a much-needed break. Starting with the breathable mesh cover: no more feeling glued to your chair after a few hours. This mesh is airy, and it will keep you cool and collected at any time. No need to shift around to find that elusive “cool spot,” too. The chair’s durable plastic frame is light but sturdy – it manages the daily hustle and game time excitement very well. You can trust it to stay steady without feeling bulky. Then there’s the butterfly mechanism with seamless adaptability. Need to rock back for a quick pause or lock into place for a strategy meeting? This mechanism lets you lean any way you want. The adjustable backrest angle shifts between 90° and 120°. The smooth tilt lets you switch modes in a heartbeat, and your spine will thank you. The 5-star metal base anchors the chair, and paired with quiet 50 mm casters, you can roll, pivot, and glide around without the annoying squeaky soundtrack. The Class-4 gas lift allows you to find your perfect height with just a lever’s pull. It’s built tough to support up to 136 kg (300 lb), so you can sit confidently without the fear of sudden drops or wobbles. The headrest and lumbar adjustment are also game-changers. Customize the support to match your needs and focus on what matters without the nagging aches. Durable

Built on a sturdy aluminum top plate, ensuring long-lasting durability and stability. SMOOTH & SILENT LINEAR “DREAM SWITCHES” The LORGAR™ linear “Dream Switches” can withstand 50,000,000 cycles, making them highly dependable. With the balanced actuation force of 40 grams, no accidental input is expected, and the actuation point of 2 mm within 4 mm of travel distance gives you a reaction advantage in-game. TKL LAYOUT The optimized 87-key tenkeyless design maximizes desk space without compromising functionality. This compact format brings your mouse closer to the keyboard's center, reducing arm movement and enhancing gaming ergonomics. CUSTOMIZABLE RGB BACKLIGHT The keyboard features RGB backlighting that can be fully customized and synced with other LORGAR™ devices using the LORGAR PLATFORM. LORGAR PLATFORM Besides the ability to customize and synchronize your devices' backlight, our LORGAR PLATFORM allows you to create gaming profiles, record macros, and remap keys. You can also monitor your gaming performance

} Wireless Gaming Headset Ego GH-16 Imagine diving into your favorite game, where every footstep and explosion is delivered with razor-sharp clarity. The Ego GH-16 Wireless Gaming Headset is meant to do just that, transforming the way you hear, play, and connect. Designed for top performance, this headset delivers a fast, uninterrupted connection with BT 5.3, letting you game wirelessly without lag or dropouts. And when every second counts, the 40mm high-fidelity drivers bring deep bass, crisp highs, and immersive surround sound, pulling you deeper into the action. But power means nothing without endurance. With up to 20 hours of battery life, you can grind through long gaming sessions, binge-watch your favorite shows, or listen to music for hours on end without interruption. For a quick boost, the fast-charging Type C port gets you back in the game in no time. And when wireless isn't an option, simply switch to the 3.5mm wired connection for instant, latency-free sound. Built for long-term comfort, the Ego GH-16 features lightweight construction and plush ear cushions, making marathon sessions feel wonderful. The headset’s versatile design adapts to your every need, like strategizing with teammates, jamming to your favorite playlist, or taking important calls. No wires or limits – just pure, game-changing sound that keeps you ahead of the competition. 3 Connection Modes: 2.4G Wireless, BT, Wired Headset Game the way you want with three flexible connection options. 2.4G wireless ensures a lag-free experience for i

item.g:title: CANYON speaker BSP-8 10W Red
item.g:description: Portable wireless speaker BSP-8 The new Canyon portable wireless speaker is ready to blast your all-time favorites. Rated at 10 Watts, it is a travel-sized powerhouse. Rounded shapes, compact size, and a neat little handle make it a perfect companion for a trip or a countryside party with your friends! The RGB backlight on top will look awesome after dark, and you can easily find the playback control buttons there. Enjoy up to 3 hours of music while being connected with Bluetooth, and once the battery dies - just plug it in with about any Type-C cable. Besides, you can use AUX, USB, or a MicroSD memory card as your media source. We truly recommend using Bluetooth – what’s better than switching playlists on the fly? As far as 10 meters from the speaker, the connection remains stable. Get your BSP-8 speaker in red, gray, or black – your adventures need to get a soundtrack. An excellent solution for those who want to enjoy music in nature, in a country house or on the street. item.g:title: CANYON headset TWS-5 Purple
item.g:description: True wireless stereo headset TWS-5 These wireless headphones are designed for those who are constantly on the move and love to listen to music in high quality playback. The latest version of Bluetooth 5.3 ensures stable pairing both with the audio source and between the right and left earbuds. In addition, thanks to this protocol, the operating time of the headset has been increased up to 7.5 hours. Clear and surround stereo sound will allow you to enjoy your favorite music in high quality. The TWS function allows you to pair it with a second BT TWS speaker for immersive stereo sound experience. The headset allows you to receive phone calls and use voice assistant without touching your smartphone. To charge the headphone box, a USB Type-C cable is used, the same one used in most modern smartphones. The comfortable design of the ear buds with silicone ear tips ensures a snug fit in the ear. Additional ear cushions in different sizes allow you to choose the right ones for you, ensuring the most comfortable fit. Reliable audio gadget for those who love an active lifestyle! item.g:description: True wireless stereo headset TWS-8 Have you already tried true wireless earphones? There is a chance you won’t look back with these Canyon earbuds 13 mm speakers will bring joy to your ears, offering a balanced sound profile. Not only music – these earphones make a great companion for calls and conferences. Four microphones work together to provide environment noise cancellation. Whether you are on a call or just in a noisy environment – this technology helps you to hear and be heard. These earphones boast an impressive battery life, offering up to 7.5 hours of playback on a single charge. When combined with the charging case, you can enjoy up to 32 hours of use. The case can be fully charged in just two hours using any Type-C cable. We use the latest Bluetooth protocol, which is dependable and energy-efficient. It will maintain a stable connection with your phone or other devices. Plus, the low latency of 50 ms makes these earphones quite good for gaming. Lightweight and ergonomic, they are almost imperceptible to the ear. We added earcaps in three sizes to make the fit ideal for you. item.g:title: CANYON headset Doublebee GTWS-2 Gaming Yellow
item.g:description: Gaming headset GTWS-2 Doublebee Are you a serious gamer looking for the ultimate audio experience? Look no further than this gaming headset from Canyon — DoubleBee GTWS-2. These true wireless earphones are designed specifically for gaming, providing an immersive audio experience. With a low latency of just 45ms in gaming mode, you'll never miss a beat or experience any lag. There’s also a dedicated Music mode, which ensures the best possible audio quality. The earphones use Bluetooth 5.3 for a stable and energy-efficient connection to your gaming device, allowing you to move around without worrying about losing your connection. With an impressive battery life of up to 4 hours on a single charge and up to 37.5 hours with the charging case, you'll never have to worry about running out of juice mid-game. Besides, the earbuds have a quick charge mode: from zero to full battery in just 60 minutes. It’s worth noting that the charging case has a unique design that resembles the iconic Bumblebee. Available in black, orange, and yellow, this case definitely looks fresh in the world of gray and white earbuds. Get a next-level experience with DoubleBee – the new true wireless headset from Canyon Gaming! item.g:description: Kids smartwatch Cindy KW-41 Do you want to get your kid a handy gadget? Try Canyon Cindy. The KW-41 smartwatch is an all-around device designed to meet children's needs. It does not require a smartphone connection — a good choice if you want a distraction-free, standalone device. 4G connection allows 2-way phone calls and messaging, and you'll always be in touch. This watch is waterproof, has a great battery life, and a dedicated SOS button — your kid's safety is our priority. Even more, there's 512MB of internal memory to use up for important stuff. We included 7 educational games, too, so this watch would be fun to wear! item.g:title: CANYON tracker ST-02 4G GPS Black
item.g:description: Senior Tracker ST-02 Put your worries away with Canyon ST-02 Senior Tracker. This smart device can be a big helper for older people – and keep you assured that your family members are safe. It is connected via 4G and Wi-Fi and features a one-key quick call. Location-based service allows for precise positioning; the GPS+Glonass module is also on board. You can track and tweak the device via mobile app – the access is easy and reliable. It is packed with sensors that can monitor the heart rate, body temperature, and orientation. The tracker will count steps. It will also send an alert in case of a fall. It is a reliable gadget with IP67 waterproof capabilities, a low battery alarm, voice timekeeping, and a special ringtone in case the wearer is lost. ST-02 is an excellent choice for caring about your elders! Features: Network: 4G network + 2G GSM Positioning method: GPS+Glonass+WIFI+LBS Health: heart rate, body temperature detection Step counting Waterproof grade IP67 Mobile App/SMS SOS one key for help One-key quick call Voice timekeeping Low battery alarm Ringtone to find people function Fall alarm Canyon Safetrack AI Canyon Safetrack AI is our enhanced indoor positioning system for kids smartwatches. It uses Wi-Fi access point scanning to determine location even when GPS is unavailable. AI-driven analytics filter out inaccurate signals and highlight only reliable location data. As a result, you can get more precise and stable positioning in malls, schools, and other indoor environments.
