Now with sleep apnoea notifications.◊Refer to legal disclaimers Track all your activity and workouts. Now with depth and water temperature. Get help in an emergency if you fall or are in a car crash.◊Refer to legal disclaimers Faster charging gives you 80% battery in about 30 minutes.◊Refer to legal disclaimers Straps Show your true colours. New materials, new styles, new colours, new carbon-neutral combinations.◊ Refer to legal disclaimers. Redefine your style with the latest collection of Apple Watch straps. ◊ Legal Disclaimers Display and Design: Compared with previous generations. Cellular and Wireless: Wireless service plan required for cellular service. Contact your service provider for more details. Connection may vary based on network availability. Check apple.com/watch/cellular for participating network providers and eligibility. See support.apple.com/en-gb/HT207578 for additional setup instructions. Sleep Apnoea Notifications: The Sleep Apnoea Notification Feature is available on Apple Watch Series 9 and later and Apple Watch Ultra 2. It is intended to detect signs of moderate to severe sleep apnoea for people 18 years old or older without a diagnosis of sleep apnoea. Emergency SOS: Emergency SOS requires a cellular connection or Wi-Fi calling with an internet connection from your Apple Watch or nearby iPhone. Fast Charging: Charge times are from 0-80% and 0-100% using the included Apple Watch Magnetic Fast Charger to USB-C Cable. Testing conducted by Apple in August 2024 using pre-production Apple Watch Series 10 (GPS) and Apple Watch Series 10 (GPS + Cellular), each paired with an iPhone; all devices tested with pre-release software, Apple Watch Magnetic Fast Charger to USB-C Cable (Model A2515) and Apple 20W USB-C Power Adapter (Model A2305). Fast-charge testing conducted with drained Apple Watch units. Times measured from the appearance of the Apple logo as the unit started up. Charge time varies with region, settings and environmental factors; actual results will vary. Up to 40% Brighter: When angled away from the user. ECG: The ECG app is available on Apple Watch Series 4 and later (excluding Apple Watch SE) and can generate an ECG similar to a single-lead electrocardiogram. Intended for use by people 22 years old and over. IRN (Irregular Rhythm Notification): Irregular rhythm notification requires the latest version of watchOS and iOS. It is not intended for use by people under 22 years old or those who have been previously diagnosed with atrial fibrillation (AF). Blood Oxygen: The Blood Oxygen app is for wellness purposes only and not for medical use. Vitals: The Vitals app is for wellness purposes only and not for medical use. Temperature Sensing: The temperature sensing feature is not intended for medical use. Temperature sensing is available only on Apple Watch Series 8 and later, and all Apple Watch Ultra models. Cycle Tracking: Cycle Tracking app should not be used for birth control or to diagnose a health condition. International Emergency Calling: Requires Apple Watch Series 7, Apple Watch SE, Apple Watch Ultra or later. For a list of supported countries and regions, see apple.com/watchos/feature-availability. Water and Dust Resistance: Apple Watch SE and Apple Watch Series 10 have a water resistance rating of 50 metres under ISO standard 22810:2010 and may be used for shallow-water activities like swimming in a pool or ocean. Series 10 can also be used for snorkelling to 6 metres. They should not be used for scuba diving, waterskiing or other activities involving high-velocity water or submersion below shallow depth. Apple Watch Ultra 2 has a water resistance rating of 100 metres under ISO standard 22810:2010 and may be used for high-speed water sports and recreational scuba diving (with compatible third-party app from the App Store) to 40 metres. It should not be used for diving below 40 metres. Water resistance is not a permanent condition and can diminish over time. For additional information, see support.apple.com/en-gb/HT205000. Apple Watch Series 10 and Apple Watch Ultra 2 are also rated IP6X dust resistant. Gestures: Requires Apple Watch Ultra 2 or Series 9 or later. Precision Finding for iPhone: Requires an iPhone and Apple Watch with second-generation Ultra Wideband chip. Power and Battery: Battery life varies by use and configuration. See apple.com/uk/watch/battery for more information. Carbon Neutral: Learn more at apple.com/environment. Apple Fitness+: Apple Fitness+ requires a subsc

} KW-44 Kids Watch The Canyon Jondy smartwatch is almost like a small 4G cell phone. It is so lightweight and fits perfectly on your kid's wrist. Safety was our top priority in the design of this product. This smartwatch has a frontal camera, so it supports 2-way video calls. It can receive text messages and has an anti-spam phone book. We added a GPS module so that you can track the device, thanks to the Canyon Life APP. In the unlikely case of an emergency, there's a designated SOS button. This device will be handy for its little user and is going to save you a lot of worries. Your child will love seven pre-installed games, an audio player, and a photo album. There are some basic necessities, too – a calculator, alarm, and calendar. Now let's see the numbers: the battery is 700mAh, 512Mb of storage is at your disposal, and all this is IP67 waterproof. Pretty good for your kid's first smartwatch! Always on! This device supports the 4G network. It can call and receive calls, short messages, and a 0.3MP built-in camera allows for video calls. All that in a compact form factor suitable for a child's wrist! Stay safe Keep the worries away. With the GPS module on board, you can track the device's location via the Canyon Life APP. There's an SOS button to call for help. For fun and learning We added seven pre-installed games, an audio player for music and audiobooks, and a photo album to store photos from the camera. Easy to use Child-friendly design is bright and welcoming. The device covers most of the little users

For the active South African lifestyle, the Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro offers an unparalleled fusion of advanced technology and everyday usability. This smart band is engineered for individuals who integrate fitness and wellness into the fabric of their daily lives. Whether you are navigating the bustling city streets, conquering challenging hiking trails, or diving into your next swim, this device is designed to keep pace with your every move. It provides comprehensive insights into your health and performance, empowering you to understand your body better and push your limits. Clarity and control at your fingertips, always. The ultra-narrow 2.2 mm bezels on all four sides maximise screen real estate, providing an immersive viewing experience without increasing the band’s overall footprint. With the always-on display capability, you can check the time, your heart rate, or other critical data at a glance, without needing to wake the device. This seamless accessibility ensures that important information is always readily available, fitting effortlessly into your dynamic routine. Unrivalled fitness tracking for every pursuit. Equipped with over 150 sports modes, the Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro is your ultimate fitness partner. From running and cycling to swimming and yoga, it meticulously records your performance metrics. The inclusion of underwater heart rate detection means your swimming sessions are tracked with unparalleled accuracy, offering a complete picture of your aquatic workouts. This detailed tracking empowers you to analyse your progress, identify areas for improvement, and celebrate every milestone achieved on your fitness journey. This fitness tracker truly supports every active pursuit. Comprehensive health monitoring, day and night. Beyond its fitness capabilities, this smart band serves as a vigilant guardian of your well-being. It provides professional sleep monitoring, offering deep insights into your sleep patterns to help you achieve more restful nights. Continuous heart rate monitoring keeps you informed about your cardiovascular health, while blood oxygen (SpO2) and stress level tracking offer a holistic view of your body’s state. These advanced health monitoring features allow you to proactively manage your wellness and make informed decisions about your lifestyle. This AMOLED smart band ensures you are always in tune with your body. Engineered for endurance and elegance. Crafted with a high-strength aluminium alloy middle frame and a lightweight design, the Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro is built to withstand the rigours of daily life. Its 5ATM water resistance rating means you can wear it confidently during swims, showers, or even in heavy rain, without concern for water damage. The extended battery life of up to 21 days in regular mode, and up to 7 days with the always-on display enabled, minimises the need for frequent charging, ensuring your band is always ready when you are. item.g:title: Giada DN24 Rasberry Pi Dual-HDMI ARM Multimedia Player (CM4 Lite | 2GB | 32GB eMMC)
item.g:description: Seamlessly integrate your digital content and control complex systems with dual 4K HDMI outputs, powered by the reliable Raspberry Pi CM4. Quick Specs Experience vibrant visuals with dual HDMI 2.0 outputs, capable of delivering up to 4K resolution at 60Hz. Power through demanding tasks with the quad-core Cortex-A72 processor and 2GB LPDDR4 RAM. Benefit from reliable onboard storage with 32GB eMMC, expandable for your needs. Connect with confidence using Gigabit Ethernet and onboard dual-band Wi-Fi/Bluetooth. Built for durability with a robust metal construction and designed for operating temperatures of 0°C to 45°C. For the discerning South African user demanding robust multimedia and control solutions The Giada DN24, powered by the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 Lite, is more than a barebone system; it is a sophisticated engine for digital displays and commercial signage. It serves those who require unwavering reliability and the flexibility to adapt. Whether you are orchestrating complex digital advertising campaigns or building custom embedded solutions, this device provides the stable foundation necessary for your vision. Its design prioritises performance and longevity, ensuring it operates efficiently within the demanding environments common in South Africa. This digital signage player is engineered for impact. Uncompromised visual output for impactful presentations At the core of the DN24's capability lies its dual HDMI 2.0 interfaces. item.g:title: Cudy N300 2.4GHz Wi-Fi Router
item.g:description: Experience reliable 2.4GHz Wi-Fi for seamless browsing and streaming | Versatile modes to fit your home networking needs. Quick Specs Achieve consistent internet speeds with 300 Mbps wireless N technology. Connect multiple devices with dual fixed antennas for extended Wi-Fi coverage. Enjoy easy setup and management via Windows, macOS, Android, or iOS devices. A foundation of reliable connectivity for every South African home The Cudy N300 is engineered for the modern household that demands stability without unnecessary complexity. It is designed for users who need a dependable internet connection for everyday tasks, from essential browsing and email to streaming your favourite shows and connecting with family. This 2.4 GHz wireless router is not for those seeking bleeding-edge speeds for extreme gaming or massive file transfers, but for individuals and families who value a consistently performing network. Its straightforward operation and versatile functionality make it an ideal choice for apartments, smaller homes, or as a supplementary network solution where a solid 2.4GHz connection is paramount. Unwavering performance for your daily digital life At its core, the Cudy N300 delivers a stable 300 Mbps wireless N connection. This speed is perfectly suited for a multitude of daily activities: it provides enough bandwidth for smooth video streaming on platforms like Netflix and YouTube, allows for clear video calls with loved ones, and supports responsive online browsing. The inclusion of two fixed omni-directional antennas ensures that this performance is distributed effectively throughout your space, minimising dead spots and providing a more uniform signal strength. This focus on consistent delivery means fewer interruptions and a more enjoyable online experience for everyone connected. The Cudy N300 router ensures your connection remains robust. Adaptability to suit your evolving network requirements The true strength of the Cudy N300 lies in its remarkable flexibility. Beyond its primary function as a router, it seamlessly transitions into several other essential roles. Use it as an Access Point (AP) to expand an existing wired network wirelessly; configure it as a Repeater (RE) to boost the signal of another router; employ its WISP mode to connect to a public Wi-Fi hotspot and share it across your devices; or integrate it into a Mesh Wi-Fi network as a Satellite to enhance coverage. This multi-functional design ensures that the N300 can adapt to your changing needs, offering a cost-effective and versatile networking solution that grows with your household. This mesh Wi-Fi capability extends your network's reach. Security and ease of use, built-in Your online safety is a priority. The Cudy N300 employs industry-standard WPA-PSK and WPA2-PSK encryption, safeguarding your network from unauthorised access and protecting your sensitive data. Setting up and managing your network is also remarkably simple. With compatibility across Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS, you can easily configure settings, manage connected devices, and monitor your network performance from virtually any device. The inclusion of a WPS button further simplifies the connection of compatible devices, offering a quick and secure way to join your network. This reliable 2.4 GHz wireless router prioritises your security. Future-ready connectivity with advanced protocol support While rooted in the reliable 2.4GHz band, the Cudy N300 is equipped with advanced features that cater to more demanding users. It supports both IPv4 and IPv6 internet protocols, ensuring compatibility with the evolving internet landscape. For those who utilise VPN services, the integrated VPN Client supporting WireGuard and OpenVPN provides a secure tunnel for your internet traffic. Additionally, features like VLAN support for IPTV and a dedicated Guest Network allow for segmenting your network, enhancing security and managing access for visitors effectively. Powered by the AMD Ryzen™ 5 150 6-core processor with boost speeds of up to 4.55GHz, this machine delivers exceptional responsiveness for modern gaming, multitasking, and content creation. Whether you’re diving into competitive titles or handling demanding workloads, the combination of 16GB DDR5 RAM and a lightning-fast 512GB NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD ensures rapid load times, seamless multitasking, and efficient data access. Preloaded with Windows 11 Home, the Nitro V 15 offers a refined and user-friendly experience tailored for productivity and play. Visual performance is taken to the next level with a stunning 15.6-inch FHD (1920 x 1080) IPS display featuring a blazing-fast 165Hz refresh rate and Acer ComfyView technology, reducing glare for long gaming sessions. The inclusion of the NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5050 GPU with 8GB GDDR7 memory unlocks cutting-edge graphics capabilities, including Ray Tracing, DLSS 4.5, and Max-Q technologies, delivering ultra-realistic visuals and AI-enhanced frame rates. Built for South African gamers who value both performance and connectivity, the Nitro V 15 features tri-band Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax), Gigabit LAN, and ultra-fast USB4 connectivity up to 40Gbps, ensuring stable online gameplay and rapid data transfers. With dual-fan cooling and dual air intake, the system remains cool under pressure, making it ideal for extended gaming sessions. Designed with practicality and immersion in mind, the Nitro V 15 includes AI-enhanced microphones and webcam features, delivering clearer communication for streaming, meetings, or online gaming. Its backlit keyboard with amber lighting adds a stylish gaming aesthetic while maintaining usability in low-light environments. Acer’s Nitro series is renowned for offering high-performance gaming hardware at competitive value, making it a strong choice for gamers looking to maximise performance without compromise. Whether you’re upgrading your current setup or entering the gaming world, this laptop delivers the speed, visuals, and reliability needed to stay ahead. item.g:title: Acer NITRO V 15 Gaming Laptop 15.6″ | AMD Ryzen 7 | 16GB | 512GB | RTX 5060 8GB | Windows 11 Home
item.g:description: [embed]https://youtu.be/UuTKnDK6QOc[/embed] The Acer NITRO V 15 Gaming Laptop is engineered for gamers and creators who demand reliable power, smooth visuals, and next-generation performance in a sleek, portable design. Powered by the AMD Ryzen™ 7 170 8-core processor with boost speeds of up to 4.75GHz, this machine delivers exceptional responsiveness for modern gaming, multitasking, and content creation. Whether you’re diving into competitive titles or handling demanding workloads, the combination of 16GB DDR5 RAM and a lightning-fast 512GB NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD ensures rapid load times, seamless multitasking, and efficient data access. Preloaded with Windows 11 Home, the Nitro V 15 offers a refined and user-friendly experience tailored for productivity and play. Visual performance is taken to the next level with a stunning 15.6-inch FHD (1920 x 1080) IPS display featuring a blazing-fast 165Hz refresh rate and Acer ComfyView technology, reducing glare for long gaming sessions. The inclusion of the NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 GPU with 8GB GDDR7 memory unlocks cutting-edge graphics capabilities, including Ray Tracing, DLSS 4.5, and Max-Q technologies, delivering ultra-realistic visuals and AI-enhanced frame rates. Built for South African gamers who value both performance and connectivity, the Nitro V 15 features tri-band Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax), Gigabit LAN, and ultra-fast USB4 connectivity up to 40Gbps, ensuring stable online gameplay and rapid data transfers. With dual-fan cooling and dual air intake, the system remains cool under pressure, making it ideal for extended gaming sessions. Designed with practicality and immersion in mind, the Nitro V 15 includes AI-enhanced microphones and webcam features, delivering clearer communication for streaming, meetings, or online gaming. Its backlit keyboard with amber lighting adds a stylish gaming aesthetic while maintaining usability in low-light environments. Acer’s Nitro series is renowned for offering high-performance gaming hardware at competitive value, making it a strong choice for gamers looking to maximise performance without compromise. Whether you’re upgrading your current setup or entering the gaming world, this laptop delivers the speed, visuals, and reliability needed to stay ahead. item.g:title: UGREEN FineTrack Mini Smart Finder for Apple Devices
item.g:description: Locate your essentials across South Africa with the seamless Apple Find My network; attach it to your keys, bag, or anything you can't afford to lose. Quick Specs Effortlessly locate your items using the vast Apple Find My network, offering global tracking. Benefit from up to 18 months of battery life with a easily replaceable CR2032 battery. Receive immediate alerts if you leave your valuables behind, ensuring peace of mind. Enjoy a clear, audible alert of up to 80dB to help pinpoint your lost item. Integrates directly with your Apple devices for simple setup and management via the Find My app. For the vigilant South African who values peace of mind, the UGREEN FineTrack Mini Smart Finder offers an elegant solution to the age-old problem of misplaced belongings. This is not a device that merely beeps; it is an extension of your awareness, designed to integrate seamlessly into your Apple ecosystem. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, the sprawling landscapes of the Karoo, or simply managing the daily rhythm of home, this key finder provides a reliable tether to your most important possessions. It is for the individual who understands that time spent searching is time lost, and who seeks a smart, intuitive tool to safeguard their valuables. This finder is built for a life in motion, ensuring your keys, wallet, or backpack remain precisely where you last placed them, or can be swiftly recovered if they are not. Leveraging the immense power and reach of Apple's Find My network, the UGREEN FineTrack operates differently from a standard Bluetooth tracker. Unlike standalone trackers with limited Bluetooth range, this mini smart finder can be located anywhere an Apple device can connect. If your item is out of your immediate vicinity, it silently and securely reports its location through the millions of Apple devices worldwide, all while maintaining your privacy and Apple's robust encryption. This global network transforms a simple accessory into a powerful recovery tool, offering a level of security and convenience previously unattainable for items outside your direct line of sight. Crafted with a compact form factor, approximately 3.2 cm in diameter, the FineTrack is unobtrusive yet robust. Its design prioritises both functionality and discretion, ensuring it complements rather than complicates your belongings. The included silicone holder provides a secure and adaptable mounting solution, allowing you to attach it effortlessly to keyrings, luggage zippers, or even pet collars. Furthermore, the replaceable CR2032 coin cell battery ensures that this vigilance can continue for up to 18 months on a single charge, with battery levels conveniently monitored within the Apple Find My app, so you are never caught unprepared. Setup is as straightforward as attaching the FineTrack to your item and pairing it directly through the Apple Find My app on your iPhone or iPad. Once linked, you can trigger an audible alarm of up to 80dB to help you track my iPhone and locate nearby items or utilise the power of the Find My network for broader searches. Left-behind alerts notify you promptly if you move away from your tagged item, preventing accidental loss before it happens. Voice commands via Siri further enhance its utility, allowing for hands-free operation. UGREEN understands that the security of your belongings extends to the privacy of your location data. The FineTrack operates within Apple's secure Find My network, employing end-to-end encryption to ensure that only you can see the location of your item. Unwanted tracking is actively discouraged through Apple's privacy features, providing a secure and trustworthy solution for safeguarding your valuables without compromising your personal information. Features Pinpoint your lost items globally using the secure and expansive Apple Find My network, making it an essential key finder. Enjoy extended peace of mind with a battery life of up to 18 months, easily replaceable, ensuring your Bluetooth tracker is always ready. Prevent accidental loss with intelligent left-behind alerts sent directly to your Apple device, helping you track my iPhone. Quickly locate nearby items with a powerful 80dB alarm that cuts through ambient noise. Integrate effortlessly with your existing Apple devices and manage all your trackers within the intuitive Find My app. Secure your privacy with Apple's end-to-end encrypted location protection, ensuring only you can track your item. Attach your finder discreetly and securely to any item using the included silicone holder, perfect for keys and bags. Specifications Form Factor: Mini Smart Tracker Tag Compatibility: Apple Find My (iOS only) Supported Operating Systems: iOS/iPadOS 14.5 or later, macOS 12.5 or later Connectivity: Bluetooth Bluetooth Network Support: Apple Find My network Tracking Coverage: Global tracking via nearby A

Plug and Play simplicity means no drivers or external power required. Benefit from faster data transfers with UASP support. Works seamlessly with Windows, macOS, Linux, and ChromeOS devices. Master Your Storage with the UGREEN USB-C to 2.5" SATA Adapter Cable For the discerning South African user who demands efficiency and simplicity in their digital workflow, this UGREEN adapter cable is an indispensable tool. It bridges the gap between your legacy 2.5-inch SATA drives and the modern connectivity of USB Type-C ports found on laptops, desktops, and other devices. Whether you are a creative professional needing to access large project files quickly, a student managing vast amounts of research data, or a home user looking to back up precious memories, this USB Type-C SATA adapter provides a direct, high-speed conduit to your data. Its robust design and advanced chipset ensure reliable performance for data recovery, system upgrades, and expanding your storage capacity without the bulk of traditional enclosures. Experience the ease of a 2.5 HDD SATA connector designed for modern computing. Effortless Connectivity for All Your Drives The core of this device is its intelligent design, which eliminates the need for complex installations or power adapters. Simply connect your 2.5-inch SATA Hard Disk Drive (HDD) or Solid State Drive (SSD) to the SATA connector on the cable, and then plug the USB Type-C end into your computer. The cable is bus-powered, drawing all the necessary energy directly from the USB port. This plug-and-play functionality, coupled with hot-swap support, means you can connect and disconnect drives on the fly, making it ideal for dynamic workflows and urgent data access needs. This USB Type-C to SATA converter ensures your data is always accessible. Optimised for Speed and Reliability Experience a significant leap in data transfer performance thanks to the USB 3.0 (also known as USB 3.1 Gen 1) Type-C interface, capable of speeds up to 5Gbps. This speed is further enhanced by the UASP (USB Attached SCSI Protocol) support, which significantly reduces latency and increases throughput for compatible operating systems and drives. The SATA III interface on the cable itself supports up to 6Gbps, ensuring that the drive's potential is not bottlenecked by the connection. For those using SSDs, TRIM support is also included, which helps maintain optimal performance over time. A Versatile Solution for Modern Computing This UGREEN adapter cable is not merely an adapter; it is a comprehensive solution for managing your storage needs. Its 50cm integrated cable length provides ample room to manoeuvre without excess clutter. The built-in ASM1153E chipset is known for its stability and compatibility across a wide range of operating systems, including Windows, macOS, Linux, and ChromeOS. The inclusion of S.M.A.R.T. monitoring support allows you to keep an eye on your drive's health, while the auto-sleep function conserves energy when the drive is inactive. item.g:description: Designed to empower seamless collaboration, high-speed access, and enterprise-level data security, the UGREEN NASync DXP2800 2 Bay NAS is a purpose-built solution for professionals and teams managing large, mission-critical files across networked environments. As a dedicated network-attached storage (NAS) system, this device enables users across the same network, whether in a creative agency, architecture firm, remote working setup, or IT department, to access, store, and collaborate on data continuously and securely. The centralised storage model eliminates file version conflicts and bottlenecks, ensuring that teams operate from a single source of truth. Built on a powerful 12th Gen Intel® N100 processor with 4 cores and 4 threads, the UGREEN NASync DXP2800 2 Bay NAS delivers responsive multi-user performance. With a powerful combination of CMR technology, AgileArray™ firmware, and IronWolf Health Management, this drive ensures 24×7 operational readiness, optimized RAID performance, and proactive drive monitoring for superior data integrity. With RV sensors, dual-plane balance, and error recovery control, it maintains consistent performance in high-vibration, multi-drive environments, preventing mechanical strain and enhancing system longevity. It is designed for those who value their time and demand a seamless transition between tasks, ensuring that productivity is never compromised by hardware limitations. For the South African user seeking to optimise their setup, this HDMI KVM switch represents a significant upgrade in operational efficiency and desk space management. Furthermore, the device features a power memory function, meaning that if power is interrupted, it will automatically revert to the last selected input source once power is restored. This ensures continuity and reduces the need for manual reconfiguration, a vital feature for uninterrupted work sessions or gaming marathons. Designed for diverse environments and operating systems Universality is key in today's interconnected world. The UGREEN 2 In 1 Out HDMI KVM Switch is engineered for broad compatibility, supporting a wide array of operating systems including Windows (XP through 11), macOS, Linux, and Chrome OS. Its robust plastic construction and compact dimensions ensure durability and easy placement, making it a practical and reliable addition to any setup. item.g:title: Xiaomi Tag Bluetooth Smart Tracker White – (1 Pack)
item.g:description: Keys, wallet, backpack, check-in bag — attach a Xiaomi Tag and stop retracing your steps. It works with Apple Find My or Google Find Hub, rings out loud when your item is nearby, and shows you where it was last seen when it isn't. Quick Specs Works with your choice of Apple Find My or Google Find Hub at setup Rings a built-in buzzer so you can follow the sound to nearby items Shows last-seen location on a map, updated by passing phones on your network Over a year of use from a replaceable CR2032 battery IP67 dust and water resistance, with a keyring loop built into the body Everything you own, easier to find We have all done it. Keys down on an unfamiliar counter, wallet left in a jacket, the laptop bag that was definitely in the boot. The Xiaomi Tag is a small, 10 g Bluetooth finder that clips onto the things you misplace most — keys, wallets, handbags, backpacks, camera bags, remotes and check-in luggage — so finding them takes seconds instead of an afternoon. How the Xiaomi Tag finds your things When your item is close by, open the app and ring the Tag's built-in buzzer, then follow the sound. When it isn't, the Tag's encrypted Bluetooth signal is picked up by passing phones on your chosen finding network, which quietly update its position on your map. That makes it very good at answering "where did I last have it" — the coffee shop, the gym, the seat pocket on the flight. The Xiaomi Tag is a Bluetooth item finder rather than a GPS tracker, so it shows you where something was last seen instead of streaming a live position. It is the right tool for everyday belongings, and location updates are quickest in busy places where plenty of phones pass by. Your choice of the world's two biggest finding networks Most trackers lock you into one ecosystem. The Xiaomi Tag doesn't. During setup you choose Apple Find My or Google Find Hub, and the Tag then draws on the millions of devices already on that network to report back. Apple users get the network built into every iPhone and iPad; Android users get Find Hub, which reaches Android 9 devices and later — a genuine advantage in South Africa, where Android dominates. The two networks operate independently, so you pick one at setup rather than running both. Built to be forgotten about Attach it once and leave it. The keyring loop is moulded into the body, so there is no separate holder to buy. IP67 dust and water resistance handles rain, spills and a soaking, and at 7.2 mm thin it disappears into a bag or pocket. The replaceable CR2032 button cell runs for over a year, and when it does run low, you swap it in seconds rather than replacing the whole Tag. Privacy that works both ways Location data is end-to-end encrypted and visible only to you and the people you choose to share with through Family & Friend Sharing. The Tag also supports unwanted-tracking alerts through Apple and Google's safety systems, so if an unknown Tag travels with someone, their phone lets them know. Mark an item as lost and a finder can get your contact details — by tapping the Tag with NFC on Apple Find My, or through a Find Hub prompt on Android. Features Choose Apple Find My or Google Find Hub as your finding network during setup Ring the built-in piezoelectric buzzer to locate items within Bluetooth range View your item's last-seen location on a map, updated by nearby network devices Left-behind alerts warn you when you walk away without your item (Apple Find My) Share item locations with family and friends for collaborative finding End-to-end encrypted location data, visible only to you NFC Lost Mode for easy return of found items (Apple Find My) Unwanted-tracking alerts help protect against being followed by an unknown Tag IP67 dust and water resistance for everyday conditions Over a year of battery life from a user-replaceable CR2032 button cell Keyring loop built into the body — no extra holder required Compatible with iOS 14.5 / iPadOS 14.5 or later, and Android 9 or later Specifications Product Type: Bluetooth Item Finder Connectivity: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) v5.4 Finding Networks: Apple Find My or Google Find Hub (one selected at setup) Positioning: Last-seen location via finding network — no GPS or cellular Left-Behind Alerts: Supported on Apple Find My Item Sharing: Family & Friend Sharing Privacy Protection: End-to-end encrypted location data NFC Support: Lost Mode (Apple Find My) Dust & Water Resistance: IP67 Battery Type: Replaceable CR2032 button cell Battery Life: Over 1 year in typical use Speaker: Built-in piezoelectric buzzer Sensor: Accelerometer Attachment: Integrated keyring loop Compatibility: iOS 14.5 / iPadOS 14.5 or later; Android 9 or later Colour: White Product Weight: 10 g Product Dimensions: 4.65 × 3.1 × 0.72 cm What's in the Box Xiaomi Tag Bluetooth Smart Tracker ×1 User manual ×1 FAQ's Is the Xiaomi Tag a GPS tracker? item.g:title: Xiaomi Tag Bluetooth Smart Tracker White – (4 Pack)
item.g:description: Keys, wallet, backpack, check-in bag — attach a Xiaomi Tag and stop retracing your steps. It works with Apple Find My or Google Find Hub, rings out loud when your item is nearby, and shows you where it was last seen when it isn’t. Quick Specs Works with your choice of Apple Find My or Google Find Hub at setup Rings a built-in buzzer so you can follow the sound to nearby items Shows last-seen location on a map, updated by passing phones on your network Over a year of use from a replaceable CR2032 battery IP67 dust and water resistance, with a keyring loop built into the body Everything you own, easier to find We have all done it. Keys down on an unfamiliar counter, wallet left in a jacket, the laptop bag that was definitely in the boot. The Xiaomi Tag is a small, 10 g Bluetooth finder that clips onto the things you misplace most — keys, wallets, handbags, backpacks, camera bags, remotes and check-in luggage — so finding them takes seconds instead of an afternoon. How the Xiaomi Tag finds your things When your item is close by, open the app and ring the Tag’s built-in buzzer, then follow the sound. When it isn’t, the Tag’s encrypted Bluetooth signal is picked up by passing phones on your chosen finding network, which quietly update its position on your map. That makes it very good at answering “where did I last have it” — the coffee shop, the gym, the seat pocket on the flight. The Xiaomi Tag is a Bluetooth item finder rather than a GPS tracker, so it shows you where something was last seen instead of streaming a live position. It is the right tool for everyday belongings, and location updates are quickest in busy places where plenty of phones pass by. Your choice of the world’s two biggest finding networks Most trackers lock you into one ecosystem. The Xiaomi Tag doesn’t. During setup you choose Apple Find My or Google Find Hub, and the Tag then draws on the millions of devices already on that network to report back. Apple users get the network built into every iPhone and iPad; Android users get Find Hub, which reaches Android 9 devices and later — a genuine advantage in South Africa, where Android dominates. The two networks operate independently, so you pick one at setup rather than running both. Built to be forgotten about Attach it once and leave it. The keyring loop is moulded into the body, so there is no separate holder to buy. IP67 dust and water resistance handles rain, spills and a soaking, and at 7.2 mm thin it disappears into a bag or pocket. The replaceable CR2032 button cell runs for over a year, and when it does run low, you swap it in seconds rather than replacing the whole Tag. Privacy that works both ways Location data is end-to-end encrypted and visible only to you and the people you choose to share with through Family & Friend Sharing. The Tag also supports unwanted-tracking alerts through Apple and Google’s safety systems, so if an unknown Tag travels with someone, their phone lets them know. Mark an item as lost and a finder can get your contact details — by tapping the Tag with NFC on Apple Find My, or through a Find Hub prompt on Android. Features Choose Apple Find My or Google Find Hub as your finding network during setup Ring the built-in piezoelectric buzzer to locate items within Bluetooth range View your item’s last-seen location on a map, updated by nearby network devices Left-behind alerts warn you when you walk away without your item (Apple Find My) Share item locations with family and friends for collaborative finding End-to-end encrypted location data, visible only to you NFC Lost Mode for easy return of found items (Apple Find My) Unwanted-tracking alerts help protect against being followed by an unknown Tag IP67 dust and water resistance for everyday conditions Over a year of battery life from a user-replaceable CR2032 button cell Keyring loop built into the body — no extra holder required Compatible with iOS 14.5 / iPadOS 14.5 or later, and Android 9 or later Specifications Product Type: Bluetooth Item Finder Connectivity: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) v5.4 Finding Networks: Apple Find My or Google Find Hub (one selected at setup) Positioning: Last-seen location via finding network — no GPS or cellular Left-Behind Alerts: Supported on Apple Find My Item Sharing: Family & Friend Sharing Privacy Protection: End-to-end encrypted location data NFC Support: Lost Mode (Apple Find My) Dust & Water Resistance: IP67 Battery Type: Replaceable CR2032 button cell Battery Life: Over 1 year in typical use Speaker: Built-in piezoelectric buzzer Sensor: Accelerometer Attachment: Integrated keyring loop Compatibility: iOS 14.5 / iPadOS 14.5 or later; Android 9 or later Colour: White Product Weight: 10 g Product Dimensions: 4.65 × 3.1 × 0.72 cm What’s in the Box Xiaomi Tag Bluetooth Smart Tracker ×4 User manual ×1 FAQ’s Is the Xiaomi Tag a GPS tracker? item.g:title: Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE Whole-Home Wi-Fi 6 Router (1-Pack) – White
item.g:description: Eliminate dead zones and experience uninterrupted, high-speed Wi-Fi 6 throughout your entire home with seamless roaming and AX3000 speeds. Quick Specs Eliminate Wi-Fi dead zones with powerful mesh technology for consistent coverage. Experience blazing-fast Wi-Fi 6 speeds up to 3000Mbps for all your devices. Enjoy seamless roaming as you move through your home without connection drops. Connect more devices simultaneously thanks to advanced OFDMA technology. Set up your entire mesh network effortlessly with the user-friendly Xiaomi Home app. Unite your home with unwavering Wi-Fi 6 In today's connected world, a single router often struggles to reach every corner of your home. The Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE is engineered to solve this, providing a unified, high-performance Wi-Fi 6 network that blankets your entire living space. This isn't merely an upgrade; it's a transformation of your digital experience, ensuring that from the furthest bedroom to the busiest home office, you have the stable, high-speed connection you demand. It is designed for the modern South African household that relies on seamless connectivity for work, entertainment, and everyday life. For those who value uninterrupted streaming, lag-free gaming, and reliable video calls, this whole home Wi-Fi system is the definitive solution. Experience the power of AX3000 Wi-Fi 6 The AX3000 rating signifies a combined theoretical wireless speed of up to 3000Mbps, delivered across both the 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands. This dual-band capability ensures optimal performance for a wide array of devices. The 5GHz band, reaching up to 2402Mbps with a 160MHz channel width, is ideal for bandwidth-intensive tasks like 4K streaming and online gaming. The 2.4GHz band, offering speeds up to 574Mbps, provides broader coverage and better penetration through walls, ensuring even distant devices maintain a stable connection. This intelligent speed distribution ensures that your network resources are used efficiently, providing a responsive experience for every user and every application on this dual band mesh Wi-Fi. Seamless roaming, total freedom Forget the frustration of dropped connections as you move between rooms. The Xiaomi Mesh System employs sophisticated seamless roaming technology, allowing your devices to automatically connect to the strongest signal source without interruption. This means your video calls remain clear, your music doesn't skip, and your online games stay active as you transition throughout your home. This feature is crucial for maintaining productivity and enjoyment, creating a truly unified network experience where the only thing that changes is your location, not your connection quality. It’s the freedom to move and stay connected. Intelligent networking for a demanding world Beyond raw speed, the AX3000 NE integrates advanced Wi-Fi 6 technologies designed to enhance network efficiency and capacity. OFDMA (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access) allows the router to communicate with multiple devices simultaneously on the same channel, significantly reducing latency and improving overall network performance, especially in environments with many connected devices. Beamforming technology focuses the Wi-Fi signal directly towards your connected devices, strengthening the connection and improving range. BSS Colouring further optimises performance by reducing interference between neighbouring networks, ensuring a cleaner signal for your devices. Effortless setup and management Setting up a comprehensive mesh network has never been simpler. The Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE is designed for intuitive installation. Simply connect the primary router to your modem, power it on, and let the Xiaomi Home app guide you through the rest of the process. Adding additional compatible mesh nodes is equally straightforward, ensuring your entire home is covered in minutes. Through the Xiaomi Home app, you gain full control over your network, including parental controls, guest network management, and QoS settings, all from your smartphone. Remote network management capabilities mean you can monitor and adjust your network from anywhere, providing peace of mind and complete control. Features Achieve comprehensive whole-home coverage, eliminating Wi-Fi dead zones with robust mesh technology for your whole home Wi-Fi. Experience lightning-fast internet speeds with Wi-Fi 6 AX3000, supporting up to 3000Mbps for all your streaming, gaming, and browsing needs. Enjoy uninterrupted connectivity as you move around your home, thanks to seamless roaming between mesh nodes. Connect a greater number of devices simultaneously and efficiently with advanced OFDMA technology. Benefit from enhanced signal strength and range through intelligent Beamforming technology. item.g:title: Port Designs Milano II Eco 13/14" Universal Laptop Sleeve - Plush Pink
item.g:description: Shield your 13" or 14" laptop with the refined corduroy exterior and soft, eco-friendly interior of the Port Designs Milano II sleeve. Quick Specs Guard your device with durable, eco-conscious materials. Accommodates both 13-inch and 14-inch laptops seamlessly. Slim profile at only 2.2cm thick to easily fit into larger bags. Lightweight design at 235g to minimise carrying burden. Elegant plush pink colourway and textured corduroy finish for a sophisticated look. For the discerning professional on the move in South Africa, the Port Designs Milano II Eco laptop sleeve offers more than mere protection; it presents a statement of conscious style and practical defence for your laptop. This laptop sleeve is crafted for the individual who values both the integrity of their technology and the aesthetic of their accessories. Whether you are commuting to your office, attending client meetings, or travelling between campuses, this sleeve ensures your essential device remains shielded from the rigours of daily transit. It is designed not just to hold a laptop, but to complement a professional lifestyle, blending durability with a refined appearance that speaks to attention to detail and an appreciation for quality materials. For those who demand reliability without sacrificing elegance, this laptop sleeve is the definitive choice, offering superior protection. Sophisticated defence meets eco-conscious design The exterior of the Milano II Eco sleeve is fashioned from resilient corduroy, offering a unique textured finish that not only looks distinguished but also provides a superior grip, reducing the chance of accidental slips. This is complemented by an interior lined with soft, eco-T cloth fabric. This material is specifically chosen for its gentle touch, ensuring that your laptop’s screen and casing are protected from scratches and minor abrasions. This thoughtful combination of materials creates a protective cocoon for your device, combining tactile elegance with robust defence against the everyday challenges of portability. Engineered for universal compatibility and ease of transport Understanding the diverse needs of laptop users, the Port Designs Milano II Eco sleeve is intelligently designed to accommodate a wide range of 13-inch and 14-inch laptops. Its internal dimensions are meticulously measured at 34.5 x 24.5 x 2.5 cm, providing a snug yet accessible fit for most popular models. The overall product dimensions of 38 x 26.5 x 2.2 cm ensure that while offering ample protection, the sleeve maintains a slim and streamlined profile. Weighing a mere 235g, it adds negligible bulk, allowing it to be easily slipped into a larger backpack, briefcase, or tote bag without adding unnecessary weight or size to your daily carry. This makes it an ideal laptop sleeve for daily commutes. A commitment to sustainable style Port Designs recognises the growing importance of environmental responsibility. The Milano II Eco sleeve embodies this commitment through its thoughtful material selection, featuring eco-friendly components that reduce environmental impact without compromising on performance or aesthetics. The use of eco-T cloth fabric is a testament to this philosophy. This approach ensures that your choice of accessory aligns with a more sustainable future, offering you peace of mind alongside excellent protection for your valuable technology. This sleeve represents a fusion of modern functionality and eco-conscious values, a truly exceptional laptop sleeve. FEATURES: Safeguard your laptop with a protective corduroy exterior that offers both durability and a refined texture, making it a superior laptop sleeve. Protect your device's finish and screen with a soft, scratch-resistant eco-T cloth fabric lining, ensuring peace of mind for your 13 or 14-inch laptop sleeve. Ensure a perfect fit for your 13-inch or 14-inch laptop with precisely engineered internal dimensions, creating a secure environment for your device. Maintain a sleek profile and effortless portability due to the slim 2.2cm thickness and lightweight 235g design. Carry with confidence using the elegant plush pink colour and sophisticated corduroy finish, ideal for professional environments. Instantly transform your desk into a haven of productivity with this all-in-one desktop PC that’s designed to meet your needs, whether you’re working from home, attending virtual meetings, or enjoying your favourite shows. Equipped with the efficient 12th Generation Intel Core i5-12400, 16GB of DDR5 memory, and a Gen4 1TB SSD so you can do more of what you enjoy, whenever you want to. This all-in-one desktop PC is built for exceptional reliability and efficiency, to ensure smooth and fast performance for all your multitasking needs. With a stunning Full HD 24-inch adjustable screen, the PCBuilder FUSION all-in-one desktop PC allows you to swivel and tilt for the perfect viewing angle. Immediately jump into a video call with your team with the built-in 2K 78° webcam, while the integrated speakers and dual microphones let your voice shine through without any awkward setup. You can jump right into the conversation, making it easy to collaborate and connect without missing a beat. The FUSION’s space-saving design doesn’t just look sleek; it also helps you reclaim your desk. With no need for a bulky tower, everything you need is built into this compact unit, perfect for those who enjoy a clean, minimalist setup. Plus, the adjustable stand allows you to customise the height, ensuring comfort whether you’re typing away or binge-watching your favourite series. This all-in-one desktop PC is perfect for small spaces, as it provides all the power of a traditional desktop without the clutter. Connectivity is a breeze with integrated Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and high-speed Gigabit LAN. You can connect additional screens via HDMI or VGA to create a more expansive workspace. Imagine effortlessly dragging files between screens while attending an online conference. You can redefine your productivity with smoother multitasking. What’s more, the PCBuilder FUSION all-in-one desktop PC comes with a silent wireless keyboard and mouse combo, so you can start working the moment you unbox it. No tangled wires or extra accessories cluttering your space – just seamless functionality at your fingertips. Whether you’re someone looking for an all-inclusive pc setup or a professional attending meetings from home, the PCBuilder FUSION 24″ AiO Desktop PC makes it easy to stay organised and efficient. Embrace the future of computing with this space-saving, all-in-one desktop PC, where innovation meets convenience, and transform the way you work and play today! item.g:title: Port Designs Milano II ECO 14/16″ Totepack – Blush Pink
item.g:description: 16L Capacity | Totepack-to-Backpack Design | Fits Laptops up to 16″ | Recycled r-PET Eco Lining | Corduroy Exterior | Trolley Strap Quick Specs Switch effortlessly between a totepack and a backpack with hideaway shoulder straps. Protect your device in a padded compartment sized for laptops up to 16″. Organise 16L of everyday essentials across numerous pockets and storage spaces. Glide through travel days with a trolley strap that slips over rolling luggage handles. Carry consciously with an eco-friendly lining made from recycled r-PET polyester. Designed in Paris for the way South Africans live, work, and commute, the Port Designs Milano II ECO is two bags in one. Whether you’re heading to the office, a campus lecture, or a weekend away, this convertible laptop bag adapts to your day. Grab the two padded top handles for a quick hand-carry, then release the hideaway shoulder straps when you’ve got further to go — all wrapped in an elegant, hard-wearing corduroy exterior that looks as good as it lasts. Smart storage that keeps your day organised. The roomy 16L main compartment houses a padded sleeve that fits laptops up to 16″, while a wide front quick-access pocket and multiple interior storage spaces keep your charger, cables, notebook and daily essentials exactly where you need them. Two side pockets hold a water bottle or umbrella, and the rear trolley strap makes this the ideal laptop backpack for travel. Built to last, made responsibly. A durable corduroy and water-repellent 600D polyester shell stands up to daily use, gunmetal-finish zips add a refined touch, and the interior is lined with 210D recycled r-PET — made from recycled and recyclable materials. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, it’s a sustainable laptop bag built to go the distance. Features Converts from a totepack to a backpack thanks to two padded top handles and hideaway shoulder straps. 16L capacity with a padded compartment that fits laptops up to 16″ (37 × 26 × 3 cm). Wide front quick-access pocket plus multiple interior storage spaces for everyday organisation. Two outer side pockets for a water bottle or umbrella, and a trolley strap for rolling luggage. Elegant, durable corduroy exterior with an eco-friendly recycled r-PET lining. With design rooted in Paris, Port Designs blends French style with everyday practicality to create laptop bags and backpacks made for modern life. The Milano II ECO reflects that ethos — combining sustainable materials, thoughtful storage and lasting build quality in a laptop backpack that South Africans can rely on day after day.

item.g:title: PCBuilder CUBE Intel Core 3-100U 16GB DDR5 512GB Windows 11 Pro Mini PC
item.g:description: QUICK SPEC: PCBuilder CUBE Mini PC Intel® Core 3-100U 6-Core 3.3GHz (Up to 4.70GHz) 16GB DDR5 4800MHz SO-DIMM Memory (1x 16GB) Intel® Graphics 512GB Gen3 M.2 NVMe Solid State Drive (SSD) Built-in Power Supply 2.5Gb LAN and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity Microsoft Windows 11 Pro The PCBuilder CUBE-100U Intel Core 3 Barebone Mini PC is a compact PC designed to deliver high-performance computing in a space-saving form factor. Whether you’re looking for a reliable workstation for office tasks, a powerful solution for digital signage, or an efficient point-of-sale (POS) system, this compact PC is built to handle professional workloads with ease. The CUBE-100U Intel® Mini PC houses a strong Intel® Core™ 3 100U processor, featuring 6 cores and 8 threads, capable of reaching speeds of up to 4.70GHz. This combination ensures smooth multitasking, fast application performance, and reliable responsiveness across business applications, making it an ideal choice for modern work environments that require efficiency and speed. Optimized for productivity, this compact PC supports stunning 8K visuals powered by Intel® Graphics, delivering sharp, detailed, and vibrant imagery for professionals who need high-resolution displays. With Type-C, DisplayPort, and HDMI 2.1 outputs, users can create flexible multi-monitor setups – extending or mirroring up to three displays to enhance workflow efficiency. Whether you’re working on spreadsheets, video editing, digital signage management, or client presentations, the CUBE-100U Intel® Mini PC ensures crystal-clear visuals at 8K@60Hz for a truly immersive viewing experience. Seamless connectivity and next-gen memory performance come standard in the CUBE-100U, making it a future-ready solution for dynamic workflows. Powered by 16GB of dual-channel DDR5 SO-DIMM memory, Intel® Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth® 5.2, and dual 2.5Gbps Ethernet ports, it delivers blazing speed and rock-solid stability – whether in the office or working remotely. Additionally, the inclusion of ultra-fast USB3.2 and USB4 ports enables high-speed data transfers of up to 40Gbps, allowing users to connect external storage devices, monitors, and high-performance peripherals. Designed with storage performance and flexibility in mind, the CUBE-100U features a 512GB M.2 PCIe 3.0 NVMe SSD slots for blazing-fast boot and load times. This gives users the freedom to configure up to two high-speed drives – ideal for creative workloads, business operations, or on-the-go computing. item.g:description: AMD B650 Chipset | AM5 Socket | DDR5 up to 7200+(OC) MHz | 2× M.2 PCIe 4.0 | Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 | 2.5Gbps LAN | Wi-Fi 6E | Bluetooth 5.3 | USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps | 7.1-Channel Audio Boost | Micro-ATX Quick Specs Build on the latest AMD AM5 platform with support for Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors. Unleash DDR5 performance with four UDIMM slots supporting up to 256GB at 7200+(OC) MHz with AMD EXPO™. Connect at speed with 2.5Gbps LAN, Wi-Fi 6E (6GHz), Bluetooth 5.3, and extensive USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports. Install high-speed NVMe storage on two M.2 slots with PCIe 4.0 x4 and M.2 Shield Frozr cooling. Game with confidence on a 10+2+1 Duet Rail power design, 6-layer 2oz copper PCB, and Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 with Steel Armor. A rock-solid AM5 foundation for South African gamers and builders who demand DDR5 performance, fast connectivity, and room to grow. The MSI B650M Gaming Plus WiFi is the AM5 motherboard that delivers where it counts — combining AMD B650 chipset support for the latest Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors with DDR5 memory speeds up to 7200+(OC) MHz and AMD EXPO™ compatibility. Its compact Micro-ATX form factor fits a wide range of cases without sacrificing the features serious builders need: dual M.2 NVMe slots, Lightning Gen 4 PCIe, Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5Gbps Ethernet, and a comprehensive USB layout including USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps. Whether you’re assembling a gaming rig, a content creation workstation, or a high-performance everyday PC, this DDR5 motherboard provides the stable, feature-rich platform to make it happen. For the South African enthusiast who wants MSI quality without the flagship price, this gaming motherboard is the smart choice. Robust power delivery and thermal engineering for sustained performance. At the heart of the B650M Gaming Plus WiFi sits a 10+2+1 phase Duet Rail Power System with Core Boost and Memory Boost technology, ensuring clean, stable voltage delivery to your CPU and RAM under heavy loads. The 6-layer PCB with 2oz thickened copper improves signal integrity and heat dissipation across the board. An extended heatsink and heavy plated VRM heatsink keep the power stages cool during demanding workloads, while the M.2 Shield Frozr thermal solution protects your NVMe drives from thermal throttling. High-quality 7W/mK MOSFET thermal pads and additional choke pads ensure stability when all cores are running at full speed. This MSI motherboard is built for sustained, reliable performance. Blazing-fast storage and expansion for your most demanding builds. Two M.2 slots — both running PCIe 4.0 x4 from the CPU — give you the bandwidth for high-speed NVMe SSDs, while four SATA 6G ports handle additional drives with RAID 0, 1, and 10 support. The Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 slot with MSI Steel Armor delivers double the bandwidth of PCIe 3.0, reinforced with heavy soldered connections to support heavy graphics cards and shield against electromagnetic interference. Two additional PCIe 3.0 x1 slots provide room for capture cards, sound cards, or other expansion. With Realtek ALC897 Audio Boost delivering 7.1-channel high-definition sound through isolated audio circuitry, this B650 motherboard covers every angle of a high-performance build. Premium connectivity that keeps you ahead of the game. The pre-installed Wi-Fi 6E module delivers tri-band wireless across 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands with MU-MIMO and 160 MHz channel bandwidth, while Bluetooth 5.3 ensures fast, stable connections to peripherals and accessories. The Realtek RTL8125BG 2.5Gbps LAN port provides wired networking that outpaces standard Gigabit connections. The rear I/O panel offers a comprehensive port selection: three USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps Type-A ports, one USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps USB Type-C port, four USB 5Gbps Type-A ports, plus HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 for integrated graphics output. Front panel headers add further USB 2.0, USB 5Gbps, and USB 10Gbps USB Type-C connectivity. Four EZ Debug LEDs simplify troubleshooting, and addressable RGB headers let you customise your build’s aesthetic. This motherboard with WiFi puts everything at your fingertips. Wi-Fi 6E (2.4/5/6 GHz), Bluetooth 5.3, and Realtek 2.5Gbps LAN for premium wired and wireless connectivity. Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 with Steel Armor, plus 7.1-channel Audio Boost with Realtek ALC897 codec. item.g:title: Xiaomi Smart Graphene Heater
item.g:description: 2000W Graphene + PTC Heating | 3-Second Rapid Warmth | 70° Wide-Angle Oscillation | Far-Infrared Resonance Heating | Xiaomi Home App & Google Assistant Quick Specs Feel warmth in as little as 3 seconds thanks to graphene quick-heating technology Heat a wider area with 70° wide-angle oscillation that circulates warm air around you Switch freely between hot, warm and natural breeze airflow modes Control the heater remotely via the Xiaomi Home app or hands-free with Google Assistant Stay protected with tip-over shutdown, overheating protection and V-0 flame-retardant materials Graphene Quick Heating for Warmth in Just 3 Seconds The Xiaomi Smart Graphene Heater brings near-instant warmth to homes across South Africa, heating up in as little as 3 seconds. A graphene coating — which conducts heat far better than copper or aluminium — works alongside a PTC ceramic heater and a powerful 2000W output to warm the surrounding air almost the moment you switch it on. The graphene-coated heating plate then spreads that heat evenly, so you get uniform, consistent warmth rather than hot and cold spots. Far-Infrared Resonance Heating That Feels Like Sunlight What sets this graphene heater apart is far-infrared resonance heating. The graphene coating emits 8–14µm far-infrared waves that closely match the body’s natural wavelength, creating a gentle resonant warming effect that feels much like basking in sunlight. It’s a deeper, more comfortable kind of heat that helps chase the chill from your hands and feet, making it well suited to South African winters. Smart, Even Comfort You Can Control From Anywhere A smart temperature control system dynamically adjusts power to hold your chosen temperature, cutting the energy waste that comes from overheating and constant fluctuations. The 70° wide-angle oscillation and centrifugal fan circulate gentle, evenly distributed airflow around the room, and you can switch between hot, warm and natural breeze modes to suit the moment. Connect it to the Xiaomi Home app to power it on or off remotely, set a target temperature, change modes or schedule on/off timers — and use Google Assistant for hands-free voice control. Designed With Safety and Simplicity in Mind Everyday use is effortless thanks to a large, top-mounted control panel that shows the heater’s status at a glance. Multiple safety designs give added peace of mind: the heater shuts down automatically if tilted, has overheating protection built in, and is made from V-0-rated flame-retardant materials — reassurance that matters in any busy home. FEATURES: Graphene quick-heating technology that delivers warmth in as little as 3 seconds Graphene coating with superior thermal conductivity to copper or aluminium PTC ceramic heater with a powerful 2000W output Graphene-coated heating plate for efficient, uniform heat conduction Far-infrared resonance heating emitting 8–14µm far-infrared waves Smart temperature control system that dynamically adjusts power to reduce energy waste 70° wide-angle oscillation for broader, wrap-around warmth Centrifugal fan and microporous air grid for gentle, evenly distributed airflow Multiple airflow modes: hot, warm and natural breeze Smart control via the Xiaomi Home app — remote on/off, target temperature, mode and on/off timer Voice control with Google Assistant Large top-mounted control panel for simple, intuitive operation Multiple safety designs: automatic shutdown when tilted, overheating protection, and V-0-rated flame-retardant materials SPECIFICATIONS: Rated Power: 2000 W Rated Voltage: 220–230 V~ Power Consumption: Networked Standby Mode: ≤2.0 W Off Mode: ≤0.5 W Product Dimensions: Φ17.6 × H46.7 cm Product Weight: 2,300 g WHAT’S IN THE BOX: Heater x1 User Manual x1 Why Xiaomi? Xiaomi designs smart, beautifully simple technology that makes everyday life more comfortable, and the Smart Graphene Heater is a perfect example — fast, efficient warmth wrapped in a clean, modern design. For South African households looking for a reliable, app-connected graphene heater to take the edge off winter, it’s an easy choice, backed by Xiaomi’s global reputation for quality and value.

item.g:title: Keychron V6 Ultra 100% 8K Red Switch Hot-Swappable Gateron Jupiter RGB Wireless Keyboard
item.g:description: 8000Hz Polling Rate | 2.4G / Bluetooth 5.3 / USB Type-C Wired | Up to 660-Hour Battery | Hot-Swappable | Gasket Mount | South-Facing RGB | 100% Full-Size Quick Specs Enjoy ultra-responsive input with an 8000 Hz polling rate in wired and 2.4G modes Connect three ways - 2.4G, Bluetooth 5.3 or USB Type-C wired Keep going for up to 660 hours on a single charge (backlight off) Swap switches freely thanks to a hot-swappable PCB (3-pin and 5-pin MX) Type on pre-lubed Keychron Silk POM Red linear switches in a gasket-mounted, acoustically tuned build Next-generation 8K wireless performance The Keychron V6 Ultra 8K is a 100% full-size custom mechanical keyboard engineered for serious performance. It delivers a high-speed 8000 Hz polling rate in both wired and 2.4 GHz wireless modes for the lowest possible input lag and ultra-responsive typing and gaming. Powered by open-source ZMK firmware on a capable Arm-based chip with 1MB of flash, it pairs that speed with the flexibility custom keyboard enthusiasts across South Africa expect. Connect your way, for months at a time Flexible triple-mode connectivity lets you link up over 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.3 — pairing with up to three devices — or a USB Type-C wired connection. A large 4000 mAh battery keeps the V6 Ultra 8K running for up to 660 hours with the backlight off (around four months of typical daily use), and you can keep working or gaming while it charges, so you’re never tethered when you don’t want to be. A refined, acoustically tuned typing experience Every layer is tuned for sound and feel. A gasket mount design with a PC plate softens each keystroke and reduces acoustic resonance, while multiple layers of internal foam deliver a deep, satisfying sound profile. Pre-lubed Keychron Silk POM Red linear switches glide smoothly for a consistent, quiet keystroke, newly enhanced screw-in stabilisers keep larger keys stable and rattle-free, and OSA-profile double-shot PBT keycaps resist shine and stop the legends fading. Endlessly customisable, inside and out Built to be personalised, the V6 Ultra 8K is fully hot-swappable — change out almost any 3-pin or 5-pin MX-style switch without soldering. South-facing RGB backlighting offers 22+ presets plus advanced Per-key RGB and Mix RGB lighting, including a static white option. Using the browser-based Keychron Launcher, you can remap keys, record macros and fine-tune lighting on Windows, macOS or Linux — with no software to install. Made for Mac and Windows alike Designed with Mac users in mind while keeping full Windows compatibility, the V6 Ultra 8K includes both Mac and Windows keycaps and a system toggle, letting you save two separate layouts — one for each system. With full NKRO in both wired and wireless modes and broad compatibility across macOS, Windows and Linux, it slots seamlessly into any setup. up to 200 hours (RGB, lowest brightness) Switch: Keychron Silk POM – Red (linear, 45 ±15 gf, pre-lubed; up to 50M keystrokes) Hot-Swappable: Yes (3-pin and 5-pin MX) N-Key Rollover: Yes (wired and wireless) Keycaps: OSA-profile double-shot PBT Plate Material: PC Stabiliser: Screw-in PCB stabiliser Backlight: South-facing RGB LED Firmware: ZMK (open-source) Compatible Systems: macOS / Windows / Linux Body Material: Plastic Angle: 4° / 9° / 11° Front Height: 24.7 mm (without keycaps) Back Height: 31.2 mm (without keycaps) Operating Environment: -10°C to 50°C Product Dimensions: 14.9 × 44.8 cm Product Weight: 1,130 g (±10 g) WHAT’S IN THE BOX: Keychron V6 Ultra 100% 8K Red Switch Hot-Swappable Gateron Jupiter RGB Wireless Keyb

item.g:title: Xiaomi Buds 8 White
item.g:description: Immerse yourself in pure sound with up to 50dB noise cancellation and Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification; enjoy up to 44 hours of listening time. Quick Specs Experience unparalleled silence with up to 50dB active noise cancellation. Enjoy crystal-clear audio with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification and 11mm drivers. Stay connected for longer with a total playback of up to 44 hours with the charging case. Navigate your audio world with advanced touch controls and smart device switching. Designed for comfort and durability with IP54 water resistance, perfect for active lifestyles. Silence the world and elevate your audio with Xiaomi Buds 8 ANC Earbuds These are not merely Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds; they are your personal sanctuary of sound, engineered for the discerning listener in South Africa who demands clarity, immersion, and unwavering performance. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, seeking focus in a busy office, or simply craving an escape into your favourite music, the Buds 8 deliver an experience that cuts through the noise of everyday life. Designed for those who appreciate superior audio fidelity and intelligent features, these in-ear headphones are built to integrate seamlessly into your dynamic lifestyle, offering a perfect blend of cutting-edge technology and enduring comfort. Prepare to rediscover your audio world with these exceptional hi-res audio earbuds. Unrivalled immersion with intelligent noise cancellation Step into a realm of pure audio bliss. The Xiaomi Buds 8 ANC Earbuds feature advanced Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) capable of reducing ambient sound by up to 50dB. This is not a subtle dampening; it is a profound silence that allows you to focus entirely on your audio. The ANC operates across a wide frequency range, up to 4kHz, effectively eliminating distractions from low rumbles to higher-pitched chatter. With three distinct transparency modes, you can effortlessly reconnect with your surroundings when needed, ensuring safety and convenience without removing your earbuds. This adaptive capability makes them the ideal companion for commuting, travel, or simply finding your peace. A symphony of sound and clarity Experience audio as the artist intended. Certified with Hi-Res Audio Wireless, these Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds unlock the full potential of high-fidelity sound, delivering richer detail, deeper bass, and clearer highs. The precisely engineered 11mm dynamic driver works in harmony with advanced Bluetooth codecs, including SBC, AAC, and LHDC, to reproduce every note with stunning accuracy. Whether it’s the subtle nuances of a classical composition or the driving beat of your workout playlist, the Xiaomi Buds 8 ensure an audio playback that is both authentic and exhilarating. Triple-Mic AI Noise Reduction further enhances your calls, ensuring your voice is heard clearly even in noisy environments. Endurance for your longest days Your soundtrack should not be interrupted. The Xiaomi Buds 8 ANC Earbuds are designed for marathon listening sessions. With ANC switched off, enjoy an astonishing up to 11 hours of playback on a single charge, extending to a total of up to 44 hours with the included charging case. This exceptional battery performance means your earbuds are always ready when you are, from your morning commute to your late-night wind-down. Experience the convenience of dual device connection earbuds, allowing seamless switching between your phone and laptop. Features Immerse yourself in pure audio with up to 50dB active noise cancellation and three transparency modes for situational awareness. Experience breathtaking sound quality with 11mm dynamic drivers and Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification, supporting LHDC codec. Enjoy uninterrupted listening with a combined battery life of up to 44 hours with ANC off, and up to 28 hours with ANC on. Communicate clearly with triple-mic AI noise reduction and wind noise reduction, ensuring your calls are crisp. Connect seamlessly with Bluetooth 5.4, supporting dual device connection and smart device switching for effortless transitions. Designed for active use with IP54 water resistance, protecting against splashes and dust. Personalise your audio experience with custom EQ settings and adaptive noise cancellation through the Xiaomi Earbuds App. Specifications Driver Size: 11mm Dynamic Driver Audio Certification: Hi-Res Audio Wireless Noise Cancellation: Up to 50dB Smart ANC ANC Frequency Range: Up to 4kHz Transparency Modes: 3 Levels Microphones: Triple-Mic AI Noise Reduction Wind Noise Reduction: Up to 12m/s Bluetooth Version: Bluetooth 5.4 Wireless Range: Up to 10m Water Resistance: IP54 (Earbuds) Battery Life (ANC Off): Up to 11 Hours Total Battery Life (ANC Off): Up to 44 Hours Battery Life (ANC On): Up to 6.5 Hours Total Battery Life (ANC On): Up to 28 Hours Earbud Battery Capacity: 54mAh Charging Case Capacit

item.g:description: AMD Radeon™ RX 9070 GRE | 12GB GDDR6 | PCIe 5.0 | Boost up to 2880 MHz (OC Mode) | Triple Axial-Tech Fans | 2.5-Slot Design Quick Specs Power high-refresh 1440p gaming with the AMD Radeon RX 9070 GRE GPU Enjoy 12GB of fast GDDR6 memory on a 192-bit interface Stay cool and quiet with three Axial-tech fans and 0dB technology Fit more builds with a compact 2.5-slot, small-form-factor-ready design Tune performance or quiet operation on the fly with Dual BIOS Primed for Power with the Radeon RX 9070 GRE The ASUS Prime Radeon™ RX 9070 GRE EVO OC Edition brings serious performance to gaming rigs across South Africa. Built on the AMD Radeon™ RX 9070 GRE GPU with 3,072 stream processors and 12GB of GDDR6 memory, it boosts up to 2880 MHz in OC mode (via GPU Tweak III) for smooth, high-refresh gameplay. A PCI Express 5.0 interface keeps it ready for the latest platforms, while support for resolutions up to 7680 × 4320 means it’s built for the long haul. Cool, Quiet Triple-Fan Cooling Cooling is where the Prime EVO shines. A carefully arranged 2.5-slot design pairs three upgraded Axial-tech fans — with smaller hubs, longer blades and barrier rings — to drive more air at lower temperatures and noise. A premium phase-change GPU thermal pad melts to fill the gaps between GPU and heatsink for superior heat dissipation and long-term longevity, and 0dB technology lets the fans stop entirely during light loads for silent operation. Compact 2.5-Slot Design for Flexible Builds Despite its triple-fan cooler, the Prime RX 9070 GRE EVO keeps to a space-saving 2.5-slot footprint that’s certified small-form-factor (SFF) ready — so it slots neatly into compact cases as well as full-size towers. The carefully arranged shroud, heatsink and heat-pipe layout lets the fans take advantage of chassis side-panel ventilation for optimal thermal performance whatever the build. A protective backplate adds structural rigidity and shields the PCB, and a grade 304 stainless-steel mounting bracket resists corrosion. Auto-Extreme manufacturing completes all soldering in a single pass for a cleaner, more reliable, more sustainable build. Dual BIOS and Powerful Tuning Software A Dual BIOS switch lets you toggle between Performance mode for maximum cooling and Quiet mode for a calmer fan curve — no software needed. The card also includes a one-month membership to Adobe Creative Cloud.
