item.g:title: Xiaomi Redmi Headphones Neo ANC Wireless Over-Ears – Black
item.g:description: Enjoy seamless wireless connectivity and superior comfort on your daily commute or longest journeys. Quick Specs Experience up to 72 hours of uninterrupted listening with ANC off. Silence the world around you with advanced Active Noise Cancellation. Seamlessly connect to your devices with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology. Enjoy all-day comfort with a lightweight, ergonomic design weighing only 263g. Quickly recharge your headphones in under 2 hours via USB Type-C. Experience Unrivalled Audio Clarity in South Africa For the discerning listener in South Africa, the Redmi Headphones Neo ANC Wireless Over-Ears offer an escape into pristine audio quality. These over-ear headphones are engineered for those who demand clarity and silence in their daily lives. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, focusing in a busy office, or simply seeking a moment of auditory peace at home, the Redmi Headphones Neo deliver. They are designed for extended wear, ensuring comfort throughout your longest commutes or flights. This is not merely a device for listening to music; it is a tool for enhancing focus, relaxation, and overall well-being through superior sound isolation and immersive audio. For the individual who values both performance and tranquillity, these over-ear headphones stand as a testament to thoughtful design and advanced technology. Immersive Sound, Distraction-Free Listening with Bluetooth 5.4 At the core of the Redmi Headphones Neo is its powerful Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) technology. This feature intelligently detects and filters out ambient noise, from the low rumble of an aeroplane engine to the chatter of a crowded café. This allows you to immerse yourself completely in your music, podcasts, or audiobooks, experiencing every nuance without interruption. The effect is profound, transforming noisy environments into personal sanctuaries of sound. This level of immersion is crucial for concentration, relaxation, and simply enjoying your audio content as the artist intended, making these ANC headphones an indispensable companion for modern life. Unrivalled Comfort for Extended Listening Sessions Crafted with the user’s comfort as a paramount concern, the Redmi Headphones Neo feature an ergonomic design that distributes weight evenly. The earcups are plush and designed to envelop the ears, providing both comfort and an effective passive seal for sound isolation. Weighing approximately 263g, they are remarkably lightweight for over-ear headphones, reducing fatigue during prolonged use. This attention to detail ensures that whether you are on a long-haul flight or engaged in an all-day work session, your listening experience remains comfortable and enjoyable from start to finish. Effortless Connectivity and Enduring Power The integration of Bluetooth 5.4 ensures a stable, low-latency wireless connection to your devices, supporting a range of up to 10 meters. This means you can move freely without worrying about dropouts or stuttering audio. Furthermore, the impressive battery life of approximately 72 hours with ANC off provides weeks of listening on a single charge for most users. When it is time to recharge, the USB Type-C port allows for rapid charging, delivering a full charge in less than 2 hours. This combination of advanced wireless technology and exceptional battery performance guarantees that these Bluetooth 5.4 headphones are always ready when you are. Transparency Mode: Stay Aware Without Breaking Your Immersion Understanding the need to balance immersive listening with situational awareness, the Redmi Headphones Neo incorporate a Transparency Mode. With a simple activation, this mode allows external sounds to be heard clearly through the headphones, without needing to remove them. This is invaluable for conversations, listening for announcements in public spaces, or simply staying aware of your surroundings for safety. This thoughtful feature ensures you remain connected to the world when necessary, enhancing the versatility and practicality of these wireless over-ear headphones. FEATURES: Silence distractions effectively with advanced Active Noise Cancellation technology. Stay connected to your surroundings when needed using the intuitive Transparency Mode. Enjoy an extended listening experience with up to 72 hours of battery life (ANC off). Experience stable, high-quality audio streaming thanks to Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity. Recharge quickly and conveniently with the modern USB Type-C charging port. Listen in comfort for hours on end with the lightweight (263g) and ergonomic design. item.g:title: Keychron C2 Pro 100% 8K Super Red Switch Hot-Swap RGB Wired Custom Mechanical Keyboard
item.g:description: 100% Full-Size Layout | 8000Hz Polling Rate | Keychron Super Red Linear Switches | Hot-Swappable | South-Facing RGB | QMK/VIA | Double-Shot PBT Keycaps Quick Specs Type on smooth, pre-lubed Keychron Super Red linear switches for quiet, effortless keystrokes Hit an 8000Hz polling rate for near-instant input registration and ultra-low latency Customise every key, macro and shortcut with QMK/VIA and the Keychron Launcher web app Swap switches in seconds with solderless hot-swappable 5-pin and 3-pin sockets Work faster on a full-size 100% layout with a dedicated number pad Vintage Looks, Pro-Grade Performance The Keychron C2 Pro 8K is a full-size wired custom mechanical keyboard that pairs a clean, retro 100% layout with the kind of premium internals enthusiasts usually build themselves. Underneath the OSA double-shot PBT keycaps sits a blazing 8000Hz polling rate, an open-source QMK/VIA core and a fully hot-swappable PCB, so this is a keyboard you can tune to your exact taste long after the box is opened. With smooth Keychron Super Red linear switches fitted as standard, it delivers a quiet, fluid typing experience that suits both the office and after-hours gaming. An Epic Core With 8000Hz Polling Set the C2 Pro 8K to a blistering 8000Hz polling rate, adjustable anywhere from 125Hz up to 8000Hz, and unlock genuinely game-changing speed in command transmission. You get faster input registration, near-instant triggering and ultra-low latency, delivering the kind of responsiveness that executes every keystroke with precision. When split seconds decide the outcome, this wired mechanical keyboard keeps you a step ahead of the competition. Programme Your Way With QMK & VIA Open-source QMK firmware means endless possibilities for key remapping, macros and shortcuts. The browser-based Keychron Launcher web app lets you configure each key online from any Chrome, Edge or Opera browser, with no software to download or install, so you can personalise your layout in the office, at home or on the move. Because the firmware is open-source, the community can review the code for safety, giving you complete control over your input security across Windows, macOS and Linux. Built for Satisfying Acoustics Every layer of the C2 Pro 8K is engineered for sound. A multi-layer foam stack, including sound-absorbing foam, PET film, IXPE film, EPDM foam, a bottom case acoustic foam and a silicone bottom pad, works together to deliver a soft, thocky typing sound while improving switch support, responsiveness and durability. South-facing RGB LEDs illuminate the non-shine-through keycaps cleanly and stay free of interference even when you fit Cherry-profile alternatives. Comfort and Compatibility for Every Setup Three adjustable typing angles of 4.8°, 7.8° and 10.2° team up with the curved OSA-profile keycaps to provide long-lasting ergonomic support for your wrists. A built-in system toggle and additional Mac and Windows keycaps let you switch between platforms with ease, while the hot-swappable PCB accepts almost any 3-pin or 5-pin MX-style switch, including Cherry, Gateron, Kailh and Panda, so you can rebuild the feel of this custom mechanical keyboard in seconds. FEATURES: 8000Hz Polling Rate: Near-instant input registration and ultra-low latency, adjustable from 125Hz to 8000Hz for responsive typing and competitive gaming. Keychron Super Red Switches: Pre-lubed linear switches rated for up to 50 million keystrokes, delivering quiet, smooth keypresses for office and gaming use. Hot-Swappable Sockets: Change switches in seconds with no soldering, supporting almost all 3-pin and 5-pin MX-style switches. QMK/VIA Support: Remap keys, build macros and create custom layers using open-source firmware and the browser-based Keychron Launcher web app. South-Facing RGB: Cleaner backlight illumination that avoids interference with Cherry-profile keycaps. OSA Double-Shot PBT Keycaps: Non shine-through caps with an SA-like profile, excellent oil resistance and legends that resist fading. Full Acoustic Foam Stack: Multiple sound-absorbing layers tuned for a soft, thocky typing sound and superior switch support. Three Adjustable Typing Angles: 4.8°, 7.8° and 10.2° feet provide long-lasting ergonomic comfort. Cross-Platform Compatibility: Works with Windows, macOS and Linux, with a system toggle and extra keycaps included. item.g:title: Keychron C1 Pro 8K 80% Super Red Hot-swappable RGB Wired Mechanical Keyboard
item.g:description: 8000 Hz Polling Rate | QMK/VIA | USB Type-C Wired | TKL (80%) | Hot-Swappable | South-Facing RGB | Double-Shot PBT Quick Specs Register every keystroke with an ultra-fast 8000 Hz polling rate Remap keys and macros freely with open-source QMK/VIA and the Keychron Launcher Swap switches without soldering thanks to a hot-swappable PCB (3-pin and 5-pin MX) Type on pre-lubed Keychron Super Red linear switches in an acoustically tuned build Enjoy a classic TKL (80%) layout with durable double-shot PBT keycaps Lightning-Fast 8000 Hz Wired Performance The Keychron C1 Pro 8K is a wired TKL (80%) custom mechanical keyboard built for speed. An 8000 Hz polling rate — adjustable from 125 Hz right up to 8000 Hz — delivers faster input registration, near-instant triggering and ultra-low latency, so every keystroke lands with precision. Powered by an Arm Cortex-M4 chip and open-source QMK firmware, it gives gamers and typists across South Africa serious responsiveness with endless room to customise. Using the browser-based Keychron Launcher, you can remap keys, record macros and fine-tune shortcuts on Windows, macOS or Linux — no software to install. Because the firmware is open source, the community can review it for safety, giving you complete confidence and control over your inputs. A Refined, Acoustically Tuned Typing Experience The C1 Pro 8K is tuned for sound and feel from the inside out. Layers of sound-absorbing foam, PET film, IXPE film, bottom-case acoustic foam and a silicone bottom pad work together for a satisfying, thocky typing sound and consistent key feel. Pre-lubed Keychron Super switches glide smoothly, plate-mounted stabilisers keep larger keys steady, and OSA-profile double-shot PBT keycaps resist shine and stop the legends fading. Hot-Swappable and Built to Personalise Make it truly yours. South-facing RGB lighting shines cleanly through from the typist’s angle — even with non-shine-through PBT keycaps — for vivid, even backlighting you can tailor key by key. Comfortable, All-Day Ergonomics Designed for long sessions, the C1 Pro 8K offers three adjustable typing angles (4.8°, 8.5° and 10.7°) and curved OSA-profile keycaps that work together to support your wrists. A system toggle plus included Windows and macOS keycaps let you switch seamlessly between platforms and save separate layouts for each. item.g:title: Giada D108 AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS Book-size Signage Player
item.g:description: AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS | Radeon™ 780M Graphics | AMD Ryzen™ AI (38 TOPS) | Quad 4K HDMI Output | Up to 96GB DDR5 | Book-Size Design Quick Specs Drive demanding signage and edge AI workloads with an 8-core AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS Accelerate on-device AI with AMD Ryzen™ AI delivering up to 38 TOPS Power up to four 4K displays at once through quad HDMI outputs Expand to 96GB DDR5 memory and fast PCIe 4.0 M.2 SSD storage Connect with dual Ethernet (1GbE + 2.5GbE) and plentiful USB 3.2 Gen2 Ryzen 8000-Series Power in a Book-Size Build The Giada D108 is a high-performance embedded computer built around the 8-core AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS processor with integrated AMD Ryzen™ AI. Delivering up to 38 TOPS of total AI performance (16 TOPS from the dedicated NPU), it’s ready for modern AI-assisted signage, kiosk and edge workloads across South Africa — all in a compact, book-size chassis that fits almost anywhere. Stunning Quad-Display Visuals Built for digital signage, the D108 drives up to four independent displays simultaneously through four HDMI ports, each supporting resolutions up to 3840 × 2160 (4K) at 60Hz with hardware EDID. AMD Radeon™ 780M graphics handle rich multimedia with advanced hardware decode and encode (including H.265, VP9 and AV1), making it ideal for crisp 4K video walls and multi-screen deployments. Extensive Connectivity and Expansion Connectivity is comprehensive. A rich I/O array includes five USB 3.2 Gen2 ports, a USB 2.0 port, an RS232 serial port (optionally two) and MIC-IN/AUDIO-OUT, while dual Ethernet — 1GbE plus 2.5GbE — keeps wired networking fast and resilient. Inside, support for up to 96GB of dual-channel DDR5 memory and a PCIe® 4.0 M.2 (2280) SSD gives you room to scale, with optional M.2 modules adding Wi-Fi 5/6E and 4G mobile connectivity plus a SIM slot. Reliable, Always-On Operation Engineered for unattended deployments, the D108 features smart active cooling, a watchdog timer, auto power-on, scheduled RTC and optional TPM 2.0 for hardware security. item.g:title: Keychron V5 Ultra 96% 8K Red Switch Hot-Swapple Silk POM RGB Wireless Keyboard
item.g:description: 96% Layout with Knob | Keychron Silk POM Red Switch | 8000 Hz Polling | 2.4 GHz / Bluetooth 5.3 / USB Type-C | Gasket Mount | Up to 660 Hours Quick Specs Game at the bleeding edge with an 8000 Hz polling rate across wired and 2.4 GHz wireless modes Keep going for up to 660 hours on a single charge with the backlight off Switch seamlessly between three devices via 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.3 or USB Type-C wired Enjoy a soft, quiet keystroke from pre-lubed linear Keychron Silk POM Red switches Customise everything with hot-swappable sockets and open-source ZMK firmware Next-Generation Performance, Fully Wireless Meet the Keychron V5 Ultra 8K, a next-generation 96% wireless custom mechanical keyboard engineered for serious performance. It pairs an ultra-fast 8000 Hz polling rate in wireless mode with up to 660 hours of battery life, multiple layers of acoustic foam and full ZMK customisation — delivering a refined typing experience with premium sound and complete control over every key. The all-new rotary knob puts volume and shortcuts right at your fingertips. 8K Polling Meets True Wireless Freedom The V5 Ultra 8K runs a high-speed 8000 Hz polling rate in both wired and 2.4 GHz wireless modes, keeping input lag to an absolute minimum for ultra-responsive performance. A powerful ARM core MCU with 1 MB of flash drives the open-source ZMK firmware, while Bluetooth 5.3 lets you connect up to three devices and switch between your computer, phone and tablet on the fly. Latency stays barely noticeable, even in competitive play. Marathon Battery, Zero Compromise Don't wait for a full charge — the V5 Ultra 8K runs even while charging, with a continuous battery life of up to 660 hours with the backlight off (or up to 200 hours with RGB at lowest brightness). Based on five hours of daily use, that's roughly four months of creating, working or gaming between charges, so you can rely on it for extended periods without constant top-ups. Silky-Smooth Silk POM Switches The V5 Ultra 8K comes with pre-lubed Keychron Silk POM Red switches built for gamers and typists who demand precision and durability. Crafted from high-quality POM housing and stem, these linear switches deliver a smooth, consistent keystroke with a quiet sound signature, rated for up to 50 million presses. Thanks to the hot-swappable PCB, you can drop in almost any 3-pin or 5-pin MX-style switch without soldering. Built for Premium Sound and Feel A gasket mount design paired with a PC plate softens acoustic resonance for a quieter, more cushioned typing experience. Inside sit multiple acoustic layers — sound-absorbing foam, EPDM foam, PET films and case foam — tuned for a satisfying sound. Screw-in PCB stabilisers keep the larger keys stable and rattle-free, OSA double-shot PBT keycaps resist oil and fading, and the south-facing RGB LEDs light the board with 22+ presets, Per-key RGB and Mix RGB. FEATURES: Keychron Silk POM Red switch, pre-lubed from factory for a smooth, quiet linear keystroke 8000 Hz polling rate in wired and 2.4 GHz wireless modes for ultra-low latency Triple connectivity via 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.3 and USB Type-C wired Connects to up to three devices and switches between them instantly Up to 660 hours of battery life with the backlight off, charges while in use Open-source ZMK firmware with the Keychron Launcher web app for remapping and macros Hot-swappable PCB compatible with 3-pin and 5-pin MX-style switches Gasket mount design with PC plate for softer, quieter acoustics Multiple acoustic layers and screw-in PCB stabilisers for a refined sound Rotary knob for quick volume and shortcut control OSA double-shot PBT keycaps resist wear and oil South-facing RGB backlight with 22+ presets, Per-key RGB and Mix RGB Full N-Key Rollover across wired and wireless connections Mac and Windows support with two saveable layouts and extra keycaps item.g:title: Redragon GCP06 24-Pin ARGB Extension Power Cable
item.g:description: 24-Pin ATX | ARGB Sync | 5V 3-Pin | 18AWG | Dual-Side Lighting | Transparent PVC Quick Specs Illuminate your entire 24-pin run with vivid addressable RGB lighting Sync seamlessly with your motherboard through the standard 5V 3-pin ARGB header Glow from both faces thanks to dual lighting PCB boards Customise endless effects via your existing ARGB control software Sleeve cleanly with 16-spindle bright-coloured aluminium foil braiding Turn Your Power Cable Into a Centrepiece The Redragon GCP06 transforms an everyday motherboard power run into the brightest feature of your build. Sitting in front of your existing 24-pin ATX cable, this 24-pin ARGB extension cable floods your case with smooth, addressable colour that flows the full length of the connector span — turning dead cable space into a deliberate design statement. Plug-and-Play ARGB Sync Fitted with standard 5V 3-pin ARGB connectors, the GCP06 plugs straight into your motherboard’s addressable header and falls in line with your wider lighting scheme. Whether you run ASUS Aura Sync, MSI Mystic Light, Gigabyte RGB Fusion or ASRock Polychrome, this ARGB power cable picks up the same effects, speeds and colours as the rest of your components — no separate software to wrestle with. Built to Be Seen From Every Angle Lighting PCB boards on both sides mean the GCP06 looks just as good whether your case is glass-on-the-left or stood on a desk in full view. The transparent PVC jacket lets every colour read true, while the 16-spindle braided sleeving in bright-coloured aluminium foil keeps the whole run crisp and tidy. With multiple lighting configurations on tap, it’s easy to land on a look that suits your setup. FEATURES: 24-pin ATX extension cable with integrated addressable RGB lighting 5V 3-pin ARGB connectors supporting motherboard ARGB sync Dual lighting PCB boards for illumination on both sides Multiple lighting configurations and effects 18AWG conductor gauge for the full 24-pin run 16-spindle braided sleeving in bright-coloured aluminium foil (PET) Transparent PVC jacket with PVC insulation SPECIFICATIONS: Connector Type: 5V 3-pin (ARGB) Conductor Gauge: 18AWG Conductor Size: 163/0.08 Conductor Lay of Stranded: 30 Braid Material: Bright-coloured aluminium foil (PET) Braid Size: 16-spindle braid Insulation Material: PVC Jacket Material: PVC Insulation Diameter: 1.7 mm Jacket Diameter: 2.4 ±0.1 mm Jacket Colour: Transparent PVC ARGB Control: Via motherboard ARGB software (no dedicated software required) Product Dimensions: 30 x 9.3 x 3.2 cm (giftbox) Product Weight: 183.75 g (with giftbox) WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Redragon GCP06 24-Pin ARGB Extension Power Cable x1 Why Redragon? Redragon has earned a loyal following among South African PC builders for delivering eye-catching gear that doesn’t punish your budget, and the GCP06 24-pin ARGB extension cable is a perfect example. It’s an affordable way to lift a local build from functional to head-turning, syncing neatly with the ARGB ecosystem you already run. If you’re after an ARGB power cable that adds genuine wow factor without the premium price tag, the GCP06 is a smart, easy upgrade.

item.g:title: AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D 8-Core 3.4GHz AM4 CPU
item.g:description: AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D | 8 Cores / 16 Threads | 3.4GHz Base, up to 4.5GHz Boost | 96MB L3 (3D V-Cache™) | Socket AM4 | DDR4 | PCIe 4.0 Quick Specs Game at the top of the AM4 platform with AMD’s 3D V-Cache™ technology Power through with 8 Zen 3 cores and 16 threads Boost up to 4.5 GHz when your games and apps demand it Tap into a massive 96MB of L3 cache for higher frame rates Drop straight into existing AM4 boards with DDR4 and PCIe 4.0 The Ultimate AM4 Gaming Processor The AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D is the ultimate gaming processor for the DDR4 platform, and it’s built around AMD’s game-changing 3D V-Cache™ technology. By stacking a huge 96MB of L3 cache onto its 8-core, 16-thread Zen 3 design, it feeds the CPU more game data closer to the cores — delivering higher frame rates in the titles that matter to gamers across South Africa, without needing a brand-new platform. Zen 3 Performance, Ready to Boost Built on the proven Zen 3 architecture, the 5800X3D runs at a 3.4 GHz base clock and boosts up to 4.5 GHz with Precision Boost 2, so it stays responsive whether you’re gaming, streaming or tackling everyday productivity. With 8 cores and Simultaneous Multithreading (SMT) for 16 threads, plus a 512KB L1 / 4MB L2 cache hierarchy, it has the muscle for serious multitasking as well as high-refresh gaming. A Smart, Easy Upgrade for AM4 Builds One of the 5800X3D’s biggest strengths is its socket AM4 compatibility. It works with X570, X470, B550, B450 and A520 chipsets, making it a superb drop-in upgrade for existing AM4 systems — often with just a BIOS update. It supports dual-channel DDR4 up to 128GB (DDR4-3200), PCIe® 4.0, and even ECC memory with compatible motherboards, so you get modern connectivity without the cost of a full platform change. Built for Modern Gaming and Cool Operation Supporting AMD 3D V-Cache™, Windows® 11 gaming and AMD Ryzen™ VR-Ready Premium, the 5800X3D is engineered for today’s most demanding experiences. It’s manufactured on TSMC’s 7nm process with a 105W default TDP and a 90°C maximum operating temperature. No cooler is included in the box, and AMD recommends a liquid cooler for optimal performance — so pair it with a capable AIO to keep it running at its best. FEATURES: AMD 3D V-Cache™ technology with a massive 96MB L3 cache for higher gaming frame rates 8 Zen 3 cores and 16 threads (Simultaneous Multithreading) 3.4 GHz base clock, boosting up to 4.5 GHz with Precision Boost 2 Socket AM4 compatibility with X570, X470, B550, B450 and A520 chipsets Dual-channel DDR4 support up to 128GB (DDR4-3200), with ECC support on compatible boards PCIe® 4.0 connectivity with NVMe boot and RAID 0/1/10 support Supports Windows® 11 Gaming and AMD Ryzen™ VR-Ready Premium Built on TSMC 7nm FinFET process technology Unlocked for tuning, with a broad set of supported instruction extensions Cooler not included; liquid cooler recommended for optimal performance SPECIFICATIONS: Name: AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D Family: Ryzen 7 (Ryzen 5000 Series) Processor Architecture: Zen 3 Former Codename: Vermeer CPU Socket: AM4 # of CPU Cores: 8 # of Threads: 16 Multithreading (SMT): Yes Base Clock: 3.4 GHz Max. Boost Clock: Up to 4.5 GHz CPU Boost Technology: Precision Boost 2 L1 Cache: 512 KB L2 Cache: 4 MB L3 Cache: 96 MB Default TDP: 105W Max. Operating Temperature (Tjmax): 90°C Supporting Chipsets: X570, X470, B550, B450, A520 Instruction Set: x86-64 System Memory Type: DDR4 Memory Channels: 2 Max. Memory: 128 GB Max. Memory Speed: DDR4-3200 (2x1R / 2x2R) ECC Support: Yes (requires motherboard support) PCI Express® Version: PCIe® 4.0 Native USB: 4 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps) Native SATA Ports: 2 Processor Technology (CPU Cores): TSMC 7nm FinFET Graphics: Discrete graphics card required Thermal Solution (PIB): Not included Recommended Cooler: Liquid cooler recommended for optimal performance Operating System Support: Windows 11 / Windows 10 (64-bit), RHEL x86 64-bit, Ubuntu x86 64-bit WHAT’S IN THE BOX: AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D Gaming Processor x1 Why AMD? AMD Ryzen™ processors have earned a loyal following among gamers and creators worldwide for delivering exceptional performance and value. The Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D is a standout — a pioneering 3D V-Cache™ chip that remains one of the best gaming CPUs you can drop into an AM4 board. For South African gamers looking to get the most from an existing platform, it’s a smart, high-impact upgrade backed by AMD’s reputation for quality.

item.g:title: Keychron G3 Ultra-Light Wireless Gaming Mouse - Black
item.g:description: Experience peak gaming performance with a feather-light 44g design and hyper-responsive 8,000 Hz polling rate, crafted for South African competitors. Quick Specs Dominate every match with a feather-light 44g construction for superior agility. Achieve pinpoint accuracy with the advanced PixArt 3950 sensor and up to 30,000 DPI. React instantly with an ultra-low latency of 0.41ms thanks to the 8,000 Hz polling rate. Adapt to any game with over 10 customizable buttons and 5 onboard memory profiles. Enjoy seamless connectivity with tri-mode options: 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.3, and wired USB-Type C. For the serious South African gamer, the Keychron G3 Ultra-Light Wireless Gaming Mouse is not just a tool; it is an extension of your will Crafted for precision, speed, and endurance, this wireless gaming mouse is engineered to give you the competitive edge you demand. In the heat of battle, where milliseconds determine victory, the G3 stands apart. Its ultra-lightweight design, weighing in at a mere 44 grams, ensures effortless movement and reduces fatigue during extended gaming sessions. This is not simply a peripheral; it is a high-performance instrument designed for players who understand that control and agility are paramount. Whether you are navigating complex virtual worlds or executing rapid-fire commands, the G3 is built to perform without compromise. Unrivalled precision and responsiveness At the core of the Keychron G3 lies the state-of-the-art PixArt 3950 Optical Sensor. This sensor delivers unparalleled tracking accuracy with adjustable DPI up to 30,000, ensuring that every subtle movement translates precisely onto your screen. Coupled with an astonishing tracking speed of up to 750 IPS, the G3 maintains accuracy even during the most frenetic gameplay. The true differentiator, however, is the ability to adjust the polling rate from 125 Hz all the way up to an incredible 8,000 Hz. This translates to a latency as low as 0.41ms on the 2.4 GHz wireless connection at 8,000 Hz, effectively eliminating any perceptible delay between your action and the on-screen response. For gamers in South Africa, this means a level of real-time control previously unattainable with a standard Bluetooth gaming mouse or any ultra light gaming mouse. Engineered for endurance and adaptability The Keychron G3 is built not only for speed but for the long haul. Its robust construction features a carbon fibre top cover and primary buttons, contributing to its ultra-lightweight profile while ensuring durability. With over 10 customisable buttons and 5 onboard memory profiles, you can tailor the mouse to your specific needs and preferred game settings, ensuring instant access to crucial commands. The 500mAh battery provides substantial gaming time, offering up to 37 hours on the demanding 2.4 GHz wireless at 8,000 Hz, and even longer in Bluetooth or lower polling rate modes, ensuring your wireless gaming mouse is ready when you are. Seamless integration across your gaming ecosystem Connectivity is paramount, and the G3 offers true tri-mode flexibility. Connect via the reliable 2.4 GHz wireless for maximum performance, utilise the power-efficient Bluetooth 5.3 for versatile pairing, or opt for the stable wired USB Type-C connection. This adaptability ensures the G3 integrates seamlessly into any South African gaming setup, offering the convenience of a Bluetooth gaming mouse when desired. Furthermore, the intuitive Keychron Launcher web-based software allows for effortless configuration across Windows, macOS, and Linux, making customisation accessible and straightforward through popular browsers like Chrome, Edge, and Opera. Features Experience unparalleled agility with an ultra-light 44g design, allowing for swift and precise movements in fast-paced games, making it a top ultra light gaming mouse. Achieve peak accuracy and responsiveness with the cutting-edge PixArt 3950 Optical Sensor, capable of up to 30,000 DPI, enhancing your wireless gaming mouse experience. React faster than your opponents with an industry-leading 8,000 Hz polling rate and a minimal 0.41ms latency for instant on-screen action. Personalise your gameplay with over 10 programmable buttons and 5 onboard memory profiles, ensuring your essential commands are always at your fingertips. Enjoy ultimate freedom with tri-mode connectivity: high-performance 2.4 GHz wireless, efficient Bluetooth 5.3, and a stable wired USB Type-C connection, perfect for a versatile Bluetooth gaming mouse. Benefit from extended gaming sessions thanks to the durable carbon fibre construction and a long-lasting 500mAh battery. Effortlessly configure your mouse settings via the web-based Keychron Launcher software, compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux. item.g:title: Xiaomi Mesh System BE3600 Pro – 3 Pack
item.g:description: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) | Up to 3600 Mbps Total Speed | Qualcomm Quad-Core 1.1 GHz | 1× 2.5GbE + 3× 1GbE per Unit | 4K-QAM | MLO | Covers 7–9 Rooms | Up to 250 Devices | NFC & Bluetooth Gateway Quick Specs Experience next-generation Wi-Fi 7 speeds up to 3600 Mbps with 4K-QAM and Multi-Link Operation (MLO) technology. Cover your entire home with three mesh units spanning 7–9 rooms and supporting up to 250 connected devices. Enjoy blazing-fast wired connectivity with a 2.5 Gbps Ethernet port plus three Gigabit WAN/LAN auto-sensing ports per unit. Connect instantly via NFC and manage your Xiaomi Bluetooth smart home devices through the built-in Bluetooth gateway. Keep your family safe online with Xiaomi Family NetShield for parental controls and network security protection. Whole-home Wi-Fi 7 coverage for the modern South African household — the Xiaomi Mesh System BE3600 Pro delivers uninterrupted speed in every room. Dead zones, buffering, and dropped connections have no place in a connected home. The Xiaomi Mesh System BE3600 Pro is a premium Wi-Fi 7 mesh system built for tech-savvy South African households that demand seamless, high-speed internet throughout every corner of their home. Powered by a Qualcomm quad-core 1.1 GHz processor and Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), this 3-pack mesh router delivers combined speeds of up to 3600 Mbps across dual bands — 2882 Mbps on 5 GHz and 688 Mbps on 2.4 GHz. With 4K-QAM modulation and Multi-Link Operation (MLO) enabling a single device to connect across both bands simultaneously, this Xiaomi mesh Wi-Fi system sets a new benchmark for home networking performance and reliability. Seamless mesh networking that adapts to your home. Three BE3600 Pro units work together as a single unified network using Xiaomi Mesh technology, covering 7–9 rooms and supporting up to 250 connected devices without a hiccup. Intelligent algorithms ensure seamless roaming as you move through your home — your device stays connected to the strongest signal automatically. If a mesh node encounters an issue, the network topology reconfigures itself to maintain an uninterrupted Wi-Fi connection. Each unit features four high-power signal amplifiers and four high-performance internal antennas for consistent, reliable coverage. This whole home Wi-Fi solution eliminates dead zones and ensures every device in your household gets the bandwidth it needs. Blazing-fast wired and wireless connectivity in every unit. Each mesh unit in the 3-pack comes equipped with a 2.5 Gbps Ethernet port plus three Gigabit WAN/LAN auto-sensing ports, giving you 2.5× the speed of traditional Gigabit connections for wired devices like gaming PCs, NAS drives, and smart TVs. LAN Aggregation support allows you to bond ports for even greater throughput. WAN/LAN auto-sensing means every port adapts to your setup automatically — no manual configuration required. Whether wired or wireless, this mesh router delivers the performance to handle 8K streaming, competitive gaming, and demanding smart home ecosystems simultaneously. Smart home integration and family-safe networking built in. The BE3600 Pro goes beyond just Wi-Fi. A simple NFC tap on the router connects your Android phone to the network instantly — no password entry needed. The built-in Bluetooth gateway provides seamless connectivity for compatible Xiaomi Bluetooth devices such as temperature monitors, motion sensors, and door/window sensors, making this mesh Wi-Fi system the hub of your smart home. Xiaomi Family NetShield delivers parental controls and network security protection to keep your family safe online, while Game Acceleration prioritises low-latency traffic for competitive gaming. Managed entirely through the Xiaomi Home App, this Wi-Fi 7 router puts complete control at your fingertips. FEATURES: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) with 4K-QAM and MLO for combined speeds up to 3600 Mbps across dual bands. 3-pack mesh system covering 7–9 rooms with support for up to 250 connected devices. 1× 2.5GbE + 3× 1GbE WAN/LAN auto-sensing ports per unit with LAN Aggregation support. Qualcomm IPQ5312 quad-core 1.1 GHz processor with 512MB DDR and 128MB flash storage. NFC instant connect and built-in Bluetooth gateway for Xiaomi smart home device integration. Xiaomi Family NetShield with parental controls and network security protection. Self-healing mesh topology that auto-reconfigures if a node encounters an error. item.g:title: UGREEN Bluetooth 6.0 USB Adapter
item.g:description: Connect Up to 5 Devices | Bluetooth 6.0 | USB-A | Up to 20m Wireless Range Quick Specs Bluetooth 6.0 USB-A Interface Connect Up to 5 Devices Up to 20m Wireless Range Plug & Play for Windows 11, 10 & 8.1 Windows 7 Compatible (Driver Required) Supports Keyboards, Mice, Headsets, Speakers, Printers & Game Controllers Upgrade your PC with reliable wireless connectivity using the UGREEN Bluetooth 6.0 USB Adapter. Connect up to five compatible devices simultaneously and enjoy a stable wireless range of up to 20 metres. With plug-and-play support for Windows 11, Windows 10 and Windows 8.1, it's an easy way to add Bluetooth functionality to your desktop or laptop. Add wireless connectivity to your desktop or laptop with the UGREEN Bluetooth 6.0 USB Adapter. This compact USB-A adapter allows you to connect up to five compatible devices simultaneously, including keyboards, mice, headsets, speakers, printers, smartphones and game controllers. Designed for convenience, it delivers a reliable wireless range of up to 20 metres, making it ideal for both home and office use. Simply plug the adapter into an available USB-A port for driver-free installation on Windows 11, Windows 10 and Windows 8.1, while Windows 7 is supported with driver installation. Whether you're upgrading an older PC or adding Bluetooth capability to a new system, the UGREEN Bluetooth 6.0 USB Adapter provides a simple, reliable and convenient wireless solution for everyday connectivity. Ways to Use Enterprise Environments: Ideal for large offices and corporate buildings requiring robust and reliable WiFi coverage. Educational Institutions: Perfect for schools and universities with high-density student and staff populations. Hospitality: Ensures seamless connectivity in hotels, resorts, and conference centers. Public Spaces: Suitable for airports, shopping malls, and other large public venues. Healthcare: Provides reliable wireless connectivity in hospitals and clinics, supporting critical applications and devices. item.g:title: Antec C2M ARGB Compact Micro-ATX Gaming Chassis - White
item.g:description: Antec C2M Constellation | Compact Micro-ATX | 270° 4mm Tempered Glass | 240mm + 120mm ARGB PWM Fans | USB Type-C 10Gbps | White Quick Specs Show off your build through 270° of full-view 4mm tempered glass Cool hard with a pre-installed 240mm reverse ARGB fan plus a 120mm rear ARGB fan Fit graphics cards up to 415mm and 360mm top radiators in a compact frame Build tool-free with clip-on front, side and top panels Connect fast through front USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) A 270° View of Your Build The C2M Constellation wraps the front and left side in 4mm tempered glass for a 270° pillar-less, full-view display. With no corner post breaking the line of sight, your motherboard, graphics card and ARGB lighting are all on show — a clean, transparent look that turns a compact Micro-ATX build into a centrepiece. Massive Airflow in a Compact Frame Mesh top, bottom and side panels let air move freely through the chassis, while a ventilated PSU shroud grille boosts vertical airflow for cooler, more stable temperatures. Removable top and bottom dust filters keep the interior clean and are quick to pull out and rinse, so the airflow advantage lasts. Serious Cooling Headroom The C2M ships ready to run, with a 240mm reverse single-frame ARGB PWM fan on the right side and a 120mm ARGB PWM fan at the rear — pushing up to 114.33 CFM at 800–1500 RPM while staying quiet at 30.4 dB(A). There's room for up to six 120mm fans in total, plus a 360mm top radiator and a 240mm side radiator, so both air and liquid builds have space to breathe. Graphics cards up to 415mm and CPU coolers up to 165mm fit comfortably — GPU clearance drops below 280mm when a side radiator is fitted. Tool-Free Building and Tidy Cable Routing Clip-on front, side and top panels use fixing slots and studs, so they come off and back on without tools for hassle-free installation and cleaning. Behind the motherboard tray you get 30mm of cable-routing clearance and three Velcro straps to keep wiring neat, while the front I/O — set low for desktop placement — puts USB 3.0, USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) and a headphone/mic combo jack within easy reach. FEATURES: Compact Micro-ATX chassis supporting Micro-ATX and ITX motherboards 270° full-view design with 4mm tempered glass across the front and left side Pre-installed 1 x 240mm reverse single-frame ARGB PWM fan (right side) and 1 x 120mm ARGB PWM fan (rear) Mesh top, bottom and side panels with a ventilated PSU shroud for high airflow Supports up to six 120mm fans — top 3 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm, side 2 x 120mm, rear 1 x 120mm Radiator support: 360mm top, 240mm side, 120mm rear Fits graphics cards up to 415mm (under 280mm with a side radiator) and CPU coolers up to 165mm Tool-free clip-on front, side and top panels Removable top and bottom dust filters 30mm cable-routing clearance with three Velcro straps Front I/O with USB 3.0, USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) and headphone/mic combo jack SPECIFICATIONS: Form Factor: Compact Micro-ATX Motherboard Support: Micro-ATX, ITX Case Material: Steel, plastic and 4mm tempered glass Side Window: 4mm tempered glass Front I/O: Power, USB 3.0 x1, USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) x1, Headphone/Mic Combo Jack Expansion Slots: 5 Drive Bays: 1 x 3.5", 1 x 2.5" Fan Support: Top: 3 x 120mm / 2 x 140mm Side: 2 x 120mm Rear: 1 x 120mm Included Fans: 1 x 240mm reverse single-frame ARGB PWM (right side), 1 x 120mm ARGB PWM (rear) Included Fan Performance: up to 114.33 CFM, 800–1500 RPM, 30.4 dB(A) Radiator Support: Top: 120 / 240 / 360mm Side: 120 / 240mm Rear: 120mm Max GPU Length: ≤ 415mm (< 280mm with side radiator installed) Max CPU Cooler Height: ≤ 165mm Max PSU Length: ≤ 225mm (cable excluded) Dust Filters: Top and bottom Cable-Routing Clearance: 30mm Product Dimensions: 44 x 22.2 x 44 cm (D x W x H) Product Weight: 6880 g WHAT'S IN THE BOX: Antec C2M ARGB Compact Micro-ATX Gaming Chassis – White x1 Why Antec? Antec has earned a long-standing reputation among South African PC builders for chassis that balance airflow, build quality and value. The C2M Constellation brings that pedigree to a compact Micro-ATX footprint, pairing a striking 270° tempered-glass view with real cooling headroom and pre-installed ARGB fans. For local gamers who want a small-form-factor ARGB case that still swallows a full-size graphics card and a 360mm radiator, the Antec C2M is a smart, eye-catching foundation for a tidy, future-ready build.

item.g:title: UGREEN USB Type-C to DisplayPort 1.4 Cable 1m
item.g:description: Experience seamless, high-fidelity visual output from your USB-C device to any DisplayPort monitor or display | Enjoy fluid gaming and true-to-life colours with 8K HDR support. Quick Specs Deliver stunning 8K resolution at 60Hz for unparalleled visual clarity. Experience ultra-smooth motion with support for 4K at 144Hz and 240Hz. Enjoy vibrant colours and enhanced contrast with HDR support. Benefit from advanced gaming features like VRR and ALLM for lag-free performance. Connect with confidence thanks to durable braided nylon and aluminium alloy construction. Unlock the full visual potential of your modern devices with the UGREEN USB Type-C to DisplayPort 1.4 Cable. This 1-meter USB Type-C to DisplayPort cable is your essential conduit for high-fidelity visual data, designed for users in South Africa who demand uncompromising clarity and performance. Whether you are a creative professional, a gamer seeking an edge, or a home user desiring an immersive cinematic experience, this DisplayPort 1.4 cable ensures your content is displayed with absolute accuracy. It expertly bridges the gap between USB Type-C enabled devices and DisplayPort monitors or televisions. For those who understand that a superior viewing experience begins with a superior connection, this cable is indispensable. This premium USB Type-C to DisplayPort connection supports the latest standards, making it ideal for demanding applications. Experience the difference a quality displayport cable can make. Engineered for breathtaking visual fidelity with DisplayPort 1.4. At its core, this UGREEN cable supports DisplayPort 1.4 standards, enabling a maximum bandwidth of 32.4 Gbps. This substantial throughput makes achieving resolutions as high as 8K (7680 × 4320) at a smooth 60Hz, or a stunning 4K at an exceptional 240Hz, possible. This isn't an approximation of high-definition; it is the delivery of true 8K and high-refresh-rate 4K content with absolute precision. The inclusion of HDR support means that colours are more vibrant, contrast is deeper, and the overall image is more lifelike. This level of detail and colour accuracy is critical for professionals and enthusiasts alike, solidifying its status as a top-tier displayport cable. Elevate your gaming and multimedia experience with this DisplayPort cable. For the gamer, the benefits of this USB Type-C to DisplayPort 1.4 cable are profound. Support for Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) and Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) synchronises your display's refresh rate with your graphics card's output, virtually eliminating screen tearing and input lag. This translates to smoother gameplay, more responsive controls, and a distinctly competitive advantage. Furthermore, AMD FreeSync and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility ensure that this cable works seamlessly with leading adaptive-sync technologies, making it an indispensable part of any high-performance gaming setup. The ability to drive 4K content at up to 240Hz means that even the fastest-paced games will appear astonishingly fluid. This is the DisplayPort connection you need for peak performance. Versatile connectivity for every setup using USB Type-C to DisplayPort. Beyond gaming, this UGREEN USB Type-C to DisplayPort cable offers exceptional versatility for productivity and entertainment. It supports HDCP 2.3 for secure content playback, ensuring compatibility with the latest streaming services and Blu-ray discs. The inclusion of eARC support further enhances its multimedia capabilities, allowing for high-quality audio passthrough. Whether you need to extend your laptop display for multitasking, mirror your screen for presentations, or leverage advanced modes like Samsung DeX or MacBook Clamshell mode, this cable provides the reliable connection you need. MST (Multi-Stream Transport) support also allows for daisy-chaining multiple compatible displays, expanding your workspace efficiently with this robust DisplayPort 1.4 cable. Features Experience unparalleled visual clarity with support for 8K resolution at 60Hz via this USB Type-C to DisplayPort cable. Achieve ultra-smooth gameplay and motion with 4K resolution at up to 240Hz, powered by the DisplayPort 1.4 standard. Enjoy lifelike colours and dynamic contrast with High Dynamic Range (HDR) support on your connected display. item.g:title: UGREEN Cat6 UTP Ethernet cable 2M - Red
item.g:description: The UGREEN Cat6 UTP Ethernet Cable is a straightforward solution for anyone needing a reliable wired network connection at home or in the office. At 2 m in length, it reaches comfortably between a router, modem, switch, or network adapter and your computer, laptop, smart TV, or games console. Built to the Cat6 standard, it supports data transfer speeds up to 1000 Mbps (1 Gbps) with a channel bandwidth of 250 MHz, keeping file transfers, video streaming, and online gaming running smoothly. The 26AWG copper clad aluminium conductors are arranged in an 8-core twisted-pair configuration using the 568B wiring method, which helps reduce noise, interference, and crosstalk. The standard 0.4mm brass nozzle is quick-detachable and compatible with 0.2mm, 0.6mm, and 0.8mm alternatives, while the hotend reaches up to 320°C and the heated bed reaches up to 120°C — covering PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, and TPU with ease. Tired of failed prints ruining your filament and your day? The Kobra S1 ACE 2 Pro Combo 3D printer addresses the most common printing frustrations with a suite of intelligent safeguards. AI spaghetti detection monitors the chamber camera feed and can skip over problem areas before they ruin an entire job. Automatic filament detection and auto-resume handle runouts without manual intervention, and power-loss recovery picks up exactly where it left off after an unexpected outage. Fully automatic levelling with object-skip and area levelling means the printer arrives ready to print — no manual Z-axis compensation required. Keep filament dry and prints in perfect condition The ACE 2 Pro unit is more than a multi-material hub — it actively dries your filament during printing at temperatures up to 65°C, helping to prevent moisture-related print defects. A built-in temperature and humidity sensor monitors conditions inside the unit, while a solenoid valve expels moist air during the drying cycle. The enclosed chamber on the Kobra S1 itself houses an activated carbon air filtration system, keeping your workspace clean when printing with materials like ABS and ASA. Full control, wherever you are Manage every aspect of your print from the 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen on the machine, or connect over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi to use the Anycubic App, Anycubic Slicer Next, or AC Cloud for remote monitoring and control. The printer runs on Kobra OS, supports multilingual setup from first boot, and is compatible with both Anycubic Slicer Next and OrcaSlicer. Quiet mode keeps noise at or below 44dB — considerate for home studios and shared workspaces. item.g:title: Cudy C200P 2-IN-1 SMB Router / AP Controller
item.g:description: 2-in-1 Gigabit VPN Router and AP Controller | 4 × PoE+ Ports with 60W Power Supply | Centralised Cudy AP Management | WireGuard, OpenVPN & IPsec VPN Quick Specs Consolidate your network infrastructure — the C200P serves as both a Gigabit VPN router and a centralised AP controller in a single compact unit. Power up to four access points cable-free with four IEEE 802.3at/af PoE+ LAN ports and a 60W total power supply. Secure your network with built-in VPN server and client support for WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec, ZeroTier, PPTP, and L2TP. Manage up to 200 Cudy Access Points from one interface, with multi-SSID, captive portal, and seamless Cudy Mesh support. Deploy flexibly — mount on a wall or sit on a desktop thanks to the compact metal chassis measuring just 190 × 100 × 28 mm. One Device, Two Roles — Router and AP Controller in a Single Box The Cudy C200P is designed for small and medium-sized businesses that need a clean, manageable network without deploying multiple separate devices. It operates simultaneously as a Gigabit VPN router handling your internet connection and as a centralised controller for your Cudy Access Points, letting you oversee your entire wireless infrastructure from a single unified interface. It can also run exclusively in AP Controller mode if a separate router is already in place, giving you the flexibility to slot it into an existing network without redesigning your topology. Power Your Access Points Directly — No Extra Switches Required Tired of hunting for spare power sockets every time you install an access point? The C200P's four Gigabit LAN ports (ports 2–5) are all PoE+ outputs compliant with IEEE 802.3at/af, delivering up to 30W per port and up to 55W total PoE budget from the built-in 60W power supply. That means you can run up to four Cudy APs — wall-plate, ceiling-mount, outdoor, or desktop form factors — directly from this unit over a single Ethernet cable each, eliminating the need for a separate PoE switch in most small-site deployments. Serious VPN Capability Baked In The C200P does not treat VPN as an afterthought. As VPN server it supports WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec, ZeroTier, PPTP, and L2TP, and as a VPN client it can tunnel outbound traffic through the same protocol range. WireGuard throughput reaches 213 Mbps upload and 152 Mbps download in server mode, while OpenVPN delivers 22 Mbps in both directions — solid figures for an SMB router at this price point. Maximum concurrent tunnels are 20 for IPSec and 16 each for PPTP/L2TP and OpenVPN, giving you ample headroom for remote staff and branch-to-branch links. Manage Your Wireless Network from a Single Dashboard In Main Router and AP Controller mode the C200P can manage up to 10 Cudy APs supporting up to 100 clients; in standalone AP Controller mode that ceiling rises to 200 APs. The management interface covers quick setup, AP management, multi-SSID configuration (up to 4 SSIDs per band), captive portal for guest networks, MAC filtering, IP/MAC binding, Wi-Fi time schedules, and per-device internet and VPN on/off controls. Remote management is available via HTTPS and TR-069/TR-098/TR-111/TR-181, and the dashboard surfaces internet, WAN, LAN, VPN, and DHCP server status at a glance. VPN server and client: WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec, ZeroTier, PPTP, L2TP — up to 20 concurrent IPSec tunnels. Cudy Mesh support for seamless roaming across compatible Cudy APs (wall-plate, ceiling-mount, outdoor, desktop). Captive portal and multi-SSID management (up to 4 SSIDs per band) via centralised AP controller interface. 1 × USB 3.0 port with Samba server functionality and Wake on LAN support. SPI firewall, DoS protection, DNS over TLS (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, Custom), and comprehensive IPv4/IPv6 support. Compact metal chassis with desktop and wall-mount installation options. item.g:description: Massive 420 × 420 × 500 mm build volume | Speeds up to 600 mm/s | Precise auto-levelling | Wi-Fi, app and cloud control | Power-loss resume Quick Specs Print ambitious creations with a massive 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume — room for truly large-scale single-piece prints Achieve faster results with print speeds of up to 600 mm/s, cutting waiting time without sacrificing quality Enjoy reliable first-layer adhesion every time thanks to precise auto-levelling and a PEI magnetic spring hotbed Stay in control from anywhere — manage prints via the Anycubic App, AC Cloud, or Anycubic Slicer Next over Wi-Fi Print with confidence knowing power-loss resume and filament runout detection protect your long prints from interruption Scale Up Your 3D Printing The Anycubic Kobra 3 Max is a large-format FDM 3D printer built for makers, designers, and hobbyists who are ready to stop thinking small. With a 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume, it lets you produce genuinely large prints in a single run — from cosplay props and architectural models to functional prototypes and statement display pieces. Pair that with print speeds of up to 600 mm/s and you have a machine that matches ambition with efficiency. A Bed You Can Trust, Every Single Print Tired of spending more time levelling your bed than actually printing? The Kobra 3 Max takes that frustration away with its precise auto-levelling system, which probes the hotbed automatically and compensates for any surface variation before each print begins. The PEI magnetic spring board provides reliable adhesion during printing and releases finished parts cleanly once cooled, so you spend less time fussing and more time making. Intelligent Protection for Long Runs Long prints on a large machine deserve long-print protection. The Kobra 3 Max includes both power-loss resume and filament runout detection with auto resume. If the power cuts unexpectedly, the printer picks up exactly where it left off when you turn it back on. If your filament spool runs dry mid-print, it alerts you to reload and then continues — keeping hours of print time from going to waste. Connect, Slice, and Print Your Way The Kobra 3 Max gives you multiple ways to work. Slice models in Anycubic Slicer or Orca Slicer, send files via USB drive or over Wi-Fi through AC Cloud and Anycubic Slicer Next, and monitor and control print jobs remotely from your phone using the Anycubic App. The onboard touchscreen handles quick adjustments right at the machine, and a dedicated port for cameras and other peripherals is available for expanded monitoring. Supported filaments include PLA, TPU, PETG, and ABS, giving you genuine material flexibility within a single machine. item.g:title: ASRock Challenger Pure 360 AIO Liquid Cooler - Black
item.g:description: Serious 360mm liquid cooling | 0dB silent operation | Precision copper cold plate | Broad platform compatibility | 6-year warranty Quick Specs Dominate thermals with a triple-fan 360mm radiator delivering serious heat dissipation for demanding CPUs Experience near-silence with 0dB Silent Cooling Technology — fans stop completely under low loads Achieve superior heat transfer through a precision-machined copper cold plate and dual-side inlet cooling path Connect to a wide range of platforms including AMD AM5, AM4 and Intel LGA1851, LGA1700 Build with confidence backed by a 6-year warranty and IIR+EPDM braided tubing built to last Pure Performance, Zero Compromise The ASRock Challenger Pure 360 AIO Liquid Cooler is built for gamers and builders who want maximum CPU cooling without the visual clutter of RGB lighting. A unified all-black design across the water block, aluminium radiator, and three 120mm fans delivers a bold yet understated presence that fits naturally into any clean, performance-focused build. It's the AIO for those who let temperatures — not LEDs — do the talking. A Pump Engineered for Unwavering Flow Tired of budget AIOs that throttle under sustained load? The Challenger Pure 360 runs a 3-phase, 6-slot, 4-pole pump built with automotive-grade components, spinning between 1200 and 3200 RPM. Its dual-side inlet cooling path delivers coolant directly to the CPU hot spot from multiple directions, shortening flow distance and evening out temperatures across the high-density micro-fin array. A precision-machined copper cold plate ensures flawless surface contact for efficient heat transfer session after session. Quiet When You Need It, Powerful When It Counts The three Ring-Frame Blade fans spin up to 1800 RPM, generating up to 53.9 CFM of airflow and 2.2 mmH2O of static pressure to push heat deep through the aluminium radiator. When the workload drops, 0dB Silent Cooling Technology kicks in — the fans stop entirely, giving you absolute silence and extending fan lifespan at the same time. At full tilt, noise peaks at just 27 dB(A), keeping your workspace calm even under pressure. Built to Install Cleanly and Last The Challenger Pure 360 ships with its three fans pre-installed and cables neatly routed for a clutter-free build from the outset. IIR+EPDM tubing resists coolant evaporation and deformation, wrapped in a braided sleeve for durability and a high-end finish. Multifunctional tube clips keep tubing tidy and secure, while a universal bracket with minimal installation steps covers AMD AM5 and AM4 as well as Intel LGA1851 and LGA1700. ASRock Therm-X1 thermal grease is included for efficient heat transfer right out of the box. The entire AIO module is backed by a 6-year warranty. item.g:title: Xiaomi Router BE19000 Pro
item.g:description: Wi-Fi 7 tri-band performance | 30Gbps wired throughput | Dual 10GE ports | AI Mesh roaming | Built-in Bluetooth gateway Quick Specs Experience next-generation Wi-Fi 7 tri-band wireless with combined speeds of up to 18,656Mbps across 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands Connect up to 1,000 devices simultaneously — and up to 300 Xiaomi Bluetooth devices via the built-in Bluetooth Mesh gateway Achieve blazing wired throughput with 2x 10GE and 4x 2.5GE ports delivering a total of 30Gbps aggregated bandwidth Expand your storage with a USB 3.0 port and M.2 slot, turning your router into a capable NAS device Enjoy seamless whole-home coverage with Xiaomi AI Mesh roaming, active dual cooling, and a Qualcomm A7 quad-core 1.8GHz processor The Router Your Home Network Has Been Waiting For The Xiaomi Router BE19000 Pro is built for households and home offices that demand the very best from their network. Whether you're streaming 8K content, running low-latency gaming sessions, transferring large files between devices, or managing a smart home full of connected gadgets, the BE19000 Pro handles it all without breaking a sweat. Wi-Fi 7 tri-band wireless and a powerful wired port configuration make this one of the most capable routers available for the modern connected home. Tired of Buffering, Lag, and Wi-Fi Dead Zones? The BE19000 Pro's tri-band Wi-Fi 7 delivers combined wireless speeds of up to 18,656Mbps across three dedicated bands — 2.4GHz for smart home devices, 5GHz for TVs and projectors, and the newly introduced 6GHz band for bandwidth-hungry devices like PCs, VR headsets, and smartphones. With 4x4 MIMO on all three bands and 12 spatial streams, dozens of devices can connect simultaneously with minimal interference. Multi-Link Operation (MLO) enables peak concurrent wireless speeds of up to 4.3Gbps, while Enhanced OFDMA and 4K QAM ensure every connection is as efficient and fast as possible. Wired Speed That Keeps Pace with 10 Gigabit Broadband Two 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports and four 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet ports combine to deliver a total of 30Gbps in aggregated wired bandwidth — far beyond what most routers offer. The 10GE ports are fully prepared for next-generation broadband upgrades and make light work of large file transfers, studio asset loading, and data-intensive workflows. WAN/LAN auto-sensing and dual LAN port aggregation add further flexibility, letting you configure the network to suit your exact setup. item.g:title: ASUS ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III Modular Power Supply
item.g:description: 1000W 80 PLUS Platinum Power | PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready | GaN MOSFET Efficiency | Magnetic OLED Display | 10-Year Warranty Quick Specs Achieve elite-level power delivery with 1000W of 80 PLUS Platinum-certified output for your most demanding build Experience next-gen GPU readiness with a PCIe Gen 5.1 16-pin cable capable of delivering up to 600W to your graphics card Enjoy whisper-quiet operation below 15 dB thanks to Cybenetics Lambda A++ certification and 0dB fan technology Monitor your system's real-time power draw at a glance with the signature magnetic OLED display Build with confidence backed by a 10-year warranty and full ATX 3.1 compliance Ultimate Power for Uncompromising Builds The ASUS ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III is built for the discerning builder who refuses to compromise — the flagship gaming rig, the heavily overclocked workstation, the next-gen GPU powerhouse that demands every watt it can get. Fully compliant with the ATX 3.1 standard and equipped with a PCIe Gen 5.1 16-pin cable capable of sending up to 600W to a single graphics card, this PSU is engineered to keep pace with today's most power-hungry hardware without breaking a sweat. GaN MOSFET and GPU-First Voltage Stability Tired of voltage fluctuations robbing your GPU of its peak performance? The ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III addresses this with an innovative GaN MOSFET that delivers up to 30% more power efficiency than conventional MOSFETs, while its smaller footprint allows for a more organised internal layout with larger heatsinks and better airflow. The patented 'GPU-First' intelligent voltage stabiliser (IVS) enhances voltage stability by up to 45% by sensing and prioritising power delivery directly to your graphics card — smoothing out the demands of the most intense gaming sessions and overclocking scenarios. Platinum-Certified Efficiency, Near-Silent Operation Earning both 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum certifications, the ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III leverages low-ESR Japanese capacitors for industry-leading efficiency, reduced heat generation, and improved acoustics. The Cybenetics Lambda A++ certification confirms noise output averages below 15 dB — practically inaudible under typical loads. The PWM-controlled dual-ball-bearing fan shuts off entirely when the PSU is operating at or below 30% load in standard mode, and a dedicated 0dB button gives you additional control over fan behaviour as your system transitions between load levels. Dual-ball bearings are rated for up to 80,000 hours of operation — twice the lifespan of sleeve bearing designs. Magnetic OLED Display, Turbo Mode, and Aura Sync The ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III goes beyond raw performance with a suite of experience-focused features. The signature magnetic OLED display shows real-time power draw at a glance, and because it attaches magnetically, it can be swapped to either side of the unit to suit fan-up or fan-down PSU installations. Turbo Mode unlocks support for extended power excursions, giving overclocking enthusiasts the headroom they need when pushing hardware to its limits. Etched modular cables in a pliable premium material make routing and management effortless, while Aura Sync ARGB support lets this PSU integrate seamlessly into a synchronised lighting setup. item.g:description: Your own private cloud — no monthly fees | Up to 64 TB of local storage | Simple app-guided setup | 4K HDMI output | AI-powered photo organisation Quick Specs Own your data — store up to 64 TB across two drive bays with no recurring cloud subscription fees Experience effortless setup with NFC tap-to-connect and a guided app wizard on iOS and Android Stream and display your media collection in 4K at 60Hz directly via the built-in HDMI port Protect your files with RAID 1 redundancy, encryption, firewall, and two-factor authentication Connect all your devices — compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, web browsers, and smart TVs Simple, Smart Storage for the Whole Family The UGREEN NASync DH2300 is a 2-bay home NAS designed for anyone who wants the convenience of cloud storage without the ongoing cost. Whether you are backing up family photos, streaming a movie collection to your TV, or keeping important documents accessible from anywhere, the DH2300 puts you in control of your own data — stored locally, secured privately, and reachable from any device. Getting Started Has Never Been This Easy Tired of tech products that require hours of configuration? The DH2300 is built for beginners with zero NAS experience. Simply download the UGREEN NAS app, tap your phone to the device using NFC to connect, and a guided setup wizard walks you through every step. Most users are up and running in under 15 minutes — no IT background required. Powerful Hardware, Low Power Draw At its core sits a Rockchip A72+A53 8-core processor running at 2.2 GHz, paired with 4 GB of LPDDR4X RAM. Your Data, Fully Protected The DH2300 supports JBOD, Basic, RAID 0, and RAID 1 configurations. Set up RAID 1 and one drive mirrors the other, so a single drive failure does not cost you your files. Advanced encryption, a built-in firewall, and two-factor authentication add further layers of security — and because everything is stored on your own hardware, not a third-party server, only you can access your data. The UGOS Pro operating system also provides granular permission management so each household member gets access to exactly what they need. item.g:title: ASUS ROG Strix SLC IV 360 ARGB LCD Liquid CPU Cooler - Black
item.g:description: Cable-free AIO cooling | 5.08" IPS LCD pump head | 360mm triple-fan radiator | ARGB lighting | 6-year warranty Quick Specs Dominate thermals with a 360mm radiator and three integrated 120mm ARGB fans delivering up to 82.57 CFM of airflow Experience cable-free simplicity with the exclusive ASUS AIO Q-Connector — power and signals via direct metal contact points, no messy wires Command your build through a vivid 5.08-inch full colour IPS LCD displaying live system stats or custom artwork at 60Hz Achieve whisper-quiet operation with PWM-controlled fans reaching as low as 800 RPM and peaking at just 35.78 dB(A) Build with confidence across Intel LGA 1851/1700 and AMD AM5/AM4 platforms, backed by a 6-year warranty Elite Cooling Meets Next-Level Aesthetics The ROG Strix SLC IV 360 ARGB LCD is engineered for builders who refuse to compromise — gamers, overclockers, and enthusiasts who demand the highest thermal performance without sacrificing a clean, stunning build. With a 360mm aluminium radiator, a high-performance pump, and three pre-installed ARGB fans, this AIO liquid cooler is built to keep even the most demanding Intel Core Ultra and AMD Ryzen 9000 processors running cool and stable through the longest sessions. Tired of cable chaos ruining an otherwise perfect build? The exclusive ASUS AIO Q-Connector changes everything. This innovative module connects directly to compatible ASUS motherboards via metal contact points, delivering both power and signals without a single visible cable between the water block, radiator, and motherboard. The result is an installation that is not only faster and simpler, but genuinely pristine — the kind of clean build that turns heads at every LAN party. For motherboards without Q-Connector support, standard installation is fully supported using the included hardware. A Living Display at the Heart of Your Build The 5.08-inch full colour IPS LCD on the pump head is more than a showpiece. Running at 60Hz with support for PNG, JPG, GIF, MP4, and AVI formats, it can display real-time system statistics, custom artwork, or animated content — all managed through the ASUS InfoHub application. The 360° rotatable tubing couplings mean the display can be orientated perfectly regardless of your case layout, while the 250mm centred tubing keeps component obstruction to a minimum for a truly breathtaking visual result. Precision Engineering from Pump to Plate Every component in the SLC IV 360 is built for long-term reliability. The copper CPU cold plate features precision micro-channels that maximise heat exchange efficiency, rapidly drawing thermal energy away from the processor. item.g:title: ASUS TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB CPU Liquid Cooler - White
item.g:description: 360mm triple-fan liquid cooling | AURA Sync ARGB lighting | Broad Intel & AMD compatibility Quick Specs Keep your CPU running cool under pressure with a triple-fan 360mm radiator delivering up to 90.78 CFM airflow Enjoy near-silent operation with a maximum noise level of just 37.4 dB(A), even under full load Customise your build's look with AURA Sync-compatible ARGB lighting across three fans and an RGB pump cap Build with confidence — the TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB is backed by an exceptional 6-year warranty Connect to virtually any modern platform with compatibility spanning Intel LGA1851/1700/1200 and AMD AM5/AM4 Built to Tame the Toughest CPUs The ASUS TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB is a 360mm all-in-one liquid cooler engineered for builders and gamers who demand sustained, high-performance cooling without compromise. Whether you're running a high-core-count workload, pushing your CPU with an all-day gaming session, or overclocking for maximum output, the LC III 360 ARGB is built to keep temperatures in check and your system performing at its peak. Triple-Fan Firepower, Whisper-Quiet Delivery Tired of cooling solutions that either roar like a jet engine or fail to keep up when things get serious? The TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB houses three 120mm TUF Gaming MF-12 fans that spin between 650 and 2600 RPM, delivering up to 90.78 CFM of airflow and 3.82 mmH2O of static pressure — all while staying at or below 37.4 dB(A) at maximum speed. PWM and DC control modes give you precise speed management, so you can tune for silence or cooling performance as your workload demands. ARGB Lighting That Commands Attention The three ARGB fans and the illuminated RGB pump cap bring your build to life with vibrant, customisable lighting. AURA Sync support means the LC III 360 ARGB integrates seamlessly with your ASUS AURA ecosystem, letting you synchronise lighting effects across your entire build from a single interface. The bold TUF Gaming aesthetic — angular pump head, sleeved rubber tubes, and an all-white finish — makes a statement whether your case has a glass side panel or not. Fits Your Build, Ready to Install With a copper CPU plate for efficient heat transfer, an aluminium radiator measuring 397 x 120 x 27 mm, and 400mm sleeved rubber tubes offering ample routing flexibility, the LC III 360 ARGB is designed to fit cleanly into a wide range of mid-tower and full-tower cases. Compatibility covers Intel LGA1851, LGA1700, and LGA1200 as well as AMD AM5 and AM4 sockets, and the cooler ships with pre-applied thermal compound so you can get straight to the build. Backed by a 6-year warranty, this is a cooling investment built to last. item.g:title: PCBuilder Intel i7-14700 HOME Master Windows 11 Desktop PC
item.g:description: QUICK SPEC: CPU – Intel i7-14700 20-Core 2.5GHz LGA1700 CPU (Up to 5.4GHz) Graphics Card – Intel built-in graphics Motherboard – B760M Chipset LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard Memory – 16GB DDR4 3200MHz Desktop Memory Storage – 480GB M.2 NVMe SSD Chassis – PCBuilder Bunker Micro-ATX Chassis Operating System – Microsoft Windows 11 Strategise and reach your targets easily with the PCBuilder i7-14700 HOME Master Windows 11 Desktop PC. This pre-built desktop PC is designed for use at home or in the office and is powered by an i7-14700 CPU with built-in Intel graphics. It also comes with a B760M chipset motherboard, 16GB of high-speed DDR4 memory, and a 480GB M.2 NVMe SSD. Built with efficiency in mind so you can reach your deadlines on time, this pre-built PC has everything you need to hit those daily targets. With Microsoft Windows 11 already installed, you can also run the latest versions of all your apps with more features and better security. Its built-in Intel graphics are also a great option for presentations, video content or editing. The HOME Master features an Intel i7-14700 CPU and DDR4 memory, which will ensure that every task gets completed quickly and efficiently. With 20 cores and 16GB of DDR4 memory, no task is too much for it to handle. Data can be transferred and applications can be loaded at lightning-quick speeds thanks to the included M.2 NVMe SSD. This makes using apps like Microsoft Word and Excel run even more smoothly, so you can get more work done. All the components are held together with a high-performance Intel LGA1700 Motherboard with Lightning Gen 4 support. The motherboard delivers an efficient and productive experience with stable functionality and maximum performance. Everything is protected and held together inside a sleek-looking Micro-ATX Chassis. This modern-looking compact chassis is easy to maintain and upgrade, while its smaller form factor is great for saving some space in the home or office. The HOME Master comes installed with Windows 11 which has easy-to-use tools that can help you optimize your screen space and maximize your productivity. It features great tools like Microsoft Edge, the new and improved Microsoft Store, Snap Layouts to arrange your open windows into grids, Desktops for better organization, as well as Widgets. Windows Security also offers advanced protections to defend against today’s ever-changing cyber threats. This includes device encryption, find my device, firewall and network protection, internet protection, parental controls, secure boot, and Windows Hello among other features. item.g:title: ASUS ROG STRIX 1000W 80 PLUS Platinum ATX 3.1 Fully-Modular Power Supply
item.g:description: 1000W of platinum-efficiency power | ATX 3.1 & PCIe Gen 5.1 ready | GaN MOSFET for cooler, quieter operation | 10-year warranty Quick Specs Achieve platinum-grade efficiency with GaN MOSFET technology delivering up to 30% superior power efficiency over conventional designs Dominate next-gen builds with native PCIe Gen 5.1 support via a 12V-2x6 connector ready for the latest graphics cards Enjoy near-silent operation thanks to 0dB technology that shuts the 135mm fan off completely at 40% load or below Experience unwavering GPU stability with the patented GPU-FIRST intelligent voltage stabilizer enhancing voltage delivery by up to 45% Build with confidence backed by a 10-year warranty and dual ball fan bearings rated for up to 80,000 hours of operation Superior Stability. Next-Level Efficiency. The ASUS ROG STRIX 1000W Platinum is engineered for builders who refuse to compromise — pairing a high-end gaming rig with a power supply that can genuinely keep pace. Fully ATX 3.1 compliant and certified to both 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum standards, it delivers 1000W of rock-solid power while wasting as little energy as possible. Whether you're running a flagship GPU through intense gaming sessions or creative workloads, the ROG Strix Platinum is built to feed your system without flinching. GaN MOSFET: Smaller Component, Bigger Impact At the heart of this PSU's efficiency story is GaN MOSFET technology. By replacing conventional components with gallium nitride MOSFETs, ASUS achieves up to 30% superior power efficiency — meaning less energy wasted as heat and a more organised internal layout. That freed-up space makes room for larger ROG heatsinks and improved airflow, keeping critical components cooler and quieter than reference designs. The result is a PSU that runs leaner and lasts longer, session after demanding session. GPU-FIRST: Power Where Your Build Needs It Most Tired of voltage instability tanking your frame rates at the worst possible moment? The ROG Strix 1000W Platinum's patented GPU-FIRST intelligent voltage stabilizer puts your graphics card first. By connecting the included IVS cable, you activate a mode that enhances voltage stability by up to 45% to the GPU — smoothing out power delivery during overclocking and peak gaming loads. If you prefer conventional CPU-focused voltage sensing, simply disconnect the IVS cable. Either way, your build stays stable. Ready for the Next Generation — and Built to Last With a native 12V-2x6 connector, the ROG Strix 1000W Platinum is PCIe Gen 5.1 ready, capable of piping up to 600W to next-gen graphics cards without an adapter in sight. The fully modular cable system means you only route what you need, keeping your build clean and airflow unobstructed. Dual ball fan bearings are rated for up to 80,000 hours — twice the lifespan of sleeve bearing designs — and the Cybenetics Lambda A+ certification confirms average noise levels below 20 dB. Backed by a 10-year warranty, this is a PSU you install once and trust for the long haul. Features 1000W total output with 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum certification for industry-leading efficiency GaN MOSFET technology delivers up to 30% superior power efficiency and a more compact internal layout for improved cooling Patented GPU-FIRST intelligent voltage stabilizer enhances GPU voltage stability by up to 45% during gaming and overclocking ATX 3.1 compliant with native 12V-2x6 (PCIe Gen 5.1) connector — ready for the latest high-power graphics cards 0dB technology: 135mm fan shuts off completely at 40% load or below for silent light-load operation; dedicated 0dB fan button for user control Dual ball fan bearings rated for up to 80,000 hours — twice the lifespan of sleeve bearing designs Fully modular cable design with premium etched cables that are flexible, UL1581 flame-test certified, and operate well within safe temperature limits Comprehensive protection suite: OPP, OVP, UVP, SCP, OCP, OTP Cybenetics Lambda A+ certified — average noise below 20 dB 10-year warranty included Specifications Wattage: 1000W Efficiency Rating: 80 PLUS Platinum Modularity: Full Modular Form Factor: ATX ATX Standard: ATX 3.1 12V-2x6 / PCIe Gen5 Connector: Yes Fan Size: 135 mm Colour: Black Warranty: 120 months Product Weight: 1810g Product Dimensions: 16.0 x 15.0 x 8.6 cm What's in the Box ASUS ROG STRIX 1000W Platinum Power Supply – Black x1 Power Cord x1 Motherboard Power Cable x1 (610mm) CPU Cable x2 (1000mm) PCI-E Gen 5.1 (16-pin-to-16-pin) Cable x1 (750mm) PCI-E (8-pin-to-6+2pin) Cable x4 (750mm) SATA 1-to-3 Cable x2 (400+120+120mm) Peripheral 1-to-3 Cable x1 (400+150+150mm) ROG Strix DIY Sticker x1 User Manual x1 Why ASUS ASUS Republic of Gamers exists to push gaming hardware beyond its limits — and the ROG Strix power supply line is no exception.
