item.g:title: AMD RYZEN 5 9600 6-Core 3.8GHz AM5 CPU
item.g:description: Elevate your computing to new heights with the AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series CPUs. These processors represent the pinnacle of desktop performance, engineered for those who demand the best from their systems. With integrated AMD Radeon™ Graphics, enjoy breathtaking visuals and seamless gameplay without the need for a separate graphics card, making these CPUs ideal for gamers and creators alike. The AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series features AMD EXPO™ Technology, delivering optimised settings and enhanced gaming performance. This technology ensures that your games run smoothly and look stunning, providing an immersive experience that takes your gaming to the next level. At the heart of the Ryzen 9000 Series are advanced AMD Ryzen™ Technologies. Precision Boost optimises performance for every task, dynamically adjusting clock speeds to deliver the power you need when you need it most. Smart Access Memory allows the CPU to fully utilise the GPU’s memory, resulting in faster performance and reduced latency, perfect for intensive gaming and creative workloads. The Ryzen 9000 Series supports the latest DDR5 memory and PCIe 5.0, preparing your system for the future with the bandwidth and speed necessary for next-generation graphics and storage solutions. This future-proofing ensures that your system remains cutting-edge, capable of handling the most demanding applications and games with ease. Combining a 27-inch QHD QD-OLED panel with a 500Hz refresh rate and a 0.03ms grey-to-grey response time, this monitor is engineered to close the gap between your reflexes and what appears on screen — making it an indispensable weapon for competitive esports players and fast-paced shooter enthusiasts alike. item.g:title: Anycubic Kobra S1 Max Combo - 3D Printer
item.g:description: Large-format multicolour 3D printing | Fully-enclosed CoreXY precision | Up to 16-colour output | Engineering-grade filament support | 350×350×350mm³ build volume Quick Specs Print large-scale models with a generous 350×350×350mm³ build volume — ideal for ambitious, full-sized creations Achieve vivid multicolour results with up to 16-colour printing capability via ACE 2 Pro units Experience consistent, reliable prints inside a fully-enclosed CoreXY structure built for precision and stability Push material boundaries with a 350°C hardened steel nozzle compatible with engineering-grade and composite filaments Enjoy broad filament compatibility across PLA, PETG, ASA, ABS, TPU, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, and PLA Silk Large-Format 3D Printing, Unleashed in Full Colour The Anycubic Kobra S1 Max Combo is built for makers, designers, and engineers who refuse to be limited — by size, by colour, or by material. Combining a fully-enclosed CoreXY printer with the ACE 2 Pro automatic colour-exchange system, this combo delivers a 350×350×350mm³ build volume alongside the capability to print in up to 16 colours in a single run. Whether you're producing functional prototypes, detailed display models, or large creative projects, the Kobra S1 Max Combo gives you the tools to do it at scale. A Build Volume That Matches Your Ambitions Tired of splitting large models into multiple prints just to fit your build plate? The Kobra S1 Max Combo's 350×350×350mm³ print volume means you can take on full-scale functional parts, oversized figurines, architectural models, and more — all in a single print session. The fully-enclosed CoreXY construction keeps the motion system rigid and precise across that entire volume, so dimensional accuracy doesn't suffer as your prints grow larger. Up to 16 Colours, Automatically Managed The ACE 2 Pro automatic colour exchange units included in this combo take multicolour FDM printing to a new level. With the right configuration of ACE 2 Pro units, the system supports up to 16-colour printing — letting you produce richly detailed, vibrant models without manual filament swaps. The result is creative output that genuinely reflects your designs rather than being constrained by single-material limitations. Built for Demanding Filaments The Kobra S1 Max Combo's hardened steel nozzle handles far more than standard PLA. With a maximum nozzle temperature of 350°C, you can print carbon-fibre composites such as PLA-CF and PETG-CF, flexible TPU, weather-resistant ASA, and tough ABS with confidence. The fully-enclosed chamber supports the stable thermal environment that engineering-grade and composite materials demand, giving you consistent results across a wide range of applications. Features 350×350×350mm³ build volume for large-scale and full-sized prints Up to 16-colour printing capability with ACE 2 Pro units Fully-enclosed CoreXY construction for rigidity and dimensional precision 350°C hardened steel nozzle supports composite and engineering-grade filaments Active chamber heating at 65°C for consistent print environment Compatible with PLA, PETG, ASA, ABS, TPU, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, and PLA Silk FDM (Fused Deposition Modelling) printing technology Specifications Brand: Anycubic Product Name: Anycubic Kobra S1 Max Combo Model Number: Kobra S1 Max Combo Manufacturer: Anycubic SKU / Part Number: KSMCBK0B-O Printer Technology: FDM (Fused Deposition Modelling) Printing Volume: 350×350×350mm³ Multicolour Printing: Up to 16-colour printing (with ACE 2 Pro units) Supporting Filaments: PLA, PETG, ASA, ABS, TPU, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, PLA Silk Nozzle Material: Hardened Steel Max Nozzle Temperature: 350°C Construction: Fully-Enclosed CoreXY Warranty: 12 Months What's in the Box Anycubic Kobra S1 Max – Black x1 Anycubic ACE 2 Pro x1 Spool Holder x1 Signal Cable x1 Teflon Tubes x4 Power Cord x1 Return Detection Module x1 M4 Screws x2 M2.5 Screws x2 Cable Clip x2 Allen Key x3 Nozzle Cleaner x1 Grease x1 Nozzle Cleaning Module x1 Nozzle Parking Pad x1 Activated Carbon Pack x1 Filament Samples x1 Spool Holder Assembly x1 Why Anycubic Anycubic has built its reputation on making professional-grade 3D printing accessible — combining hardware innovation with practical usability. item.g:title: ASUS ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB Liquid CPU Cooler - Black
item.g:description: Next-gen Asetek Gen7 V2 pump cooling | 360° rotatable water block | Triple ARGB fans with 0dB mode | Full Aura Sync support | 6-year warranty Quick Specs Dominate heat with Asetek's Gen7 V2 pump, delivering up to 100W more cooling capacity than its predecessor for rock-solid stability under the heaviest workloads. Install with total freedom thanks to a 360° rotatable water block with magnetic design, accommodating virtually any mounting orientation. Experience whisper-quiet operation with 0dB fan technology that drops all three fans to 0 RPM during low-load moments. Illuminate your build with 10+ Aura Sync lighting modes — including Smart mode that dynamically reflects real-time hardware load. Enjoy broad platform compatibility across Intel LGA 1851, 1700, 1200, 115x and AMD AM5 and AM4 sockets, backed by a 6-year warranty. Cool Beyond Limits. Build Beyond Ordinary. The ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB is a premium all-in-one liquid CPU cooler built for gamers and builders who refuse to compromise on performance or aesthetics. Powered by Asetek's latest Gen7 V2 pump with updated cold plate technology, it brings serious thermal headroom to high-end Intel and AMD platforms — keeping your processor cool, stable, and ready for anything you throw at it. A Pump That Outperforms Its Generation Tired of AIO coolers that struggle under sustained, intensive loads? The ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB addresses that head-on with Asetek's new Gen7 V2 pump, which delivers up to 100W of additional cooling capacity and temperatures up to 0.5°C lower compared to the previous Gen7 pump. Running at 800–2,800 RPM, it moves coolant efficiently through a 400 mm sleeved rubber tube and a copper cold plate, extracting heat from your CPU before it ever becomes a problem. Installation Flexibility Without Compromise Fitting a liquid cooler into a custom build can be a frustrating exercise in compromise — but the Strix LC III 360 ARGB was designed to eliminate that friction. The water block features a 360° rotatable magnetic design, meaning you can orient the pump head to face any direction without fighting cables or clearance issues. Whether you're working in a compact mid-tower or a spacious full-tower, the cooler adapts to your build — not the other way around. Silent When You Need It, Brilliant Always Three ROG Strix AF-12S ARGB fans sit across the 360mm aluminium radiator, each 120 x 120 x 25 mm and capable of spinning between 800 and 2,200 RPM via PWM and DC control. During light workloads, 0dB technology drops them to a complete standstill — zero noise, zero distraction. When performance demands ramp up, the fans deliver up to 70.38 CFM of airflow at 3.92 mmH2O static pressure, with anti-vibration rubber corners keeping resonance noise to a minimum. Even under full load, the system tops out at just 36 dB(A). And through Aura Sync, the ARGB lighting across the fans and pump cap can be tuned to match your rig — with Smart mode even adjusting lighting dynamically to reflect hardware load in real time. Features Asetek Gen7 V2 pump delivers up to 100W more cooling capacity and temperatures up to 0.5°C lower than the previous Gen7 pump 360° rotatable water block with magnetic design for flexible, orientation-free installation Three ROG Strix AF-12S ARGB 120mm fans with 0dB mode — fans drop to 0 RPM under low load for silent operation PWM and DC fan control for precise, smooth speed management across the 800–2,200 RPM range Anti-vibration rubber corners on each fan reduce resonance and operational noise Aura Sync support with 10+ lighting modes, including Smart mode that visualises hardware load dynamically Broad socket compatibility: Intel LGA 1851, 1700, 1200, 115x and AMD AM5, AM4 Pre-applied thermal compound on the copper cold plate for straightforward installation Specifications Radiator Size: 360 mm Socket Compatibility: Intel LGA 1851 | Intel LGA 1700 | Intel LGA 1200 | Intel LGA 115x AMD AM5 | AMD AM4 Fan Count: 3 Pump Display: RGB Max Noise Level: 36db RGB Lighting: Yes Tube Length: 400 mm Colour: Black Warranty: 72 months Product Dimensions: 39.4 x 12.1 x 2.7 cm What's in the Box ASUS ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB Liquid CPU Cooler - Black x1 120mm Radiator Fan x3 1-to-3 Fan Splitter Cable x1 1-to-4 ARGB Splitter Cable x1 ROG VIP Card x1 ROG Sticker x1 ROG Cable Organiser x1 Quick Start Guide x1 Accessory Pack of Screws and Brackets x1 Why ASUS ROG ASUS ROG — Republic of Gamers — exists to push the boundaries of what gaming hardware can achieve. From motherboards to peripherals to cooling, every ROG product is engineered for those who demand performance without visual compromise. The ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB is a fitting expression of that philosophy: serious thermal engineering wrapped in unmistakable ROG aesthetics, built to anchor your next high-performance build.

item.g:title: ASUS TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB White Edition Liquid CPU Cooler
item.g:description: 360mm all-in-one liquid cooling | Integrated triple ARGB fans | Single-cable installation | Aura Sync lighting | 6-year warranty Quick Specs Keep your CPU running cool with a 360mm radiator and three integrated ARGB fans delivering 90.78 CFM airflow and 3.82 mmH2O static pressure Enjoy dramatically cleaner builds — a single cable handles both fan power and ARGB lighting across all three fans Experience long-lasting reliability from an upgraded three-phase, six-slot, four-pole pump engineered for up to twice the lifespan and 30% greater efficiency Customise your build's aesthetic with Aura Sync ARGB lighting on both the pump top and integrated fans to complement your TUF Gaming setup Build with confidence backed by a 6-year warranty and broad socket support for Intel LGA 1851/1700/1200 and AMD AM5/AM4 platforms Serious Cooling, Seriously Clean Build The ASUS TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB White Edition is an all-in-one liquid CPU cooler built for builders who refuse to compromise on performance or presentation. With a 360mm aluminium radiator, three pre-installed integrated 120mm ARGB fans, and an efficient upgraded pump, it keeps even demanding processors at optimal temperatures — all wrapped in a clean white aesthetic that pairs beautifully with TUF Gaming motherboards. An Upgraded Pump That Goes the Distance Tired of cooling solutions that lose efficiency over time? The LC III's pump has been redesigned with a three-phase, six-slot, four-pole architecture and a ceramic shaft, delivering up to twice the lifespan of previous generations and improving efficiency by up to 30% — while also running quieter. Combined with pre-applied thermal compound on the copper CPU plate, getting optimal contact and performance from day one has never been more straightforward. One Cable. Three Fans. Zero Clutter. The integrated fan design is one of the LC III's most builder-friendly improvements. All three ARGB fans connect through a single cable that carries both power and lighting — reducing cable clutter from six connections down to one. Anti-vibration rubber pads at all four corners of each fan dampen resonance, and the braided pump and ARGB header cables make routing through your chassis clean and flexible. Aura Sync Lighting That Commands Attention The pump top features the TUF Gaming logo illuminated with customisable Aura Sync ARGB lighting, letting you dial in the exact colour and effect that defines your build. The three integrated MF-12 fans add matching ARGB illumination across the entire radiator face, creating a cohesive visual statement. Whether your build is all-white or accented with colour, the LC III White Edition is designed to sit centre stage. Features 360mm aluminium radiator with reinforced 400mm sleeved rubber tubing for enhanced durability and chassis compatibility Three pre-installed integrated TUF GAMING LC III ARGB MF-12 120mm fans — no separate fan mounting required Single-cable connection delivers both PWM/DC fan control and ARGB lighting to all three fans, drastically reducing cable clutter Upgraded three-phase, six-slot, four-pole pump with ceramic shaft — up to twice the lifespan and 30% improved efficiency versus previous generation Aura Sync ARGB lighting on pump top and integrated fans for full ecosystem lighting customisation Anti-vibration rubber pads on all four corners of each fan to reduce resonance noise Pre-applied thermal compound on copper CPU plate for immediate optimal thermal contact Compatible with Intel LGA 1851, LGA 1700, LGA 1200 and AMD AM5, AM4 sockets Specifications Radiator Size: 360 mm Socket Compatibility: Intel LGA 1851 | Intel LGA 1700 | Intel LGA 1200 AMD AM5 | AMD AM4 Fan Count: 3 Pump Display: RGB Max Noise Level: 37.4db RGB Lighting: Yes Tube Length: 400 mm Colour: White Warranty: 72 months What's in the Box ASUS TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB White Edition CPU Liquid Cooler x1 Accessory Pack of Screws and Brackets x1 TUF GAMING Sticker x1 Quick Start Guide x1 Why ASUS ASUS has built a reputation for engineering components that perform under pressure and last the distance — the TUF Gaming line embodies that philosophy with military-grade durability standards and rigorous testing. item.g:title: Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4
item.g:description: Powerful cordless cleaning | 90-minute runtime | Blue light dust detection | H13 HEPA filtration | Multi-surface attachments Quick Specs Experience powerful 25 000 Pa suction and 230AW airwatts to lift everyday dust, debris, and hair effortlessly. Enjoy up to 90 minutes of runtime on a single charge — enough to tackle the whole home in one go. Reveal hidden dust with a 180° blue light that makes fine particles under beds and sofas clearly visible. Breathe easier with a 5-stage H13-grade HEPA filtration system capturing 99.99% of particles as small as 0.3μm. Clean every corner with five dedicated attachments covering floors, mattresses, crevices, and hard-to-reach spaces. Whole-Home Cleaning, Reimagined The Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 is built for households that demand serious performance without the constraints of a cord. Delivering up to 25 000 Pa of suction power and 230AW of consistent airflow, it handles everything from fine dust and pet hair to stubborn debris across multiple floor types — all from a single, lightweight device. Whether you're working through open-plan living areas or navigating the tight corners of a busy South African home, this cordless vacuum is designed to keep pace with your life. See What You've Been Missing Tired of vacuuming a room only to spot dust you missed the moment the light catches the floor? The Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 addresses this with a 180° blue light dust-revealing system built into the all-flooring brush bar. With a 30 cm illumination range and up to 30x dust magnification, fine particles hiding under sofas, beds, and along skirting boards become clearly visible — so you clean with confidence rather than guesswork. Smart Suction That Adapts As You Clean Built-in infrared sensors detect dust levels in real time, and in Auto mode the vacuum automatically adjusts suction power to match what it finds. Heavy debris triggers maximum suction; lighter dust draws less power, conserving battery life. The LED smart display keeps you informed at a glance, showing battery level, cleaning mode, and a colour-coded dirt indicator — blue for clean, yellow for light dirt, orange for heavy dirt — so you always know exactly what's happening. Anti-Tangle Design and Long-Lasting Filtration Long hair is the bane of most vacuum brush heads, but the Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 tackles it with dual anti-tangle technology. Built-in comb teeth on the all-flooring brush bar detangle hair during vacuuming, while the mini electric brush uses a single-arm floating roller that channels hair directly into the suction airflow. Behind the brushes, 12-cone cyclonic separation keeps airflow stable and extends filter life, feeding into a 5-stage precision filtration system that traps 99.99% of fine particles — including dust mites — and returns cleaner air to your space. Features 25 000 Pa maximum suction power with 230AW consistent airflow for rapid removal of dust, debris, and hair. Up to 90 minutes of runtime in Eco mode on a single removable, replaceable lithium-ion battery. 180° blue light dust-revealing with 30 cm illumination range and 30x dust magnification for thorough cleaning. Auto mode with real-time infrared dust detection automatically adjusts suction for efficient, energy-conscious cleaning. 5-stage H13-grade HEPA filtration system delivers 99.99% filtration efficiency for particles as small as 0.3μm. 12-cone cyclonic separation maintains stable, consistent suction and extends filter lifespan. Dual anti-tangle design on brush bar and mini electric brush handles up to 200 strands of long hair in a single pass. LED smart display shows battery level, cleaning mode, and colour-coded dirt status in real time. Bendable tube reaches low, hard-to-access spaces without requiring you to bend down. Washable attachments and wall-mounted charging dock for convenient storage and easy maintenance. Specifications Brand: Xiaomi Warranty: 12 Months Suction Power: 25000pa Max Runtime: 90 mins on auto mode HEPA Filtration: Stage 5 H13-grade HEPA Attachments Included: All-flooring dust-revealing brush bar,2-in-1 crevice brush, Mini electric brush, Bendable tube, Extension rod Display: LED What's in the Box Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 (Model F203) x1 Battery x1 Extension rod x1 Bendable tube x1 All-flooring dust-revealing brush bar x1 2-in-1 crevice brush x1 Mini electric brush x1 Charging dock wall mount x1 Power adapter x1 Charging dock wall mount kit (plug holder clip x1, wall plug x2, pointed screw x2) x1 User manual x1

item.g:title: Anycubic Photon Mono M7 Pro 10.1" 14K Resin 3D Printer
item.g:description: Bring your finest ideas to life in breathtaking detail. The Anycubic Photon Mono M7 Pro is a next-generation resin 3D printer built for makers who refuse to compromise on quality. At its heart sits a crisp 10.1-inch 14K monochrome LCD, resolving fine features down to a razor-sharp 16.8µm on the X/Y axis - so every miniature, prototype and precision part comes off the plate looking exactly as you imagined it. Speed keeps pace with the detail. Paired with High-Speed Resin, the M7 Pro reaches printing speeds of up to 170mm/h, turning what used to be an overnight wait into a same-session result. And thanks to Auto-Adaptive Technology with dynamic temperature control, the printer keeps your resin in its ideal working range for consistent, repeatable prints - batch after batch. It's designed to work smarter, not harder. Auto Resin Refill and Withdrawal tops up the vat and draws resin back automatically, so longer prints run unattended without the mess or the guesswork. A generous 223 × 126 × 230mm (6.5L) build volume gives you room for large single models or a full plate of miniatures, while a laser-engraved build plate, dual linear Z-axis rails with 10µm precision and a leveling-free design mean strong adhesion and reliable results straight out of the box. Versatile by nature, the M7 Pro handles high-speed, water-washable, standard, ABS-like and plant-based resins, and connects your way over USB, Wi-Fi or LAN. With Photon Workshop and Chitubox support, a responsive 4.3-inch touchscreen and full Anycubic App integration, it's a resin 3D printer that fits effortlessly into your workflow - whether you're a hobbyist, a tabletop enthusiast or a professional chasing production-grade accuracy. The Anycubic Photon Mono M7 Pro - precision, speed and effortless printing, ready for whatever you create next. Features 10.1-inch 14K mono LCD screen for high-resolution resin printing 170mm/h with High-speed Resin Designed for detailed miniatures, prototypes, and precision parts Auto-Adaptive Technology Control Heating Auto Resin Refill, Withdrawal Resin-based photopolymer printing process Specifications Printing Volume: 223 x 126 x 230mm³ (6.5L) Printing Speed: Max Speed ≤130mm/h; Standard Resin (0.1mm): ≤130mm/h; High-Speed Resin (0.1mm): ≤170mm/h Layer Height Range: 0.01 – 0.15mm X/Y Axis Resolution: 16.8 × 24.8μm Light Source: COB Light Source+ Fresnel lens + Light Uniformity Algorithm Light Intensity: 5500 ±10% μW/cm² Material Compatibility: High-speed, Water-washable, Standard, ABS-like, and Plant-based Resins, etc Build Platform: Laser-engraved Build Plate Z-axis: Dual Linear Rails with 10 μm Precision Release film: Improved ACF Film Resin Vat: ≤1L Machine Leveling: Leveling-free Power Loss Resume: Not Supported Power Supply: 240W Protection Film: Replaceable Scratch-resistant Film Resin Auto-fill Unit: Supported Dynamic Temperature Control Resin Vat: Supported Slicing Software: Photon Workshop, Chitubox, Lychee Slicer (Scheduled) File Transfer: USB/Wi-Fi/LAN Hinged Cover: - Operating Screen: 4.3" Touch-Control Air Purifier: Optional Accessory LCD Screen: 10.1-inch Monochrome LCD, 14K Resolution Anycubic App: Supported Multilingual Support: EN / CN / DE / FR / IT / ES / RU / JP Machine Weight: 12 800g Product Dimensions: 312 x 315 x 520mm³ What's in the Box Anycubic Photon Mono M7 Pro 10.1" 14K Resin 3D Printer x1 Print Platform x1 Resin Vat x1 Wi-Fi Antenna x1 Hex Key Set x1 Protective Equipment x1 Filter x5 Scrapers x2 Leveling Paper x1 USB Drive x1 Power Cord x1 Screen Protector Kit x1 Auto-fill Unit x1 User Manual x1

item.g:title: Xiaomi Mijia Electric Shaver Pro - Silver
item.g:description: Pro-level shaving precision | Up to 90-day battery life | IPX8 fully washable | 360° floating head | Smart colour display Quick Specs Achieve a smoother, gentler shave with dual-ring corrugated foils and concave stainless steel blades that capture hair efficiently while minimising pulling Enjoy up to 90 days of battery life on a single charge, with Type-C charging supported even while in use Experience confident grooming anywhere with a full IPX8 waterproof rating — rinse under running water for effortless cleaning Adapt to every contour of your face with a 360° omnidirectional floating shaver head that reaches jawlines, sideburns, and corners of the mouth Stay informed at a glance with a smart dynamic colour display showing mode, battery level, and travel lock status Flagship shaving performance, built for everyday life The Xiaomi Mijia Electric Shaver Pro is engineered for those who refuse to compromise on their grooming routine. Combining advanced cutting technology with a skin-friendly design, it delivers a consistently close, comfortable shave whether you're at home or on the go. With its sleek silver finish and thoughtful accessories, it's equally at home in your bathroom cabinet or your travel bag. A smarter cut that's kinder to your skin Tired of electric shavers that tug and irritate? The Pro's dual-ring corrugated foils — crafted using Metal Injection Moulding (MIM) technology — offer a larger hair-intake area than conventional straight-groove foils, improving capture and cutting efficiency. Paired with dual-ring concave stainless steel blades, the wraparound hair-capture system locks onto facial hair with minimal pulling. The shaver head surface is coated with high-density silicon-based microbeads, forming a smooth, low-friction coating that reduces tightness and discomfort, making it suitable even for sensitive skin. Power that adapts, precision that delivers A high-speed motor capable of up to 5 million cuts per minute powers through thick, coarse stubble with ease. A smart chip monitors beard density up to around 100 times per second, dynamically adjusting cutting speed between Standard mode (2,900 rpm) and Turbo mode (3,100 rpm) to optimise performance at all times. The 360° omnidirectional floating shaver head flexes in every direction — vertically, horizontally, and at any angle — so no area of your face gets missed. Weeks of use between charges, no compromise on hygiene One full charge powers up to 95 days of shaving in Standard mode or 90 days in Turbo mode, based on one minute of use per day. When you do need to top up, the Type-C connection charges the shaver fully in approximately 2.5 hours and even supports use while charging. The full IPX8 waterproof rating means you can rinse the entire device under running water after every shave, keeping it hygienic and fresh. A smart travel lock, activated with a tap-and-hold, prevents accidental start-up in your bag, while the colour display alerts you to low battery, overheating, or operational issues before they become a problem. Features Dual-ring corrugated foils with MIM technology for improved hair capture and cutting efficiency Wraparound beard-capture system with concave stainless steel blades minimises hair pulling Microbead-coated shaver head reduces friction and discomfort, suitable for sensitive skin 360° omnidirectional floating head adapts to facial contours including jawline and sideburns High-speed motor with up to 5 million cuts per minute; Standard (2,900 rpm) and Turbo (3,100 rpm) modes Smart dynamic colour display shows operating mode, battery level, and travel lock status Up to 95 days battery life (Standard mode) or 90 days (Turbo mode) on a single charge Type-C charging with use-while-charging support; full charge in approximately 2.5 hours IPX8 waterproof rating — fully washable under running water Smart travel lock prevents accidental activation Specifications Rated input: 5V ⎓ 1A Waterproof rating: IPX8 Charging time: Approx. 2.5 hours to charge fully Charging method: Type-C charging Sound power level: ≤72dB(A) Colour: Silver Warranty: 12 months Product Dimensions: 6.6 x 6.9 x 17.2 cm What's in the Box Xiaomi Mijia Electric Shaver Pro – Silver x1 Storage pouch x1 Type-C charging cable x1 Cleaning brush x1 Shaver stand x1 User manual x1 Quick start guide x1 Why Xiaomi Xiaomi has built its reputation on delivering genuine innovation at accessible price points — and its grooming range is no different. The Mijia Electric Shaver Pro reflects Xiaomi's commitment to engineering products that blend smart technology with everyday practicality, giving South African consumers access to flagship-level personal care without compromise. Powered by a high-speed brushless motor delivering up to 170AW of turbo suction and 20,000 Pa of vacuum pressure, it handles everyday household messes — from fine dust to pet hair and large debris — quickly and efficiently. Whole-Home Cleaning Power, Reimagined The Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Pro is built for households that refuse to settle for surface-level clean. Powered by a high-speed brushless motor delivering up to 27,000 Pa of suction pressure and 280AW of airflow, it tackles everything from fine dust and hair to larger debris across hard floors, wooden floors, and carpets. With six specialised attachments, a bendable tube, and smart dirt detection that automatically adjusts suction to the task at hand, the Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Pro is the kind of thorough, versatile clean that the modern South African home deserves. See the Dust You've Been Missing Tired of vacuuming under the bed only to find you've missed half of what was there? The 180° wide-angle blue-light dust detection system illuminates fine particles in dark, low-clearance spaces — under sofas, beds, and in dimly lit corners — magnifying dust up to 30 times so you can clean with precision rather than guesswork. Combined with smart dirt sensors that detect dust levels in real time during Auto mode, the vacuum adjusts suction power automatically, so you get thorough cleaning without wasting battery life. Reach Every Spot Without the Strain Low furniture shouldn't mean a sore back. The included bendable tube lets you manoeuvre into tight clearance spots — under sofas, bookshelves, beds, and wall-mounted décor — without bending or contorting. The right edge-cleaning design on the brush bar follows skirting boards and corners closely, picking up gap dust in a single pass. Whether you're tackling the main living area or the hard-to-reach nooks, this vacuum is designed to cover every corner of your home with minimal effort. Deep Filtration, Long-Lasting Performance The Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Pro's 5-stage precision filtration system captures 99.99% of particles, including those as small as 0.3μm, thanks to an H14-grade HEPA filter at its final stage. The 12-cone cyclone separation technology efficiently separates dust from airflow, minimising filter blockages, reducing suction loss over time, and extending filter life. The dual anti-tangle design on both the all-flooring brush bar and the mini electric brush helps handle up to 200 strands of long hair with minimal tangling, keeping maintenance straightforward. Key accessories are washable and reusable, reducing waste and running costs over the long term. item.g:description: Tri-mode wireless freedom | QMK/VIA fully customisable | Gasket-mount comfort | Hot-swappable Gateron Jupiter Brown switches | Up to 190 hours battery life A custom mechanical keyboard built for the serious professional The Keychron V3 Max is an 80% TKL wireless mechanical keyboard engineered for those who refuse to compromise between functionality and craftsmanship. Whether you are a developer, writer, or power user working across multiple devices, this keyboard delivers the deep customisability of QMK/VIA firmware, the flexibility of tri-mode connectivity, and the satisfying tactile feedback of Gateron Jupiter Brown switches — all in a compact layout that reclaims desk space without sacrificing the keys that matter. Type freely, without wires holding you back Tired of cable clutter disrupting your workspace? The V3 Max supports tri-mode connectivity — Bluetooth 5.1, 2.4 GHz wireless, and wired via USB Type-C — so you can switch seamlessly between your laptop, desktop, and tablet. A generously sized 4000 mAh rechargeable li-polymer battery keeps you going for up to 190 hours with the backlight off, or up to 100 hours at the lowest RGB brightness. When the battery does need replenishing, a full charge takes around 5 hours via the USB Type-C charging port. Tune every keystroke to your preference Full QMK and VIA support means every key on the V3 Max is remappable, with support for macros, layers, and custom lighting profiles — all configured without flashing firmware mid-session. The hot-swappable PCB accepts most 3-pin and 5-pin MX-compatible switches (including Gateron, Cherry MX, and Kailh), so upgrading your switches is straightforward whenever your preferences evolve. South-facing RGB LEDs illuminate double-shot PBT keycaps in OSA profile for vivid, consistent colour across the board, and N-Key Rollover (NKRO) is active in both wireless and wired modes. Built to absorb the hours, not fight them The gasket-mount design suspends the plate within the chassis, producing a softer, more forgiving keypress that reduces finger fatigue during long sessions. The typing angle is adjustable across three positions — 4°, 7°, and 10° — via integrated feet, letting you dial in the ergonomic tilt that suits your posture. Screw-in PCB stabilisers provide consistent, rattle-free performance on larger keys straight out of the box, while the ABS plastic body and PC plate keep the overall weight at a practical 895 g. Weighing just 4.4 g per earbud and shaped with a biomimetic curved design, they sit gently in the ear without pressure — making them as suited to an extended work-from-home session as they are to a morning commute. With support for aptX Lossless, aptX Adaptive, LC3, AAC, and SBC codecs, the Buds 6 are built for the full spectrum of modern listening. An 11 mm driver that earns its keep At the heart of the Xiaomi Buds 6 is an 11 mm triple-magnet gold-plated driver, custom-engineered to deliver powerful bass alongside crisp, refined treble. A 24K gold-plated diaphragm enhances high-frequency sensitivity, while a 16 Hz–40 kHz frequency response ensures you hear every layer of your music, from the deepest sub-bass to the finest high-frequency detail. Two Harman AudioEFX sound modes — developed in collaboration with the Harman Golden Ears team — let you choose between a clear, transparent presentation and a warmer, more enveloping sound signature. Tired of calls that sound like you're underwater? The Buds 6 address this with a triple-microphone AI call noise cancellation system that isolates your voice even in environments with up to 95 dB of ambient noise. Active noise cancellation (ANC) runs simultaneously, reducing environmental distractions without cutting you off from important audio cues like voices or traffic. Whether you're taking a call from a busy café or working late in an open-plan office, your conversations stay clear and stable. Smart features that keep you in control Bluetooth 5.4 ensures a stable, low-latency connection over up to 10 m in open space, while multipoint connectivity lets you stay linked to two devices at once — your laptop and smartphone, for example — and switch between them without re-pairing. Customisable touch gestures cover playback, volume, calls, and noise cancellation. The earbuds are also compatible with Apple Find My and Google's Find Hub, so you can locate your case quickly if it goes astray. The IP54-rated earbuds handle everyday splashes and light perspiration without concern. item.g:title: Xiaomi Mijia Smart Air Purifier with Humidification Pro
item.g:description: Pure, moist air for every room | 2-in-1 purification and humidification | Ultra-quiet 14.6 dB(A) sleep mode | Smart app and voice control | Up to 16 hours continuous humidification Quick Specs Purify and humidify simultaneously with a 2-in-1 system that tackles dust, bacteria, allergens, and dry air in one pass. Achieve cleaner air in a 24 m² living room in just 10 minutes with a 400 m³/h CADR. Enjoy up to 16 hours of continuous humidification from the 8 L water tank — no mid-night refills needed. Rest undisturbed with sleep mode noise as low as 14.6 dB(A), quieter than a whisper. Control air quality and humidity from anywhere via the Xiaomi Home app, Google Assistant, or Alexa. Cleaner Air and Comfortable Humidity, All in One The Xiaomi Mijia Smart Air Purifier with Humidification Pro is designed for households that want more than just filtered air. By combining a HEPA + Carbon purification stage with a high-capacity evaporative humidifier in a single appliance, it tackles dust, allergens, bacteria, and dry indoor air without the need for two separate devices. Whether it is allergy season, a dry winter, or simply the daily grind of indoor pollution in the modern South African home, this purifier adapts to deliver comfortable, breathable air year-round. Purification First, Then Humidification Tired of humidifiers that simply recirculate unclean air? The Mijia Smart Air Purifier with Humidification Pro routes air through a dedicated HEPA + Carbon purification filter before it ever reaches the humidification stage, so the moisture delivered into your room is already clean. The result is humidification that hydrates rather than contaminates. A UV-C sterilisation module built into the water circuit continuously works to deactivate bacteria in the water pathway, while the cool evaporative method produces no mist or water marks on furniture. With a rated humidification capacity of 1800 mL/h and an 8 L water tank, it can humidify continuously for up to 16 hours in sleep mode without a refill. Removes 12 Common Air Pollutants From fine particulate matter to household bacteria and pet dander, the dual-filter system is tested against a broad range of pollutants. The HEPA + Carbon filter combination targets PM1, PM2.5, and PM10 particles, as well as allergens from cat dander, dog dander, and dust mites. A 400 m³/h CADR rating means a 24 m² living room can be purified in around 10 minutes, while smaller spaces such as a children's room or bedroom are cleared even faster. The air quality sensor monitors PM1, PM2.5, dust, temperature, and humidity in real time, so you always know exactly what you are breathing. Whisper-Quiet Nights and Smart Daily Control Sleep mode brings noise down to just 14.6 dB(A) — a level so low it is unlikely to disturb even light sleepers — while the LCD dome display automatically dims its brightness to match the ambient light in your room. During the day, the Xiaomi Home app gives you full remote control: check air quality readings, adjust humidity targets, schedule on/off times, monitor filter life, and create smart home scenes. Voice control via Google Assistant and Alexa means you can make adjustments without touching the unit. The 360° swivel caster wheels make it easy to move the purifier between rooms as needed, so clean air follows you through the home. Practical Design Built for Everyday Life Refilling the 8 L water tank requires no bending — simply top up from above or remove the tank entirely using the built-in handle. An illuminated water level indicator keeps you informed at a glance, and a child safety lock prevents accidental changes by little hands or curious pets. The washable humidification filter extends service life and simplifies maintenance, while the anti-backflow water circuit design helps reduce water discolouration and dirt build-up over time. Power consumption in purification-only mode is 36 W, rising to 55 W when humidification is active. Features 2-in-1 purification and humidification: air is filtered before humidification for cleaner moisture delivery. HEPA + Carbon dual-filter system removes particulate matter, bacteria, and allergens. UV-C sterilisation module in the water circuit helps continuously reduce bacteria and viruses. 400 m³/h CADR purifies a 24 m² room in approximately 10 minutes. Rated humidification capacity of 1800 mL/h with up to 16 hours of continuous humidification from the 8 L tank. Ultra-quiet sleep mode at 14.6 dB(A) with light-adaptive LCD dome display. Monitors five air-quality metrics in real time: PM1, PM2.5, dust, temperature, and humidity. Smart control via Xiaomi Home app with support for Google Assistant and Alexa voice commands. Cool evaporative humidification — no mist, no water marks on furniture. 360° swivel caster wheels and washable humidification filter for easy everyday use. item.g:title: Anycubic Ace 2 Pro - For Kobra X and S1/M
item.g:description: 4-channel active drying and feeding hub | Print-while-drying workflow | Brushless motors for quiet, reliable operation | Sealed moisture control | Compatible with Kobra X, S1, and S1 Max Quick Specs Dry and print simultaneously with active 65 °C drying — keep your filament fresh without pausing a single job Feed four colours at once through four independent brushless motors running at under 48 dB for smooth, near-silent operation Switch filaments faster with a next-generation buffer mechanism that doubles loading speed compared to the previous generation Protect every spool with sealed storage, an electromagnetic moisture valve, and real-time temperature and humidity monitoring Built to last with an alumina ceramic filament feeding port that resists wear far longer than standard plastic alternatives Upgrade Your Multi-Material Workflow The Anycubic ACE 2 Pro is designed for FDM makers who want a reliable, intelligent hub to manage multiple filaments — drying them, feeding them, and keeping them in peak condition, all at the same time. Compatible with the Kobra X, Kobra S1, and Kobra S1 Max, it connects seamlessly into your existing setup and replaces the guesswork of manual filament management with a fully automated system. Never Stop Printing to Dry Your Filament Again Tired of halting your print jobs just to run a separate drying cycle? The ACE 2 Pro supports simultaneous drying and printing, maintaining a chamber temperature of up to 65 °C while your printer keeps running. Built-in temperature and humidity sensors monitor conditions in real time, an electromagnetic valve actively expels moisture, and a silicone sealing ring blocks external humidity from creeping back in. Your filament stays as fresh as the day it came out of the bag. Faster, Quieter, More Reliable Feeding Four independent brushless motors — each rated for a lifespan of 5,000 hours or more — drive the next-generation buffer mechanism, delivering smooth and stable filament feed and retraction across all four channels. Operating at under 48 dB during closed-door printing, the ACE 2 Pro keeps your workspace quiet. Filament loading speed is doubled compared to the previous ACE Pro generation, meaning less waiting between colour changes and more time spent actually printing. The alumina ceramic filament feeding port adds another layer of durability, offering superior abrasion resistance over standard plastic ports for reduced long-term maintenance. Intelligent Monitoring and Jam-Free Maintenance The ACE 2 Pro keeps you informed and in control. Real-time temperature and humidity readings are displayed on the app, slicer, and printer screen. Filament runout detection and auto-resume printing mean unexpected interruptions are handled automatically. When a jam does occur, the quick-release external feeding channel and buffer mechanism allow rapid disassembly so you can clear the issue and get back to printing in seconds. In standard mode the four output ports reach up to 100 metres at full Gigabit speeds; switch to Extend mode and transmission stretches to 250 metres, though port speed is capped at 10 Mbps in that configuration. Battery Life That Outlasts Your Longest Sessions Tired of your headset dying mid-match? The VOID WIRELESS v2 delivers up to 70 hours of wireless runtime over its 2.4GHz USB connection, and an astonishing up to 130 hours when connected via Bluetooth. Whether you're grinding through a marathon weekend or moving from your PC to your mobile device, you'll spend less time on the charger and more time in the game. Precision Audio, Engineered for the Competitive Edge At the heart of the VOID WIRELESS v2 are 50mm headphone drivers delivering a wide frequency response of 20Hz to 20kHz, with a sensitivity of 116dB (+/-3dB) and an impedance of 32k Ohms at 1kHz. The result is audio that renders every footstep, every environmental cue, and every in-game detail with the clarity your performance demands. This is sound that becomes a tactical advantage. Its multi-mode connection supports PC, Mac, PS4/5, and mobile, giving you a single headset that travels seamlessly between your gaming rig and your mobile device. The included USB wireless transmitter ensures a stable, low-latency link, while Bluetooth extends your reach even further. Pair it with Corsair's iCUE software on PC or Mac to fine-tune your audio profile exactly the way you want it. item.g:description: Full HD 1080p smart projector | VIDAA OS with Netflix & more | 1100 ANSI Lumens brightness | Auto keystone, focus & screen alignment | 140-inch projection Quick Specs Experience a full 1920x1080 Full HD picture at up to 140 inches — cinema scale in your own home. Stream straight out of the box with VIDAA OS, giving you access to Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, Prime Video, and 1800+ apps. Connect wirelessly via AirPlay or Miracast, or use your voice through VIDAA Voice — compatible with Google Nest Home and Apple HomePod. Get up and watching in seconds — cold start in just 12 seconds, with auto keystone, auto focus, and auto screen alignment handling setup for you. Big-screen entertainment without the big-screen price The Wanbo X5S is a Full HD smart projector built for anyone who wants a genuine home cinema experience without the complexity or cost of a large-format TV. Running on VIDAA OS with access to Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, Prime Video, Apple TV+, and over 1800 apps, it is a complete entertainment system the moment you plug it in. Whether you are mounting it to the ceiling, placing it on a shelf, or setting it up on a table for movie night, the X5S is designed to fit into your living space on your terms. A picture that fills the room At 1100 ANSI Lumens and native 1920x1080 Full HD resolution, the X5S delivers a bright, sharp image through its high light transmission glass lens. Project anywhere from 40 to 140 inches at a throw distance of 1.1 to 3.9 metres, and choose from front, rear, front ceiling, or rear ceiling projection modes. HDR10 support brings deeper contrast and richer colour, while the 50%–100% zoom function gives you flexibility in tighter spaces. The light source is rated for over 20,000 hours, so it will be part of your home for years to come. Setup that takes care of itself Tired of fiddling with projector alignment every time you move it? The X5S features automatic vertical and horizontal keystone correction (±30°), auto focus, auto obstacle avoidance, and auto screen alignment — so the image is properly framed and sharp within moments of powering on. Cold start takes just 12 seconds, and standby wake-up is as fast as 1.5 seconds. Whether you are setting up for a spontaneous movie session or a regular evening ritual, the X5S gets out of the way and lets you enjoy. Smart, connected, and voice-ready The X5S connects to your home network via dual-band 2.4/5GHz Wi-Fi and pairs to speakers or headphones over Bluetooth 5.0. Wireless screen casting is supported through both Miracast and AirPlay, so you can mirror your phone, tablet, or laptop without cables. VIDAA Voice lets you control the projector with your voice, and it is compatible with Google Nest Home and Apple HomePod for seamless smart home integration. The HDMI 2.1 port supports 4K HDR input, eARC output, and higher HDCP versions, while two USB ports and an AUX output round out the connection options. The built-in 12W speaker with Dolby Audio support means you can enjoy room-filling sound without a separate sound bar. item.g:description: Tri-mode wireless freedom | 4000 mAh battery | Full-size RGB membrane | Real-time status display | Multi-function control knob Quick Specs Connect your way with tri-mode connectivity — wired USB, 2.4G wireless, or Bluetooth — for lag-free gaming on any setup. Game longer with a built-in 4000 mAh battery keeping you in the fight without constantly reaching for a cable. Control your experience instantly with a multi-function knob to adjust volume and backlight brightness on the fly. Stay informed at a glance with a real-time power and connection status display built into the keyboard. Illuminate your battlestation with vibrant per-key RGB backlighting across all 104 full-size keys. Command the Battlefield Without Being Tethered The Redragon RM104 PRO VOLCANO is a full-size tri-mode wireless membrane gaming keyboard built for the South African gamer who demands flexibility, endurance, and a commanding presence on the desk. Whether you're deep in a late-night session or switching between rigs, the VOLCANO PRO has you covered with three connection modes and a battery that won't quit. Three Modes, Zero Compromises on Response Tired of fumbling with cables mid-session or losing connection at the worst possible moment? The RM104 PRO delivers low-latency tri-mode connectivity — plug in via the 150 cm PVC cable for wired stability, switch to 2.4G wireless for the fastest untethered response, or pair over Bluetooth for convenient multi-device flexibility. Switching between modes is instant, keeping your focus where it belongs: on the game. Stay Powered, Stay in Control The built-in 4000 mAh lithium battery is engineered to keep you gaming for extended sessions without interruption. A real-time power and connection display lets you monitor battery level and active connection mode at a glance — no guessing, no surprise shutdowns. When you do need to recharge, simply plug in the USB cable and keep playing in wired mode without skipping a beat. RGB Ambience, Precision at Your Fingertips All 104 keys blaze with vibrant RGB backlighting, letting you customise your setup's atmosphere to match your playstyle. The dedicated multi-function knob gives you instant, tactile control over volume and backlight brightness without breaking your flow. A single-toggle switch lets you flip between Windows and Mac shortcut key layouts effortlessly, and software support opens up further personalisation for lighting and key configuration. Features Tri-mode connectivity: wired USB, 2.4G wireless, and Bluetooth for versatile, low-latency performance. Large 4000 mAh built-in lithium battery for extended wireless gaming sessions. Real-time power and connection status display for at-a-glance monitoring. Multi-function knob for quick adjustment of volume and backlight brightness. Full RGB backlighting across all 104 keys for immersive desk aesthetics. Windows/Mac shortcut key support with a convenient one-toggle switch. Software compatible for further customisation of lighting and key functions. 150 cm PVC USB cable included for wired mode and charging. Specifications Keyboard Size: Full-size Switch Type: Membrane Connection: Tri-mode Backlighting: RGB Hot-Swappable Switches: No Keycap Material: ABS Battery Capacity: 4000mAh Layout: English (US) Colour: Black Warranty: 18 months Product Weight: 713g Product Dimensions: 44.6 x 14 x 3.9 cm What's in the Box Redragon RM104 PRO VOLCANO RGB Wireless Membrane Gaming Keyboard - Black x1 USB Cable x1 Why Redragon Redragon is dedicated to empowering gamers with high-performance, reliable peripherals that deliver exceptional value without compromise — the trusted choice for gamers across South Africa who want to elevate their setup and dominate every session without breaking the bank.

item.g:title: UGreen Nexode 10000mAh 30W Power Bank with Built-in USB Type-C Cable
item.g:description: 10000mAh fast-charging power bank | Built-in nylon-braided USB Type-C cable | 30W max output | Charge 3 devices simultaneously | Ultra-compact pocket size The UGREEN Nexode Power Bank 10000mAh 30W is built for anyone who needs reliable, fast charging on the move without the hassle of carrying extra cables. The integrated nylon-braided USB Type-C cable — tested to withstand 10,000+ bends and plug cycles — means you're always ready to charge, and doubles as a convenient carry strap. With up to 30W max output and support for PD3.0, QC3.0, SCP, and FCP fast-charge protocols, it delivers rapid top-ups for smartphones and other compatible devices. Two USB Type-C ports, one USB-A port, and the built-in cable let you charge up to three devices at the same time, while a digital display keeps you informed of remaining battery at a glance. At just 82 x 62 x 26 mm, it slips into any pocket or travel bag without adding bulk — and at under 100Wh, it's flight-safe on any airline. Pass-through charging and a 2.3-hour full recharge via the built-in cable round out a compact power bank that's ready whenever you are. item.g:description: 145W max output for laptops and phones | 20000mAh capacity | Built-in USB Type-C cable with 100W output | Recharge in approximately 1.5 hours | 3-port simultaneous charging The UGREEN Nexode 145W 20000mAh Power Bank is built for anyone who needs serious, reliable power on the move — from remote workers and frequent travellers to anyone who refuses to be slowed down by a dying battery. item.g:title: UGREEN 20000mAh 67W Nexode Power Bank with Built-in Cable
item.g:description: 67W ultra-fast charging | 20000mAh high capacity | Built-in braided USB Type-C cable | Charges laptops and smartphones | Airline approved The UGREEN Nexode 20000mAh 67W Power Bank is built for anyone who needs serious, reliable power on the go — whether you're travelling, working remotely, or simply away from a plug for extended periods. item.g:title: PORT Office docking station 3 X 4 USB-C 11 devices 100W
item.g:description: Triple 4K display support | 11-port connectivity | 100W USB-C Power Delivery | Plug-and-play compatibility | Built for demanding professionals Quick Specs Connect up to 11 peripherals through a single USB-C cable, keeping your desk clean and efficient Drive up to three 4K displays simultaneously — two with your laptop connected, three in standalone mode Charge your laptop at up to 100W via USB-C Power Delivery while powering all connected devices Transfer data at up to 10 Gbps via USB-A 3.1 Gen 2 and USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 ports with fast-charge support Compatible with Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS — plug-and-play setup, no drivers required Your laptop's full potential, unlocked through one cable The PORT Connect USB-C 3X4K Office Docking Station is built for professionals who need a commanding, clutter-free workstation without sacrificing connectivity. By connecting a single USB-C cable to your laptop, you gain access to 11 ports — spanning video outputs, high-speed data transfer, wired networking, audio, and power delivery — all from a compact, desk-friendly unit. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS, it integrates seamlessly into any hybrid or office environment. Three 4K screens, one docking station Tired of toggling between windows on a single screen? The PORT Connect docking station supports up to three simultaneous 4K displays via two DisplayPort 1.4++ outputs and one HDMI 2.0 output, using DisplayPort Multi-Stream Transport (MST) technology. With your laptop connected, you can drive two additional external screens in 4K. Disconnect the laptop and use the dock in standalone mode to extend across three 4K displays — ideal for developers, analysts, and creatives who rely on multiple active windows throughout the day. Fast charging and rapid data transfer in a single connection The docking station delivers up to 100W of USB-C Power Delivery to your laptop, so your battery stays charged throughout the workday without a separate power brick. For peripherals, the two USB-A 3.1 Gen 2 ports and two USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 ports each support transfer speeds up to 10 Gbps and are compatible with BC 1.2 fast charging and Apple Charging. Two USB-A 2.0 ports handle standard accessories, ensuring nothing gets left behind. A Fully-Loaded Foundation for Your Next Gaming PC Build The Corsair 3200D RS ARGB is a spacious mid-tower gaming chassis engineered for builders who refuse to compromise on cooling, aesthetics, or ease of assembly. Designed with the discerning South African PC builder in mind, it arrives with 3x RS120 ARGB PWM fans already installed, nine 120mm fan mount positions, and room for a top-mounted 360mm radiator — giving you a powerful, versatile platform from day one. Whether you're constructing a high-performance gaming rig or a capable workstation, the 3200D RS ARGB is a great foundation for any DIY PC project. Serious Cooling Potential, Right Out of the Box Tired of cases that leave your cooling options as an afterthought? The 3200D RS ARGB ships with 3x RS120 ARGB fans pre-installed in the ventilated front panel, delivering continuous airflow and customisable RGB lighting from the moment you power on. A total of nine 120mm fan mount positions — including an angled mount on the PSU shroud that channels cool air directly at the GPU — means you can scale your cooling as your build demands. Top and front radiator support accommodates 360mm, 280mm, and 240mm configurations, so even the most powerful CPUs stay well within temperature limits. Built for Modern Hardware and a Clean Aesthetic The 3200D RS ARGB is fully compatible with the latest reverse-connector motherboards — including ASUS BTF, MSI Project Zero, and Gigabyte Project Stealth designs — enabling truly clean builds with no visible cables on the front face of the board. A built-in cable shroud neatly conceals PSU and drive cabling, while abundant cable tie-down locations across the back panel make routing straightforward. The tempered glass left side panel is secured with a locking screw, putting your ARGB-lit interior permanently on display. GPU clearance of 370mm with front fans installed (400mm with fans removed) means even the largest current-generation graphics cards fit with room to spare, and the included GPU Anti-sag Stabilization Arm keeps heavy cards properly supported. Practical Front I/O and Easy Connectivity The easily accessible front I/O panel brings everything you need within arm's reach. A USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C port delivers up to 20Gb/s of bandwidth — four times the speed of USB 3.0 — alongside a USB 2.0 Type-A port and a combined headphone/microphone jack. A single-connector front panel cable simplifies the build process, reducing the cable tangle inside the chassis. Storage flexibility is handled by a combination drive plate that accommodates one 3.5-inch hard drive or two 2.5-inch SSDs, keeping your storage neatly tucked away behind the shroud. Features Supports 360mm, 280mm, and 240mm radiators in both the top and front positions for versatile liquid cooling configurations. Nine 120mm fan mount positions including an angled PSU shroud mount that directs cool air towards the GPU for improved thermal performance. 3x RS120 ARGB PWM fans included, pre-installed in the front panel for immediate ARGB lighting and continuous intake airflow. Compatible with reverse-connector motherboards (ASUS BTF, MSI Project Zero, Gigabyte Project Stealth) for cable-free clean builds. Built-in GPU Anti-sag Stabilization Arm provides adjustable support for heavy modern graphics cards. 370mm GPU clearance with front fans installed; 400mm clearance with front fans removed for extra-large GPUs. Tempered glass left side panel with locking screw puts your build on full display. Built-in cable shroud and abundant cable tie-down locations simplify cable management. Front I/O includes USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C (up to 20Gb/s), USB 2.0 Type-A, and headphone/microphone jack. item.g:title: Corsair K70 CORE TKL RGB Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
item.g:description: Command your battlefield with a compact keyboard built for pinpoint precision | blazing-fast MLX Red switches | immersive per-key RGB | onboard profile storage Quick Specs Dominate every match with ultra-responsive CORSAIR MLX Red mechanical switches and a 1,000Hz report rate. Enjoy silky-smooth, wobble-free keystrokes engineered for competitive precision. Free up desk space for your mouse with a compact tenkeyless (TKL) footprint. Personalise your battle station with vivid per-key RGB backlighting through CORSAIR iCUE. Store up to 5 onboard profiles with 8MB of onboard memory for performance on the move. Precision Gaming in a Compact Form Tired of your mouse hand bumping into a bulky numpad mid-match? The CORSAIR K70 CORE TKL Mechanical Gaming Keyboard trims away the excess without cutting corners on performance, giving competitive South African gamers a tenkeyless footprint built for pure focus. Every key rides on CORSAIR MLX Red linear switches, pre-lubricated for silky-smooth, wobble-free keystrokes that keep you fast and consistent when it counts. Switches Engineered for Speed At the core of the K70 CORE TKL are CORSAIR MLX Red mechanical switches, tuned for light, linear actuation that rewards rapid inputs without sacrificing accuracy. Backed by a 1,000Hz report rate and full key rollover (NKRO), every keystroke registers instantly and independently, so your combos, binds, and rapid-fire commands land exactly when you need them to. Illuminate Your Battle Station Ultra-bright per-key RGB lighting brings your setup to life, and with CORSAIR iCUE software you can customise lighting effects and store up to 5 onboard profiles across 8MB of onboard memory, so your personal setup travels with you between PCs. Two layers of internal sound dampening keep the acoustics tight, giving your keystrokes a satisfying, tempered sound rather than a hollow clatter. Built for the Long Grind A tangle-free rubber cable and wired USB Type-A connection keep your setup reliable match after match, while dedicated FN shortcuts give you quick access to media and volume controls without breaking your focus. Compatible with PC, Mac, or Xbox One via a USB 3.0 or 3.1 Type-A port, the K70 CORE TKL is ready to become the trusted centre of your gaming setup. item.g:title: Unique PCI‑E 2x Serial & 1x Parallel multi combo card
item.g:description: Unique PCI‑E 2x Serial & 1x Parallel multi‑I/O combo card – Single‑slot expansion card that adds 2× RS‑232 serial (DB9) and 1× IEEE 1284 parallel (DB25) ports to a PC, compatible with both PCI and PCI‑Express x1 slots. Based on a 16C550‑class UART, supports standard serial speeds up to 115.2 kbps (some listings quote up to 16 Mbps per port depending on chipset) and parallel modes SPP/EPP/ECP with bi‑directional speeds up to 1.5 MB/s. Includes standard and low‑profile brackets for desktop and slim cases.

The H810M-P Gen5 pairs a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot with Dual Channel DDR5 memory support across two DIMM slots, scaling up to 128GB total capacity. With XMP 3.0 support and memory speeds tuned for DDR5 performance, your CPU and graphics card get the bandwidth headroom to actually perform, rather than wait on the board around them. Display and Everyday Essentials, Sorted Whether you're editing, gaming, or just running a productive desktop, the H810M-P Gen5 has the outputs to match. HDMI 2.1 delivers up to 4K at 120Hz, while DisplayPort 1.4 with DSC pushes as high as 8K at 60Hz or 5K at 120Hz, both with HDCP 2.3 support. item.g:title: CUDY AC1200 Mesh Wi-Fi System 3 Pack
item.g:description: Whole-home Wi-Fi coverage | Seamless mesh roaming | Dual-band speeds up to 867 Mbps | Connects up to 128 devices | Effortless self-install setup Quick Specs Blanket every room of your home in strong Wi-Fi with three mesh units covering up to 220 m² Enjoy fast, stable dual-band speeds of up to 867 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz Stay connected as you move through your home with seamless mesh roaming between units Connect up to 128 devices at once without slowdown thanks to MU-MIMO and beamforming Get online in minutes — set up one unit and the rest auto-sync Whole-Home Wi-Fi, Without the Dead Zones The Cudy M1200 AC1200 Mesh Kit is built for households that have outgrown a single router. This 3-pack of compact mesh units works together to blanket up to 220 m² of your home in reliable dual-band Wi-Fi 5, replacing patchy signal in back bedrooms and garages with one seamless network. Setup is simple: plug in the first unit, and the rest auto-sync to extend your coverage, making it a practical upgrade for larger South African homes where a single router just doesn't reach far enough. Tired of Wi-Fi Dropping Out as You Move Around? Walking from the lounge to the bedroom shouldn't mean your video call freezes or your stream buffers. Cudy Mesh technology automatically hands your devices off to whichever unit has the strongest signal, switching in milliseconds so you stay connected without lifting a finger. Combined with multi-band simultaneous backhaul, the units talk to each other efficiently in the background, keeping your whole-home network fast and consistent wherever you are. Speed and Capacity for a Busy Household With 4-stream dual-band Wi-Fi 5 delivering up to 867 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, plus MU-MIMO and beamforming support, the M1200 kit keeps multiple devices running smoothly at the same time. It's rated to handle up to 128 connected devices, making it well suited to homes with several smartphones, laptops, smart TVs, and smart-home gadgets all online at once. Each unit also includes two Fast Ethernet ports for wiring in a games console, smart TV, or desktop PC directly. Control and Peace of Mind, Built In Beyond raw speed, the M1200 gives you tools to manage your network with confidence. Set up a built-in VPN server or client for secure remote access, and use parental controls to schedule offline time or block inappropriate content for the kids. Everything is managed through the Cudy App with cloud control, so you can adjust settings, check connected devices, and keep your home network running the way you want it to. Features 4-stream dual-band Wi-Fi 5 delivering up to 867 Mbps (5 GHz) and 300 Mbps (2.4 GHz) Cudy Mesh with seamless roaming — auto-switches devices to the strongest signal MU-MIMO and beamforming for improved performance across multiple devices 2x 10/100 Mbps Fast Ethernet ports per unit (Auto WAN/LAN) Supports up to 128 connected devices Built-in VPN server and client for secure access Parental controls with Wi-Fi time scheduling and web filtering Managed via the Cudy App with cloud control Specifications Brand: Cudy Model Number: M1200 2.0 Manufacturer Part Number: M1200 2.0 EAN / Barcode: 6971690795641 Colour: White Warranty: 24 months Product Weight: 0.4065 kg Product Dimensions (L x W x H): 8.5×8.5×8.65 cm Device Type: Mesh System Wi-Fi Standard: Wi-Fi 5 Speed Class: AC1200 Bands: Dual-Band Units in Pack: 3 Coverage: 220 m² Ethernet Ports per Unit: 2 USB Port: false Max Connected Devices: 128 What's in the Box 3 x Cudy M1200 Mesh Unit - White 3 x Power Adapter 3 x Ethernet Cable 1 x Installation Guide Why Cudy Cudy is committed to making reliable, whole-home networking simple and accessible, without unnecessary complexity or cost. item.g:title: Anycubic Water Wash Resin 2.0 – White
item.g:description: Water-washable UV resin | Compatible with 365–405 nm MSLA/LCD printers | White finish for detailed prints | Rinse clean with water — no harsh solvents needed The ANYCUBIC Water Wash Resin 2.0 White is designed for MSLA/LCD resin printers and makers who want high-detail results without the hassle of solvent-based cleaning. Its hydrophilic group-modified formulation means printed parts can be rinsed clean with plain water (≥5 minutes), cutting out the need for isopropyl alcohol in the wash stage. Compatible with 365–405 nm UV light sources, it suits a wide range of consumer resin printers. Once washed, a 3-minute post-cure at 405 nm locks in the mechanical properties — tensile strength of 38–43 MPa and hardness of 82–85 HD — delivering finished parts that are firm and dimensionally stable. Best printed in an ambient temperature of 20–40 °C for consistent layer adhesion and reliable results. item.g:title: Anycubic PLA+ Filament 1kg - Grey
item.g:description: Enhanced toughness over standard PLA | Smooth, consistent extrusion | Eco-friendly plant-based material | Compatible with all 1.75 mm FDM printers | Beginner-friendly printing parameters The Anycubic PLA+ Filament is a high-toughness 3D printing material suited to hobbyists, educators, and makers who want better structural results than standard PLA without added complexity. Formulated from premium raw materials, it delivers twice the toughness of ordinary PLA with a bending modulus of 3980±360 MPa, making it well suited to toys, decorative parts, and functional prints that need to withstand handling. A tight diameter tolerance of less than ±0.02 mm ensures consistent, even extrusion that minimises nozzle clogging and produces clean, smooth surfaces. Because it shares standard PLA printing parameters — nozzle temperatures of 190–230 °C, a heated bed of 55–65 °C, and print speeds of 50–200 mm/s — you can load a new spool and get reliable results straight away. Refined from an eco-friendly plant-based substance, it produces lower odour during printing and does not emit irritating fumes, keeping your workspace comfortable. Each 1 kg spool features a reusable design with a threaded connection system that reduces filament entanglement and tangling errors. item.g:title: Anycubic Water Wash Resin 2.0 – Translucent Blue
item.g:description: Water-washable UV resin | Compatible with 365–405 nm MSLA/LCD printers | Translucent blue finish for detailed prints | Rinse clean with water — no harsh solvents needed The ANYCUBIC Water Wash Resin 2.0 Translucent Blue is designed for MSLA/LCD resin printers and makers who want high-detail results without the hassle of solvent-based cleaning. Its hydrophilic group-modified formulation means printed parts can be rinsed clean with plain water (≥5 minutes), cutting out the need for isopropyl alcohol in the wash stage. Compatible with 365–405 nm UV light sources, it suits a wide range of consumer resin printers. Once washed, a 3-minute post-cure at 405 nm locks in the mechanical properties — tensile strength of 38–43 MPa and hardness of 82–85 HD — delivering finished parts that are firm, dimensionally stable, and transparent blue colour. Best printed at an ambient temperature of 20–40 °C for consistent layer adhesion and reliable results. One Headset, Every Platform The Redragon FURY WRS is built for the gamer who refuses to be tied to a single setup. Retro style, modern performance The Redragon EISA 100 brings a distinctive retro aesthetic to the desk of the discerning South African gamer, pairing a cream and grey colourway with genuine mechanical performance. This isn't just a keyboard for looks — beneath the vintage-inspired keycaps sits a full-size 100-key layout built on linear mechanical switches, engineered for gamers and typists who want their setup to stand out without compromising on feel or function. Connect your way, every time Tired of being tied to a single cable or dongle? The EISA 100 solves that with tri-mode connectivity, letting you switch freely between a wired connection, 2.4GHz wireless, and Bluetooth depending on what you're doing and which device you're on. Up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation.◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Adaptive Audio◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Automatically adjusts the levels of noise cancellation depending on your environment. Transparency◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Lets you hear the world around you more naturally than ever before, so you can stay aware of your surroundings. Conversation Awareness◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Lowers your media volume when you speak to someone nearby and brings it back as soon as you’re done. A redesigned multiport acoustic architecture brings greater depth, clarity, and detail to your listening experience. Personalized Spatial Audio for sound that surrounds you.◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Volume control. AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case feature a force sensor with volume swipe. With USB‑C charging. AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case can also use Apple Watch or Qi wireless chargers.◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Up to 4 hours of listening time with ANC for AirPods 5 on a single charge◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Up to 5 hours of listening time with ANC for AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case on a single charge◊Refer to legal disclaimers. Up to 22 hours of total listening time with ANC for AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case◊Refer to legal disclaimers. IP57.◊ Refer to legal disclaimers. Improved dust, sweat, and water resistance. Locate your AirPods 5 with Find My.◊ Refer to legal disclaimers. AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case also feature a built‑in speaker. Compatibility Magic runs in the family. Refer to support.apple.com/en-us/120409 for AirPods Pro cleaning instructions. Adaptive Audio, Conversation Awareness, Siri Interactions, Voice Isolation: Requires a compatible Apple device running the latest operating system software. Automatic Switching: Requires an Apple Account and a compatible Apple device running the latest operating system software. Battery: Battery life depends on device settings, environment, usage, and many other factors. Testing conducted by Apple in July and August 2026 using preproduction AirPods 5 and AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case paired with preproduction iPhone 18 Pro units, all with prerelease software. The playlist consisted of 358 unique audio tracks purchased from the iTunes Store (256‑Kbps AAC encoding). Volume was set to 50%, Spatial Audio and Conversation Awareness were off, and Noise Control was set to Active Noise Cancellation. With Noise Control turned off, listening time for AirPods 5 was up to 6 hours, and listening time for AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case was up to 7 hours. Testing consisted of full AirPods battery discharge while playing audio until the first AirPod stopped playback. Testing conducted by Apple in July and August 2026 using preproduction AirPods 5 and charging case and AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case paired with preproduction iPhone 18 Pro units, all with prerelease software. The playlist consisted of 358 unique audio tracks purchased from the iTunes Store (256‑Kbps AAC encoding). Volume was set to 50%, Spatial Audio and Conversation Awareness were off, and Noise Control was set to Active Noise Cancellation. Testing consisted of full AirPods battery discharge while playing audio until the first AirPod stopped playback. The drained AirPods were charged to 100 percent, then audio playback was resumed until the first AirPod stopped playback. This cycle was repeated until both the AirPods and charging case were fully discharged. Charging Case: USB‑C charging requires a compatible USB‑C charger. Wireless charging requires a Qi‑certified wireless charger or the Apple Watch charger. MagSafe charging requires a compatible MagSafe charger. Dust, Sweat, and Water Resistance: AirPods 5 and AirPods Pro 3 are dust, sweat, and water resistant for non‑water sports and exercise. Water and Dust Resistance: Apple Watch Series 2 and later and Apple Watch SE and later have a water resistance rating of 50 meters under ISO standard 22810:2010. This means that they may be used for shallow-water activities like swimming in a pool or ocean. Series 10 and later can also be used for snorkeling to 6 meters. item.g:description: E-ATX ultra tower space | 4 included fans | 360mm radiator support front and top | GPU clearance up to 375 mm | USB Type-C front I/O Quick Specs Build with confidence in an E-ATX ultra tower gaming chassis designed to house a serious high-end system. Fit long graphics cards with clearance for GPUs up to 375 mm. Keep airflow flowing from day one with 4 included fans. Expand your cooling with 360mm radiator support at both the front and top. Connect quickly via front I/O with 2 x USB 3.0 ports and a USB Type-C port. Command your build with the FSP U530 gaming chassis The FSP U530 Ultimate Silent E-ATX Ultra Tower Gaming Chassis is made for the discerning South African gamer who wants room to build without compromise. As an ultra tower gaming chassis with E-ATX in its name and a clean black finish with a solid side panel, it gives your components a focused, understated home. Whether you are assembling a flagship rig or planning a build you can grow into, the U530 gives you the space to do it properly. Cooling headroom for sustained performance Tired of building a powerful PC only to find there is no room for the cooling you want? The U530 ships with 4 fans already included, so you have airflow in place from the first power-on. When you are ready to step up, the chassis supports 360mm radiators at both the front and the top, plus a 120/140mm radiator at the rear. That flexibility lets you plan an all-in-one or custom liquid cooling layout to keep a demanding gaming system running at its best. Room for serious hardware Big graphics cards and tall air coolers demand real clearance, and this chassis delivers it. You can fit a GPU up to 375 mm long and a CPU cooler up to 175 mm tall, so you can choose components based on performance rather than worrying about whether they will fit. It is a practical advantage when you are building a high-end gaming PC and want your hardware choices to stay open. Connect fast, every session Front I/O puts everyday connections within easy reach, with 2 x USB 3.0 ports and a USB Type-C port. Plug in your headset, a fast external drive or a modern peripheral without crawling behind your desk. At 47.3 x 23 x 49 cm and 8.88 kg, the U530 is a substantial ultra tower, so measure your desk or cabinet space before you commit. It is a chassis built to be the foundation of your battle station. Features Ultra tower E-ATX gaming chassis with room for a high-end build. 4 fans included, so you get airflow without buying extras. Front 360mm radiator support for a large liquid cooling setup. Top 360mm radiator support for further cooling flexibility. Rear 120/140mm radiator support to complete your airflow layout. Fits GPUs up to 375 mm long, making room for long graphics cards. Fits CPU coolers up to 175 mm tall, so you can use tall air coolers. Front I/O with 2 x USB 3.0 ports and a USB Type-C port for quick connections. Solid side panel in a black finish for a clean, understated look. Dominate the build with the DeepCool CG530 4F gaming chassis The DeepCool CG530 4F is an ATX gaming chassis for the discerning South African gamer who wants a build that looks as fierce as it performs. A tempered glass side panel puts your hardware on show, while RGB lighting adds a splash of personality to your desk or setup. It is a confident foundation for a custom gaming PC that earns attention. Tired of cramped builds and hardware that will not fit? Component clearance is where many cases let builders down, and the CG530 4F is made to give you room to work. At 44 x 28.5 x 39.9 cm and 7.0 kg, the CG530 4F is a substantial but manageable chassis that gives your gaming PC a solid home.
